name: 10× PBS
ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

notes.en: Autoclave to sterilize. Dilute 1:10 with dH₂O for 1× PBS. Check pH after dilution — should be 7.4. Store at RT.
notes.zh: 高压灭菌。用 dH₂O 1:10 稀释得 1× PBS。稀释后需校 pH（应为 7.4）。室温保存。

usage.en: Universal physiological buffer for cell washing, immunostaining, dilutions. Isotonic at 1× (~150 mM NaCl, ~10 mM phosphate).
usage.zh: 通用生理缓冲液，用于细胞洗涤、免疫染色、试剂稀释。1× 时等渗 (~150 mM NaCl, ~10 mM 磷酸盐)。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月 (高压灭菌后)

prepSteps.en: Weigh NaCl, KCl, Na₂HPO₄, KH₂PO₄ into a {v:1:L} beaker
prepSteps.zh: 称取 NaCl、KCl、Na₂HPO₄、KH₂PO₄ 于 {v:1:L} 烧杯

prepSteps.en: Add ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O, stir until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O，搅拌至完全溶解

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl (usually needs very little)
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.4（通常只需极少量）

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL} with ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 用 ddH₂O 定容至 {v:1000:mL}

prepSteps.en: Autoclave 121°C 20 min. Store at RT
prepSteps.zh: 121°C 高压灭菌 20 min，室温保存

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:10 to get 1× PBS before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前 1:10 稀释得 1× PBS

name: 1× PBS
ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl or NaOH. Autoclave. Can also dilute from 10× PBS. Store at RT, stable for months.
notes.zh: 用 HCl 或 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.4。高压灭菌。也可由 10× PBS 稀释。室温保存，可稳定数月。

usage.en: Ready-to-use wash/dilution buffer. Used in WB wash, cell culture rinse, ELISA, immunostaining, flow cytometry.
usage.zh: 即用型洗涤/稀释缓冲液。用于 WB 洗膜、细胞培养洗涤、ELISA、免疫染色、流式细胞术。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月 (高压灭菌后)

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× PBS into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× PBS 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix well, check pH (~7.4)
prepSteps.zh: 混匀，检查 pH（应为 ~7.4）

prepSteps.en: Autoclave or filter-sterilize (0.22 µm) for cell culture use
prepSteps.zh: 若用于细胞培养需高压灭菌或 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

name: 10× TBS
ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.6 with HCl. Autoclave. Dilute 1:10 for 1× TBS. Add 0.1% Tween-20 to make TBST.
notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.6。高压灭菌。1:10 稀释得 1× TBS。加 0.1% Tween-20 即为 TBST。

usage.en: WB wash base buffer. Preferred over PBS when probing phospho-proteins (phosphate in PBS interferes with anti-pSer/pThr).
usage.zh: WB 洗膜基础液。检测磷酸化蛋白时优先选 TBS（PBS 中的磷酸盐会干扰 anti-pSer/pThr 抗体）。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris base and NaCl in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris base 和 NaCl 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.6 with concentrated HCl (~{v:15:mL} 12N HCl)
prepSteps.zh: 用浓 HCl 调 pH 至 7.6（约需 {v:15:mL} 12N HCl）

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. Autoclave
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}，高压灭菌

name: 1× TBST

notes.en: Prepare fresh. Tween-20 at 0.05–0.1% is acceptable; adjust based on background signal.
notes.zh: 现配现用。Tween-20 终浓度 0.05–0.1% 均可，根据背景调整。

ref: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

usage.en: Standard WB wash buffer. Tween-20 reduces non-specific antibody binding. Use for all wash steps between primary/secondary antibody.
usage.zh: 标准 WB 洗膜液。Tween-20 降低非特异性抗体结合。用于一抗/二抗之间所有洗涤步骤。

label.zh: 室温, 约 1 个月（注意检查是否有沉淀）

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× TBS into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× TBS 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add {v:1:mL} Tween-20 (0.1% final)
prepSteps.zh: 加入 {v:1:mL} Tween-20（终浓度 0.1%）

prepSteps.en: Mix well. No pH adjustment needed
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀，无需调 pH

name: RIPA Lysis Buffer

notes.en: Add protease inhibitor cocktail (1:100) and phosphatase inhibitors before use. Work on ice, store at 4°C.
notes.zh: 使用前加入蛋白酶抑制剂 cocktail (1:100) 和磷酸酶抑制剂。冰上操作，4°C 保存。

ref: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40; Abcam RIPA Buffer Recipe

usage.en: Strong lysis buffer for total protein extraction. Denatures most protein-protein interactions. Use for WB when you need high yield. NOT for Co-IP (too harsh).
usage.zh: 强裂解液，用于总蛋白提取。会破坏大部分蛋白-蛋白互作。WB 需要高产量时使用。不适用于 Co-IP（太强）。

label.zh: 4°C, 3 个月；蛋白酶/磷酸酶抑制剂现用现加

prepSteps.en: Prepare stock RIPA without protease inhibitors
prepSteps.zh: 配制不含蛋白酶抑制剂的 RIPA 储备液

prepSteps.en: Dissolve NaCl, Tris-HCl, NP-40/IGEPAL, sodium deoxycholate, SDS in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 NaCl、Tris-HCl、NP-40、脱氧胆酸钠、SDS 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.4 if needed (usually correct from Tris stock)
prepSteps.zh: 必要时调 pH 至 7.4（通常 Tris 母液 pH 已正确）

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm), store at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌，4°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Before use: add 1× protease inhibitor cocktail + 1 mM PMSF + phosphatase inhibitors
prepSteps.zh: 使用前加入：1× 蛋白酶抑制剂 cocktail + 1 mM PMSF + 磷酸酶抑制剂

name: SDS-PAGE Gel (10% Resolving + 4% Stacking)
nameCn: SDS-PAGE 凝胶（10% 分离胶 + 4% 浓缩胶）

label.zh: 立即灌胶——约 30 分钟凝固

notes.en: Use 30% Acrylamide/Bis (29:1) stock. Add APS and TEMED last — gel polymerizes quickly once added. Overlay with isopropanol or water-saturated butanol while resolving gel sets. Pour stacking gel after resolving is solid. Acrylamide is a neurotoxin — wear gloves.
notes.zh: 此为 10% 分离胶配方（10 mL / 2 块胶）。可在 Calculator → SDS-PAGE 中调整浓度和体积。浓缩胶另配。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685; Bio-Rad Mini-PROTEAN Manual

usage.en: Standard SDS-PAGE gel for protein separation. 10% resolving gel separates 20–80 kDa. Adjust % for your target MW — use the Gel Calculator for custom volumes.
usage.zh: 标准 SDS-PAGE 蛋白分离凝胶。10% 分离胶分辨 20–80 kDa。可根据目标分子量调整浓度——使用配胶计算器自定义体积。

prepSteps.en: Mix ddH₂O, Tris-HCl buffer, and acrylamide stock
prepSteps.zh: 混合 ddH₂O、Tris-HCl 缓冲液和丙烯酰胺母液

prepSteps.en: Add 10% SDS
prepSteps.zh: 加入 10% SDS

prepSteps.en: Add 10% APS and TEMED last — mix gently
prepSteps.zh: 最后加入 10% APS 和 TEMED——轻柔混匀

prepSteps.en: Pour resolving gel, overlay with isopropanol, let polymerize ~30 min
prepSteps.zh: 灌入分离胶，覆盖异丙醇，凝固约 30 分钟

prepSteps.en: Rinse, pour stacking gel with comb, let polymerize ~15 min
prepSteps.zh: 冲洗后灌入浓缩胶并插入梳子，凝固约 15 分钟

name: 2× Laemmli Sample Buffer

notes.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C. β-mercaptoethanol can be replaced with DTT (200 mM). Heat at 95–100°C for 5 min before loading.
notes.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存。β-mercaptoethanol 可用 DTT (200 mM) 替代。使用前 95–100°C 加热 5 min。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

usage.en: SDS-PAGE loading buffer. Denatures proteins, adds negative charge for separation by MW. Add β-ME/DTT fresh for reducing conditions.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液。使蛋白变性，添加负电荷以按分子量分离。还原条件下需现加 β-ME/DTT。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 6 个月；β-ME 现用现加

prepSteps.en: Mix Tris-HCl pH 6.8, glycerol, SDS, and bromophenol blue
prepSteps.zh: 混合 Tris-HCl pH 6.8、甘油、SDS 和溴酚蓝

prepSteps.en: Heat gently to dissolve SDS if needed (do NOT boil)
prepSteps.zh: 必要时轻微加热溶解 SDS（不要煮沸）

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 0.5–1 mL per tube, store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 0.5–1 mL/管，-20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Before use: add 5% β-mercaptoethanol or 100 mM DTT
prepSteps.zh: 使用前加入 5% β-巯基乙醇或 100 mM DTT

prepSteps.en: Mix 1:1 with protein sample, boil 95°C × 5 min
prepSteps.zh: 与蛋白样品 1:1 混合，95°C 煮沸 5 min

name: 4× Laemmli Sample Buffer

notes.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C. Dilute 1:4 before use (3 parts sample : 1 part buffer).
notes.zh: 分装保存 -20°C。上样时 1:4 稀释（样品:buffer = 3:1）。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

usage.en: 4× concentrated loading buffer — saves sample volume. Mix 1:3 with sample for less dilution.
usage.zh: 4× 浓缩上样缓冲液——节省样品体积。与样品 1:3 混合，稀释更少。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 6 个月

prepSteps.en: Same as 2× but at double concentration
prepSteps.zh: 同 2× 配法，浓度翻倍

prepSteps.en: Mix 1 part buffer : 3 parts sample
prepSteps.zh: 1 份缓冲液 : 3 份样品混合

prepSteps.en: Boil 95°C × 5 min
prepSteps.zh: 95°C 煮沸 5 min

name: 1× Running Buffer (Tris-Glycine-SDS)

notes.en: pH should naturally reach ~8.3; no adjustment needed. Can also dilute from 10× stock.
notes.zh: pH 应自然达到 ~8.3，无需调 pH。也可由 10× 母液稀释。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685; Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10

usage.en: SDS-PAGE electrophoresis buffer (Laemmli system). Conducts current through gel for protein separation.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 电泳缓冲液（Laemmli 系统）。在凝胶中导电以分离蛋白。

label.en: RT, use within 2 weeks (single use recommended)
label.zh: 室温, 2 周内用完（建议单次使用）

prepSteps.en: Dilute {v:100:mL} 10× Running Buffer into {v:900:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:mL} 10× Running Buffer 加入 {v:900:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix well. Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 混匀。不要调 pH

prepSteps.en: Can reuse 2-3× for mini-gels but fresh is better
prepSteps.zh: Mini-gel 可重复使用 2-3 次，但建议用新鲜配的

name: 10× Running Buffer
ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

notes.en: Do NOT add SDS when making 10×. Add SDS when diluting to 1× (or add separately). Do not adjust pH — should be ~8.3 without adjustment. Do not autoclave.
notes.zh: 配 10× 时不加 SDS。稀释成 1× 时加 SDS（或另加）。不调 pH——不调即为 ~8.3。不可高压灭菌。

usage.en: Stock for SDS-PAGE running buffer. Dilute 1:10 before use.
usage.zh: SDS-PAGE 电泳缓冲液母液。使用前 1:10 稀释。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris, glycine, and SDS in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris、甘氨酸和 SDS 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Stir until clear. Do NOT adjust pH (should be ~8.3)
prepSteps.zh: 搅拌至透明。不要调 pH（应为 ~8.3）

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}

name: 1× Transfer Buffer (Towbin)

notes.en: Add methanol last, bring to 1 L. For proteins >100 kDa, add 0.01–0.05% SDS. Use cold (4°C). Do not adjust pH.
notes.zh: 加入甲醇后定容至 1 L。转膜大蛋白 (>100 kDa) 可加 0.01–0.05% SDS。4°C 使用。不要调 pH。

ref: Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350–4354

usage.en: Western blot transfer buffer. Transfers proteins from gel to membrane (PVDF/NC). Methanol aids protein-membrane binding and removes SDS.
usage.zh: WB 转膜缓冲液。将蛋白从凝胶转移到膜上（PVDF/NC）。甲醇促进蛋白-膜结合并去除 SDS。

label.zh: 现配现用；预冷至 4°C

prepSteps.en: Dilute 10× Running Buffer 1:10, add methanol to 20%
prepSteps.zh: 将 10× Running Buffer 1:10 稀释，加甲醇至 20%

prepSteps.en: Pre-chill to 4°C (transfer generates heat)
prepSteps.zh: 预冷至 4°C（转膜过程会产热）

prepSteps.en: For large proteins (>100 kDa): reduce methanol to 10%, add 0.01% SDS
prepSteps.zh: 大蛋白 (>100 kDa)：甲醇降至 10%，加 0.01% SDS

prepSteps.en: Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 不要调 pH

name: 5% Skim Milk Blocking Buffer

notes.en: Prepare fresh. Do not use for phospho-protein detection (milk casein is phosphorylated). Use BSA blocking instead.
notes.zh: 现配现用。勿用于检测磷酸化蛋白（milk 中含酪蛋白磷酸化位点），改用 BSA。

ref: Burnette (1981) Anal Biochem 112:195–203

usage.en: WB blocking — cheap, effective for most antibodies. Do NOT use with anti-phospho antibodies (casein contains phosphoproteins → high background).
usage.zh: WB 封闭——便宜好用，适合大多数抗体。不要用于磷酸化抗体检测（酪蛋白含磷蛋白→背景高）。

label.zh: 每天现配

prepSteps.en: Weigh {v:2.5:g} skim milk powder
prepSteps.zh: 称取 {v:2.5:g} 脱脂奶粉

prepSteps.en: Add to {v:50:mL} TBST, vortex until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入 {v:50:mL} TBST，涡旋至完全溶解

prepSteps.en: Use immediately. Discard after use
prepSteps.zh: 立即使用，用后丢弃

name: 5% BSA Blocking Buffer

notes.en: Suitable for phospho-protein detection. Add 0.02% NaN₃ to store at 4°C for ~1 week.
notes.zh: 适用于磷酸化蛋白检测。加 0.02% NaN₃ 可 4°C 保存约 1 周。

ref: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol Ch.10, Unit 10.2A

usage.en: WB blocking — required for phospho-protein detection. More expensive than milk. Also used for IF blocking.
usage.zh: WB 封闭——磷酸化蛋白检测必须用 BSA。比脱脂奶贵。也可用于 IF 封闭。

label.zh: 现配；BSA 粉末室温保存

prepSteps.en: Weigh {v:2.5:g} BSA (Fraction V or IgG-free)
prepSteps.zh: 称取 {v:2.5:g} BSA（Fraction V 或 IgG-free）

prepSteps.en: Dissolve in {v:50:mL} TBST. Rock gently, do NOT vortex vigorously
prepSteps.zh: 溶于 {v:50:mL} TBST，轻摇溶解，不要剧烈涡旋

prepSteps.en: Filter through 0.22 µm if needed
prepSteps.zh: 必要时 0.22 µm 过滤

name: 50× TAE

notes.en: Dilute to 1× (40 mM Tris-acetate, 1 mM EDTA) for gel electrophoresis. TAE gives better DNA recovery than TBE but lower buffering capacity — change buffer for long runs. Store 50× at RT.
notes.zh: 稀释至 1×（40 mM Tris-acetate, 1 mM EDTA）用于凝胶电泳。TAE 比 TBE DNA 回收率更高但缓冲能力较弱——长时间电泳需换液。50× 室温保存。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8644; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: DNA agarose gel electrophoresis buffer. Good for routine DNA gels. TAE gives better resolution for large fragments; TBE better for small.
usage.zh: DNA 琼脂糖凝胶电泳缓冲液。适合常规 DNA 电泳。TAE 对大片段分辨率好；TBE 对小片段好。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris base in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris base 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add glacial acetic acid and EDTA stock
prepSteps.zh: 加入冰醋酸和 EDTA 母液

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. No pH adjustment needed (~8.5)
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。无需调 pH（~8.5）

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:50 for working solution
prepSteps.zh: 使用时 1:50 稀释

name: 10× TBE

notes.en: Provides higher resolution than TAE for certain applications. Use at 0.5× or 1×.
notes.zh: 分辨率要求高时用 TBE (优于 TAE)。稀释至 0.5× 或 1× 使用。0.5× = 45 mM Tris-borate, 1 mM EDTA, pH ~8.3。室温保存，过 0.22 µm 滤膜防沉淀。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8458; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: Alternative DNA gel buffer. Higher buffering capacity than TAE — better for long runs. Preferred for small DNA/RNA fragments and polyacrylamide gels.
usage.zh: 替代 DNA 凝胶缓冲液。缓冲能力比 TAE 强——适合长时间电泳。小 DNA/RNA 片段和聚丙烯酰胺凝胶首选。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月；注意检查有无沉淀

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris and boric acid in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris 和硼酸溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 stock
prepSteps.zh: 加入 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 母液

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. Dilute 1:10 before use
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。使用时 1:10 稀释

name: TE Buffer

notes.en: Used for dissolving and storing DNA. Autoclave before storage. Low TE (0.1 mM EDTA) is suitable for PCR templates.
notes.zh: 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0。DNA 保存标准缓冲液。EDTA 螯合二价阳离子抑制核酸酶。高压灭菌，室温保存。低 TE (0.1 mM EDTA) 适合 PCR 模板。

ref: CSH Protocols; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

usage.en: DNA/RNA storage buffer. Tris maintains pH, EDTA chelates Mg²⁺ to inhibit DNases.
usage.zh: DNA/RNA 保存缓冲液。Tris 维持 pH，EDTA 螯合 Mg²⁺ 抑制 DNase。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月（高压灭菌后）

prepSteps.en: Mix Tris-HCl pH 8.0 stock and EDTA pH 8.0 stock
prepSteps.zh: 混合 Tris-HCl pH 8.0 母液和 EDTA pH 8.0 母液

prepSteps.en: Dilute to final concentrations with ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 用 ddH₂O 稀释至终浓度

prepSteps.en: Autoclave 121°C 20 min
prepSteps.zh: 121°C 高压灭菌 20 min

name: Coomassie Blue Staining Solution

notes.en: Dissolve CBB in methanol first, then add acetic acid and water. Filter (0.45 µm) before use. Stain 1–4 h.
notes.zh: 先将 CBB 溶于甲醇，再加醋酸和水。使用前过滤 (0.45 µm)。染色 1–4 h。

ref: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol, Ch.10, Unit 10.6

name: Coomassie Destaining Solution

notes.en: Change destain solution multiple times; adding Kimwipes absorbs released dye and speeds destaining.
notes.zh: 多次换液，加 Kimwipe 吸附可加速脱色。

ref: Gallagher (2012) Curr Protoc Mol Biol, Ch.10

name: Ponceau S Staining Solution

notes.en: Soak PVDF/NC membrane for 1–5 min after transfer. Rinse with TBS or water to destain. Solution is reusable.
notes.zh: 转膜后浸泡 PVDF/NC 膜 1–5 min，TBS 或水洗即可脱色。可重复使用。

ref: Romero-Calvo et al. (2010) Anal Biochem 401:318–320

name: LB Medium (Luria-Bertani)
ref: Bertani (1951) J Bacteriol 62:293–300; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH. Autoclave 121°C 15 min. Add antibiotics after cooling to <55°C. For agar plates, add 15 g/L agar before autoclaving.
notes.zh: 用 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.0。121°C 高压灭菌 15 min。冷却至 <55°C 后加抗生素。制备平板加 15 g/L 琼脂后再灭菌。

name: LB Agar

notes.en: Autoclave, cool to ~55°C before adding antibiotics, then pour plates. ~25 mL per 100 mm dish.
notes.zh: 高压灭菌后冷至 ~55°C 加抗生素，倒板。每板约 25 mL (100 mm dish)。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

usage.en: Solid growth medium for plating and selecting bacterial colonies. Add antibiotics after cooling to ~55°C.
usage.zh: 用于细菌涂板和筛选的固体培养基。冷却至约 55°C 后再加抗生素。

label.zh: 4°C 平板, 2 个月 (密封)

prepSteps.en: Autoclave LB + agar at 121°C for 20 min
prepSteps.zh: 121°C 高压灭菌 LB + 琼脂 20 min

prepSteps.en: Cool to ~55°C before adding antibiotics
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至 ~55°C 后再加抗生素

prepSteps.en: Pour ~25 mL per 100 mm dish. Let solidify at RT, then store inverted at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 每 100 mm 皿倒约 25 mL。室温凝固后倒置 4°C 保存

name: SOC Medium

notes.en: Autoclave Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl together. After cooling to <60°C, add sterile MgCl₂ and filter-sterilized glucose. Aliquot at −20°C.
notes.zh: 灭菌前加 Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl。灭菌后冷却至 <60°C 加 MgCl₂ 和 Glucose。分装 -20°C。

ref: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580

usage.en: Super Optimal broth with Catabolite repression. Rich recovery medium for transformed bacteria. Glucose enhances plasmid retention.
usage.zh: SOC 培养基。转化后细菌的富营养恢复培养基。葡萄糖增强质粒保留。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Autoclave Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl together
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tryptone/Yeast/NaCl/KCl 一起高压灭菌

prepSteps.en: Cool to <60°C, add sterile MgCl₂ and filter-sterilized glucose
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至 <60°C，加入无菌 MgCl₂ 和过滤除菌的葡萄糖

prepSteps.en: Aliquot and store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 -20°C 保存

name: WB Stripping Buffer (Mild)

notes.en: Adjust pH to 2.2 with HCl. Incubate at 37°C for 10–15 min × 2, then wash with TBST 3 × 10 min, then re-block.
notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 2.2。37°C 孵育 10–15 min × 2 次，然后 TBST 洗 3 次 × 10 min，重新封闭。

ref: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

usage.en: Removes primary+secondary antibodies from WB membrane for re-probing with a different antibody. Mild conditions preserve most antigens.
usage.zh: 去除 WB 膜上的一抗+二抗，用于更换抗体重新检测。温和条件保留大部分抗原。

label.zh: 每次现配

prepSteps.en: Mix glycine, SDS, Tween-20 in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将甘氨酸、SDS、Tween-20 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 2.2 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 2.2

prepSteps.en: Incubate membrane 2×10 min with stripping buffer
prepSteps.zh: 膜在 stripping buffer 中孵育 2×10 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 2×10 min with PBS, then 2×5 min with TBST
prepSteps.zh: 用 PBS 洗 2×10 min，再用 TBST 洗 2×5 min

prepSteps.en: Re-block and probe with new antibody
prepSteps.zh: 重新封闭后加新抗体

name: IP / Co-IP Lysis Buffer

notes.en: Add protease/phosphatase inhibitors before use. For Co-IP use mild detergent (0.5% NP-40) to preserve interactions. Lyse on ice 30 min, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 15 min.
notes.zh: 使用前加蛋白酶/磷酸酶抑制剂。Co-IP 用温和去垢剂 (0.5% NP-40) 保持蛋白互作。冰上裂解 30 min，4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min。

ref: Miernyk & Thelen (2008) Plant J 55:415–425; Nature Protocols

usage.en: Co-IP lysis buffer. Milder than RIPA — preserves protein-protein interactions. NP-40 concentration can be tuned (0.1–1%).
usage.zh: Co-IP 裂解液。比 RIPA 温和——保留蛋白-蛋白互作。NP-40 浓度可调节（0.1–1%）。

label.zh: 4°C 储备, 3 个月；抑制剂现用现加

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris-HCl, NaCl, NP-40, EDTA in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris-HCl、NaCl、NP-40、EDTA 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.4
prepSteps.zh: 调 pH 至 7.4

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize, store at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌，4°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Add protease inhibitors immediately before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前立即加入蛋白酶抑制剂

name: ChIP SDS Lysis Buffer

notes.en: Use after crosslinking (1% formaldehyde, RT 10 min). Add protease inhibitors. Sonicate to generate 200–500 bp DNA fragments.
notes.zh: 交联后 (1% 甲醛，室温 10 min) 使用。加蛋白酶抑制剂。超声使 DNA 片段 200–500 bp。

ref: Lee et al. (2006) Cell 125:301–313; Collas (2010) Mol Biotechnol 45:87–100

usage.en: ChIP lysis + sonication buffer. SDS denatures chromatin for efficient shearing. Used after crosslinking with formaldehyde.
usage.zh: ChIP 裂解/超声缓冲液。SDS 使染色质变性以高效剪切。在甲醛交联后使用。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve SDS, EDTA, Tris-HCl in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 SDS、EDTA、Tris-HCl 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: pH should be ~8.1 from Tris stock
prepSteps.zh: pH 应为 ~8.1（来自 Tris 母液）

prepSteps.en: Add protease inhibitors before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前加入蛋白酶抑制剂

name: ChIP Dilution Buffer

notes.en: Dilute SDS lysate 10× with this buffer before immunoprecipitation. Add protease inhibitors.
notes.zh: 将 SDS 裂解产物稀释 10× 后用于免疫沉淀。加蛋白酶抑制剂。

ref: Upstate/Millipore ChIP Protocol; Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

usage.en: Dilutes the SDS in lysis buffer to allow antibody binding. Reduces SDS from 1% to ~0.1%.
usage.zh: 稀释裂解液中的 SDS 以允许抗体结合。将 SDS 从 1% 降至 ~0.1%。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Mix Triton X-100, EDTA, Tris-HCl, NaCl in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Triton X-100、EDTA、Tris-HCl、NaCl 混合于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Dilute ChIP lysate ~10-fold with this buffer
prepSteps.zh: 用此缓冲液将 ChIP 裂解物稀释约 10 倍

name: ChIP Low Salt Wash Buffer

notes.en: ChIP wash step; rotate at 4°C for 5 min each wash.
notes.zh: ChIP 洗涤步骤，每步 4°C 旋转 5 min。

ref: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

usage.en: First stringency wash in ChIP — removes loosely bound chromatin.
usage.zh: ChIP 第一步严格洗涤——去除松散结合的染色质。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Prepare and use ice-cold
prepSteps.zh: 配制后冰上使用

prepSteps.en: Wash beads 3–5 min with rotation at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 旋转洗珠 3–5 min

name: ChIP High Salt Wash Buffer

notes.en: High-salt wash reduces nonspecific binding.
notes.zh: 高盐洗涤减少非特异性结合。

ref: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185

usage.en: Second stringency wash in ChIP — higher NaCl removes most non-specific binding.
usage.zh: ChIP 第二步严格洗涤——高盐去除大部分非特异结合。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Prepare and use ice-cold
prepSteps.zh: 配制后冰上使用

prepSteps.en: Wash beads 3–5 min with rotation at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 旋转洗珠 3–5 min

name: 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA)

notes.en: 60°C water bath to dissolve (do not exceed 70°C); add NaOH to clarify; cool and adjust pH to 7.4. Filter (0.45 µm). Aliquot at −20°C.
notes.zh: 60°C 水浴搅拌溶解 (勿超 70°C)，加 NaOH 至澄清，冷却后调 pH 至 7.4。过滤 (0.45 µm)。分装 -20°C 保存。⚠️ 通风橱操作！

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec11863; Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40

usage.en: Fixative for immunofluorescence, flow cytometry, tissue processing. Crosslinks proteins to preserve cellular structure.
usage.zh: 固定液，用于免疫荧光、流式细胞术、组织处理。交联蛋白以保持细胞结构。

label.en: -20°C aliquots; thaw once only; toxic fumes!
label.zh: -20°C 分装；只解冻一次；有毒蒸气！

prepSteps.en: ⚠️ Work in fume hood! PFA is toxic
prepSteps.zh: ⚠️ 在通风橱内操作！PFA 有毒

prepSteps.en: Heat PBS to 60°C (do NOT boil)
prepSteps.zh: 将 PBS 加热至 60°C（不要煮沸）

prepSteps.en: Add PFA powder, stir until dissolved
prepSteps.zh: 加入 PFA 粉末，搅拌至溶解

prepSteps.en: Add 1–2 drops 1N NaOH to clear solution
prepSteps.zh: 滴加 1–2 滴 1N NaOH 使溶液变澄清

prepSteps.en: Cool to RT, adjust pH to 7.2–7.4 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至室温，用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.2–7.4

prepSteps.en: Filter (0.22 µm), aliquot, freeze at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤，分装，-20°C 冻存

name: IF Permeabilization Buffer

notes.en: Incubate at RT 10–15 min. For membrane proteins use 0.05% Triton or 0.1% saponin. For nuclear proteins use 0.5% Triton.
notes.zh: 室温孵育 10–15 min。胞膜蛋白用 0.05% Triton 或 0.1% saponin。核蛋白可用 0.5% Triton。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.7; Nature Protocols

usage.en: Makes cell membrane permeable for intracellular antibody access in IF. Triton X-100 creates holes in lipid bilayer.
usage.zh: 使细胞膜通透以便抗体进入细胞内部（IF）。Triton X-100 在脂质双层上打孔。

label.zh: 现配现用

prepSteps.en: Add 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 to PBS
prepSteps.zh: 在 PBS 中加入 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100

prepSteps.en: Incubate cells 10–15 min at RT
prepSteps.zh: 室温孵育细胞 10–15 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 3× with PBS
prepSteps.zh: 用 PBS 洗 3 次

name: IF Blocking Buffer

notes.en: Block 1 h at RT. Serum species should match the secondary antibody host. 10% donkey serum also works.
notes.zh: 封闭 1 h 室温。serum 种属应与二抗宿主一致。也可用 10% donkey serum。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1; Im et al. (2019) STAR Protoc Preview

usage.en: IF blocking — BSA + serum reduces non-specific antibody binding to fixed/permeabilized cells.
usage.zh: IF 封闭——BSA + 血清降低固定/透化细胞上的非特异抗体结合。

label.en: Prepare fresh; serum matches secondary host
label.zh: 现配；血清需与二抗来源种属一致

prepSteps.en: Dissolve BSA in PBS, add normal serum (same species as secondary Ab)
prepSteps.zh: 将 BSA 溶于 PBS，加入正常血清（与二抗同种属）

prepSteps.en: Add 0.1% Tween-20 (optional, reduces background)
prepSteps.zh: 可选加入 0.1% Tween-20（降低背景）

prepSteps.en: Block cells 1 h at RT or overnight at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 室温封闭 1 h 或 4°C 过夜

name: FACS Staining Buffer

notes.en: Include NaN₃ to prevent capping; omit for live cell sorting. Store at 4°C. Filter through 0.22 µm.
notes.zh: NaN₃ 防止 cap-and-strip；若做活细胞分选则不加 NaN₃。4°C 保存。过滤 (0.22 µm)。

ref: Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457–1973 (Guidelines for flow cytometry)

usage.en: Flow cytometry staining/wash buffer. BSA prevents non-specific binding, EDTA prevents cell clumping, azide prevents capping.
usage.zh: 流式细胞术染色/洗涤缓冲液。BSA 防非特异结合，EDTA 防细胞聚团，叠氮钠防抗体封帽。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve BSA and EDTA in PBS
prepSteps.zh: 将 BSA 和 EDTA 溶于 PBS

prepSteps.en: Optional: add 0.05% sodium azide (NaN₃)
prepSteps.zh: 可选：加入 0.05% 叠氮钠 (NaN₃)

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm)
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Keep at 4°C, use cold
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 保存，冷用

name: MACS Separation Buffer

notes.en: Degas before use. Store at 4°C. 2% FBS can substitute BSA.
notes.zh: 脱气后使用。4°C 保存。也可用 FBS 替代 BSA (2% FBS)。

ref: Miltenyi Biotec MACS Handbook; Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457

usage.en: Magnetic cell separation buffer. Optimized for MACS column flow. BSA prevents non-specific bead binding.
usage.zh: 磁珠细胞分选缓冲液。为 MACS 柱优化。BSA 防止磁珠非特异结合。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 周；使用前脱气

prepSteps.en: Dissolve BSA and EDTA in PBS
prepSteps.zh: 将 BSA 和 EDTA 溶于 PBS

prepSteps.en: Degas buffer (prevents air bubbles in MACS column)
prepSteps.zh: 缓冲液脱气（防止 MACS 柱中产生气泡）

prepSteps.en: Keep at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 保存

name: Nuclear/Cytoplasmic Fractionation Buffer A
nameCn: 核质分离裂解液 A (胞浆)

notes.en: Incubate on ice 15 min, add 10% NP-40 to final 0.6%, vortex 10 s, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 30 s. Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction.
notes.zh: 冰上孵育 15 min，加 10% NP-40 至终浓度 0.6%，涡旋 10 s，4°C 14,000×g 30 s。上清 = 胞浆。

ref: Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29; Suzuki et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:532–539

usage.en: Hypotonic buffer — swells cells for gentle cytoplasmic lysis. NP-40 permeabilizes plasma membrane while keeping nuclei intact.
usage.zh: 低渗缓冲液——使细胞膨胀以温和裂解胞质。NP-40 透化质膜但保持核完整。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月；DTT+抑制剂现加

prepSteps.en: Prepare without DTT and protease inhibitors
prepSteps.zh: 先配制不含 DTT 和蛋白酶抑制剂的储备液

prepSteps.en: Before use: add 1 mM DTT + protease inhibitors
prepSteps.zh: 使用前加入 1 mM DTT + 蛋白酶抑制剂

prepSteps.en: Incubate cells on ice 15 min, then add NP-40 to 0.1%
prepSteps.zh: 冰上孵育细胞 15 min，然后加 NP-40 至 0.1%

prepSteps.en: Vortex 10 s, centrifuge 3000×g 10 min → supernatant = cytoplasm
prepSteps.zh: 涡旋 10 s，3000×g 离心 10 min → 上清 = 胞质

name: Nuclear/Cytoplasmic Fractionation Buffer B
nameCn: 核质分离裂解液 B (核)

notes.en: Resuspend nuclear pellet, rock on ice 15 min, centrifuge at 4°C 14,000×g for 5 min. Supernatant = nuclear extract. Add protease inhibitors.
notes.zh: 重悬核沉淀，冰上振荡 15 min，4°C 14,000×g 5 min。上清 = 核蛋白。加蛋白酶抑制剂。

ref: Suzuki et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:532–539

usage.en: High-salt nuclear extraction buffer — extracts nuclear proteins from the nuclear pellet after cytoplasmic fractionation.
usage.zh: 高盐核提取缓冲液——从胞质分离后的核沉淀中提取核蛋白。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月；抑制剂现加

prepSteps.en: Resuspend nuclear pellet in Buffer B
prepSteps.zh: 用 Buffer B 重悬核沉淀

prepSteps.en: Rotate 30 min at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 旋转 30 min

prepSteps.en: Centrifuge 16,000×g 20 min → supernatant = nuclear extract
prepSteps.zh: 16,000×g 离心 20 min → 上清 = 核提取物

name: His-tag Binding/Wash Buffer

notes.en: Adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH. Binding buffer: 10–20 mM imidazole; wash buffer: 20–50 mM; elution buffer: 250–500 mM.
notes.zh: NaOH 调 pH 至 8.0。结合液含 10–20 mM imidazole；洗涤液 20–50 mM；洗脱液 250–500 mM。

ref: QIAGEN Ni-NTA Handbook; Kimple et al. (2013) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 73:9.9.1–9.9.23

usage.en: Ni-NTA binding/wash buffer for His-tagged protein purification. Imidazole (10–20 mM) reduces non-specific binding.
usage.zh: Ni-NTA 结合/洗涤缓冲液，用于 His 标签蛋白纯化。低浓度咪唑 (10–20 mM) 减少非特异结合。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve NaH₂PO₄, NaCl, imidazole in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 NaH₂PO₄、NaCl、咪唑溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 8.0 with NaOH
prepSteps.zh: 用 NaOH 调 pH 至 8.0

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

name: His-tag Elution Buffer

notes.en: Adjust pH to 8.0. Dialyze or desalt immediately after elution to remove imidazole. Gradient elution improves purity.
notes.zh: 调 pH 至 8.0。洗脱后立即透析或脱盐去除 imidazole。可用梯度洗脱提高纯度。

ref: QIAGEN Ni-NTA Handbook; Kimple et al. (2013) Curr Protoc Protein Sci 73:9.9.1

usage.en: Elutes His-tagged protein from Ni-NTA resin. High imidazole (250 mM) competes with His-tag for Ni²⁺ binding.
usage.zh: 从 Ni-NTA 树脂上洗脱 His 标签蛋白。高浓度咪唑 (250 mM) 竞争 His 标签与 Ni²⁺ 的结合。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Same as binding buffer but with 250 mM imidazole
prepSteps.zh: 同结合缓冲液，但咪唑浓度为 250 mM

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 8.0 (imidazole shifts pH)
prepSteps.zh: 调 pH 至 8.0（咪唑会改变 pH）

prepSteps.en: Collect 1 mL fractions, check by Bradford/SDS-PAGE
prepSteps.zh: 收集 1 mL 组分，Bradford/SDS-PAGE 检测

name: GST Elution Buffer

notes.en: Prepare fresh — glutathione oxidizes rapidly. Add just before use. Adjust pH to 8.0. Elute at RT for 10–15 min.
notes.zh: 新鲜配制。谷胱甘肽易氧化，临用加入。调 pH 至 8.0。室温洗脱 10–15 min。

ref: Harper & Bhatt (2004) Methods Mol Biol 261:55–72; GE Healthcare GST Gene Fusion System Handbook

usage.en: Elutes GST-tagged protein from glutathione resin. Reduced glutathione competes with GST-glutathione binding.
usage.zh: 从谷胱甘肽树脂上洗脱 GST 标签蛋白。还原型谷胱甘肽竞争 GST-谷胱甘肽结合。

label.zh: -20°C 分装；谷胱甘肽室温易氧化

prepSteps.en: Dissolve reduced glutathione in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0
prepSteps.zh: 将还原型谷胱甘肽溶于 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 8.0 (glutathione is acidic)
prepSteps.zh: 调 pH 至 8.0（谷胱甘肽偏酸性）

prepSteps.en: Use fresh or thaw from -20°C aliquots
prepSteps.zh: 现配或从 -20°C 分装中解冻使用

name: Native PAGE Running Buffer
nameCn: 非变性 PAGE 电泳缓冲液

notes.en: Same as SDS-PAGE but without SDS. pH ~8.3 forms naturally. Do not boil samples or add reducing agents. Run at 4°C.
notes.zh: 与 SDS-PAGE 相同但不加 SDS。pH ~8.3 自然形成。样品不煮沸不加还原剂。4°C 电泳。

ref: Wittig et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:418–428

usage.en: Native PAGE — separates proteins by charge and shape WITHOUT denaturing. No SDS. For studying native complexes.
usage.zh: Native PAGE——按电荷和形状分离蛋白，不变性。无 SDS。用于研究天然蛋白复合物。

label.zh: 室温, 1 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris and glycine in ddH₂O (NO SDS)
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris 和甘氨酸溶于 ddH₂O（不加 SDS）

prepSteps.en: pH should be ~8.3. Do not adjust
prepSteps.zh: pH 应为 ~8.3，不要调节

prepSteps.en: Run gel at 4°C to preserve native structure
prepSteps.zh: 在 4°C 跑胶以保持蛋白天然结构

name: Blue Native PAGE Cathode Buffer

notes.en: Do not adjust pH (~7.0). After the gel front has migrated ~1/3, switch to cathode buffer without CBB to reduce background.
notes.zh: 不调 pH (约 7.0)。电泳 1/3 后可换不含 CBB 的阴极缓冲液。

ref: Wittig et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:418–428

usage.en: Blue Native PAGE cathode buffer — Coomassie G-250 provides charge for migration without SDS denaturation. For membrane protein complexes.
usage.zh: Blue Native PAGE 阴极缓冲液——考马斯亮蓝 G-250 提供电荷，无需 SDS 变性。用于膜蛋白复合物。

label.zh: 4°C, 1 周；考马斯蓝会沉淀

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tricine and Bis-Tris in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tricine 和 Bis-Tris 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add Coomassie G-250 to 0.02%
prepSteps.zh: 加入考马斯亮蓝 G-250 至 0.02%

prepSteps.en: Prepare fresh; use cold (4°C)
prepSteps.zh: 现配；冷用 (4°C)

name: MTT Stock Solution

notes.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light. Add 10 µL per 100 µL medium. After 37°C 4 h incubation, discard supernatant and solubilize formazan.
notes.zh: 过滤除菌 (0.22 µm)。分装 -20°C 避光保存。使用时每孔加 10 µL/100 µL 培养基。37°C 4 h 后弃上清，加 DMSO 150 µL 溶解紫色结晶。490–570 nm 读数。

ref: Mosmann (1983) J Immunol Methods 65:55–63; van Meerloo et al. (2011) Methods Mol Biol 731:237–245

usage.en: Cell viability assay reagent. MTT is reduced by mitochondria in living cells → purple formazan crystals. Dissolved in DMSO and measured at OD570.
usage.zh: 细胞活力检测试剂。活细胞线粒体将 MTT 还原为紫色甲臜结晶。用 DMSO 溶解后 OD570 检测。

label.zh: -20°C 避光保存, 6 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve MTT powder in PBS to 5 mg/mL
prepSteps.zh: 将 MTT 粉末溶于 PBS 至 5 mg/mL

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm)
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Aliquot into light-protected tubes, store -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装至避光管，-20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Add 10 µL per 100 µL culture medium, incubate 2–4 h
prepSteps.zh: 每 100 µL 培养基加 10 µL，孵育 2–4 h

name: CRISPR RNP Assembly Buffer

notes.en: sgRNA:Cas9 molar ratio 1.2:1–3:1. Incubate at RT for 10 min to assemble RNP complex. Deliver by electroporation or lipofection.
notes.zh: sgRNA:Cas9 摩尔比 1.2:1–3:1。室温孵育 10 min 组装 RNP。电转或脂质体转染。

ref: Kim et al. (2014) Genome Res 24:1012–1019; Hanna & Doench (2020) Nat Biotechnol 38:824–844

usage.en: CRISPR Cas9-sgRNA ribonucleoprotein assembly buffer. Low salt, neutral pH for RNP complex formation before electroporation.
usage.zh: CRISPR Cas9-sgRNA 核糖核蛋白组装缓冲液。低盐、中性 pH，用于电穿孔前的 RNP 复合物形成。

label.en: -20°C, 3 months; RNP should be used within 1h of assembly
label.zh: -20°C, 3 个月；RNP 组装后 1h 内使用

prepSteps.en: Mix HEPES pH 7.5 + KCl + MgCl₂ in nuclease-free H₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 HEPES pH 7.5 + KCl + MgCl₂ 混合于无核酸酶水中

prepSteps.en: Add Cas9 protein + sgRNA (1:1.2 molar ratio)
prepSteps.zh: 加入 Cas9 蛋白 + sgRNA（1:1.2 摩尔比）

prepSteps.en: Incubate RT 10 min for RNP formation
prepSteps.zh: 室温孵育 10 min 形成 RNP 复合物

prepSteps.en: Electroporate immediately
prepSteps.zh: 立即电穿孔

name: TRIzol RNA Extraction

components.name: 1. 加 TRIzol 裂解
components.note: 1 mL per 5–10×10⁶ cells; 组织: 1 mL per 50–100 mg, 匀浆器研磨

components.name: 2. 室温静置 5 min
components.note: 充分裂解核蛋白复合物

components.name: 3. 加 0.2 mL 氯仿 (per 1 mL TRIzol)
components.note: 盖紧, 剧烈摇晃 15 s, 室温 2–3 min

components.name: 4. 离心 12,000×g, 15 min, 4°C
components.note: 分三层: 上层水相 (RNA) / 中间层 (DNA) / 下层有机相 (蛋白)

components.name: 5. 小心吸取上层水相至新管
6. 加 0.5 mL 异丙醇 (per 1 mL TRIzol)
7. 离心 12,000×g, 10 min, 4°C
components.note: RNA 沉淀为白色/透明胶状颗粒

components.name: 8. 弃上清, 加 1 mL 75% 乙醇洗涤
10. 弃乙醇, 风干 5–10 min
components.note: 勿过度干燥 (沉淀变透明即可), 否则难溶解

components.name: 11. 加 20–50 µL RNase-free H₂O 溶解
components.note: 55°C 孵育 10 min 助溶解; 轻弹混匀

ref: Chomczynski & Sacchi (1987) Anal Biochem 162:156–159; Rio et al. (2010) CSH Protoc doi:10.1101/pdb.prot5439; Thermo Fisher TRIzol Reagent User Guide (Pub. No. MAN0001271)

notes.en: All steps use RNase-free consumables. TRIzol is toxic (phenol + guanidinium) — work in fume hood with gloves. Typical yield: 5–15 µg RNA per 10⁶ cells. For small amounts, add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) as carrier before isopropanol step. Store RNA at -80°C. DNase I treatment recommended before RT-qPCR.
notes.zh: 全程使用无 RNase 耗材。TRIzol 含苯酚和异硫氰酸胍，通风橱操作，戴手套。典型产量：每 10⁶ 细胞 5–15 µg RNA。微量样品在异丙醇沉淀前加 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) 做载体。RNA 保存 -80°C。RT-qPCR 前建议 DNase I 处理。

usage.en: Gold-standard total RNA extraction using phenol-guanidinium. High yield from cells, tissues, bacteria. Compatible with downstream RT-qPCR, RNA-seq, Northern blot.
usage.zh: 苯酚-异硫氰酸胍法提取总 RNA 的金标准。适用于细胞、组织、细菌。兼容 RT-qPCR、RNA-seq、Northern blot 等下游实验。

label.zh: 实验方案 — RNA -80°C 保存

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells in TRIzol → add chloroform → centrifuge → collect aqueous phase → isopropanol precipitate → ethanol wash → dissolve RNA
briefSteps.zh: TRIzol 裂解 → 加氯仿 → 离心 → 取水相 → 异丙醇沉淀 → 乙醇洗涤 → 溶解 RNA

detailedSteps.en: **Cell lysis**: Remove media, add 1 mL TRIzol per 5–10×10⁶ cells (or 50–100 mg tissue). Pipet up/down 10× to lyse completely
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞裂解**: 去除培养基，每 5–10×10⁶ 细胞加 1 mL TRIzol（或 50–100 mg 组织）。反复吹打 10 次至完全裂解

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 5 min at RT to dissociate nucleoprotein complexes
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 5 min，使核蛋白复合物完全解离

detailedSteps.en: **Phase separation**: Add 0.2 mL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol. Cap tightly, shake vigorously 15 s (do NOT vortex)
detailedSteps.zh: **相分离**: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加 0.2 mL 氯仿。盖紧管盖，剧烈摇晃 15 s（不要涡旋）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 2–3 min at RT. Solution should turn milky pink
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 2–3 min。溶液应变为乳白粉红色

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 12,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Three layers form: red organic (bottom), white interphase, clear aqueous (top)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 12,000×g 离心 15 min。形成三层：红色有机相（底）、白色中间相、透明水相（顶）

detailedSteps.en: **RNA precipitation**: Carefully transfer upper aqueous phase to new tube (~60% of TRIzol volume). ⚠️ Avoid interphase!
detailedSteps.zh: **RNA 沉淀**: 小心转移上层水相至新管（约为 TRIzol 体积的 60%）。⚠️ 避免触碰中间相！

detailedSteps.en: Add 0.5 mL isopropanol per 1 mL TRIzol. Mix gently by inversion 6×
detailedSteps.zh: 每 1 mL TRIzol 加 0.5 mL 异丙醇。轻柔颠倒混匀 6 次

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 10 min RT (or -20°C 1 h for low-abundance samples)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 10 min（低丰度样品可 -20°C 放 1 h）

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 12,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. RNA pellet should be visible (white/translucent)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 12,000×g 离心 10 min。应可见 RNA 沉淀（白色/半透明）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Discard supernatant. Add 1 mL 75% ethanol (in DEPC-H₂O). Vortex briefly
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 弃上清。加 1 mL 75% 乙醇（DEPC 水配制）。短暂涡旋

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 7,500×g, 5 min, 4°C. Discard ethanol completely
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 7,500×g 离心 5 min。完全弃去乙醇

detailedSteps.en: **Dissolve**: Air-dry pellet 5–10 min (do NOT over-dry — pellet becomes hard to dissolve). Dissolve in 20–50 µL RNase-free H₂O
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解**: 室温风干沉淀 5–10 min（不要过度干燥——会难以溶解）。加 20–50 µL 无 RNase 水溶解

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 55°C, 10 min to aid dissolution. Place on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 55°C 孵育 10 min 促进溶解。然后置于冰上

detailedSteps.en: **QC**: Measure A260/280 (expect ~2.0) and A260/230 (expect >1.7). Run on gel or Bioanalyzer if needed
detailedSteps.zh: **质检**: 测 A260/280（期望 ~2.0）和 A260/230（期望 >1.7）。必要时跑胶或 Bioanalyzer 检测

note.en: Aqueous phase can be stored at -80°C
RNA pellet in 75% ethanol can be stored at -80°C for months
note.zh: RNA 沉淀在 75% 乙醇中可 -80°C 保存数月

name: Western Blot Full Protocol

components.name: 1. 样品制备: RIPA 裂解
3. 加 Loading Buffer, 煮沸 5 min

notes.en: Primary antibody: 1:500–1:2000; HRP secondary: 1:5000–1:10000. Use BSA blocking for phospho-proteins. Semi-dry transfer suitable for proteins <100 kDa.
notes.zh: 一抗稀释比通常 1:500–1:2000；HRP 二抗 1:5000–1:10000。磷酸化蛋白用 BSA 封闭。半干转适合 <100 kDa 蛋白。PVDF 需甲醇活化。

ref: Mahmood & Yang (2012) N Am J Med Sci 4:429–434; Bass et al. (2017) STAR Protoc Preview; Towbin et al. (1979) PNAS 76:4350

usage.en: Detect specific proteins in cell/tissue lysates by separating on SDS-PAGE, transferring to membrane, and probing with antibodies. Quantitative with proper controls.
usage.zh: 通过 SDS-PAGE 分离蛋白，转膜后用抗体探测特定蛋白。适当对照下可实现定量分析。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 天实验

briefSteps.en: Lyse → quantify → SDS-PAGE → transfer → block → primary Ab O/N → wash → secondary Ab 1h → wash → ECL detect
briefSteps.zh: 裂解 → 定量 → SDS-PAGE → 转膜 → 封闭 → 一抗过夜 → 洗 → 二抗 1h → 洗 → ECL 检测

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Sample prep**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 样品制备**

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Aspirate media, wash 1× cold PBS. Add cold RIPA buffer (100–200 µL per well of 6-well plate). Rock on ice 15–30 min
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 吸除培养基，冷 PBS 洗 1 次。加冷 RIPA 裂解液（6 孔板每孔 100–200 µL）。冰上晃动 15–30 min

detailedSteps.en: Scrape cells, transfer to 1.5 mL tube. Centrifuge 14,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant (= total protein)
detailedSteps.zh: 刮下细胞，转移至 1.5 mL 管。4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min。取上清（= 总蛋白）

detailedSteps.en: **Quantification**: BCA or Bradford assay. Need 20–50 µg protein per lane
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: BCA 或 Bradford 法。每泳道需 20–50 µg 蛋白

detailedSteps.en: Mix protein sample with equal volume 2× Laemmli buffer (or 1:3 with 4× buffer)
detailedSteps.zh: 蛋白样品与等体积 2× Laemmli buffer 混合（或与 4× buffer 1:3 混合）

detailedSteps.en: Boil 95°C, 5 min (or 70°C, 10 min for membrane proteins). Quick-spin, place on ice or store -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: 95°C 煮沸 5 min（膜蛋白用 70°C, 10 min）。快速离心，冰上或 -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **SDS-PAGE**: Set up gel (choose % based on target MW — see Gel Calculator tab). Load samples + ladder
detailedSteps.zh: **SDS-PAGE**: 装好凝胶（根据目标蛋白分子量选择浓度——参见配胶计算 tab）。上样 + Marker

detailedSteps.en: Run: 80V through stacking gel (~20 min), then 120V through resolving gel (~1–1.5 h). Run until dye front reaches bottom
detailedSteps.zh: 电泳: 浓缩胶 80V（约 20 min），分离胶 120V（约 1–1.5 h）。跑至溴酚蓝到达底部

detailedSteps.en: **Transfer**: Prepare transfer sandwich — sponge / filter paper / gel / membrane / filter paper / sponge. Remove all air bubbles!
detailedSteps.zh: **转膜**: 组装转膜三明治——海绵 / 滤纸 / 凝胶 / 膜 / 滤纸 / 海绵。去除所有气泡！

detailedSteps.en: Wet transfer: 100V, 60–90 min in cold Transfer Buffer with ice pack. OR semi-dry: 25V, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 湿转: 冷 Transfer Buffer 中 100V, 60–90 min，加冰块。或半干转: 25V, 30 min

detailedSteps.en: For proteins >150 kDa: transfer at 30V overnight at 4°C, reduce methanol to 10%, add 0.01% SDS
detailedSteps.zh: >150 kDa 蛋白: 4°C 30V 过夜转膜，甲醇降至 10%，加 0.01% SDS

detailedSteps.en: **Verify transfer**: Ponceau S stain membrane 2 min, wash with ddH₂O. Photograph. Destain with TBST
detailedSteps.zh: **验证转膜**: Ponceau S 染膜 2 min，ddH₂O 冲洗。拍照。用 TBST 脱色

detailedSteps.en: **Blocking**: 5% milk/TBST or 5% BSA/TBST, 1 h at RT with rocking. ⚠️ Use BSA for phospho-antibodies!
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 5% 脱脂奶/TBST 或 5% BSA/TBST，室温摇 1 h。⚠️ 磷酸化抗体必须用 BSA！

detailedSteps.en: **Primary antibody**: Dilute in blocking buffer (typically 1:500–1:2000). Incubate 4°C overnight with rocking
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗**: 用封闭液稀释（通常 1:500–1:2000）。4°C 摇孵过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: TBST 3×10 min with rocking. Use generous volume (>10 mL per wash)
detailedSteps.zh: **洗膜**: TBST 3×10 min 摇洗。用量要足（每次 >10 mL）

detailedSteps.en: **Secondary antibody**: HRP-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit IgG, dilute 1:5000–1:10,000 in blocking buffer. 1 h RT
detailedSteps.zh: **二抗**: HRP 标记的抗鼠/兔 IgG，封闭液 1:5000–1:10,000 稀释。室温 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: TBST 3×10 min. Final wash with TBS (no Tween) 1×5 min
detailedSteps.zh: **洗膜**: TBST 3×10 min。最后用 TBS（不含 Tween）洗 1×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Detection**: Mix ECL components 1:1, apply to membrane, incubate 1–5 min. Image on ChemiDoc or expose to film
detailedSteps.zh: **检测**: ECL 等比混合，涂于膜上，孵育 1–5 min。用化学发光成像仪或胶片曝光

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: Quantify band intensity with ImageJ/Image Lab. Normalize to loading control (β-actin, GAPDH, or total protein)
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: 用 ImageJ/Image Lab 定量条带灰度。以 loading control（β-actin、GAPDH 或总蛋白）归一化

note.en: Lysate can be stored at -80°C for months
note.zh: 裂解液可 -80°C 保存数月

note.en: Membrane can be stored dry at -20°C or in TBST at 4°C overnight
note.zh: 膜可 -20°C 干燥保存或 4°C TBST 中过夜

note.en: Can incubate overnight at 4°C (recommended for many antibodies)
note.zh: 可 4°C 过夜孵育（推荐用于多数抗体）

name: Immunofluorescence (IF) Protocol

components.name: 7. 封闭 (3% BSA + 5% serum) 1 h RT
8. 一抗 (稀释于封闭液) 4°C 过夜
10. 荧光二抗 1 h RT 避光

notes.en: Secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647. Protect from light. Tissue sections require antigen retrieval (heat-induced or enzymatic). Confocal: recommend 63× oil immersion.
notes.zh: 二抗选择: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647 等。避光操作。组织切片需抗原修复 (热修复或酶消化)。共聚焦推荐 63× oil 物镜。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1; Im et al. (2019) STAR Protoc 1:100023; CSH Protocols

usage.en: Visualize protein localization and expression in fixed cells using fluorescent antibodies. Compatible with confocal, epifluorescence, and super-resolution microscopy.
usage.zh: 用荧光抗体观察固定细胞中蛋白的定位和表达。兼容共聚焦、落射荧光和超分辨率显微镜。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 当天完成（~5h + 过夜）

briefSteps.en: Culture on coverslips → fix (PFA) → permeabilize → block → primary Ab O/N → wash → fluorescent secondary 1h → DAPI → mount
briefSteps.zh: 盖玻片培养 → 固定 (PFA) → 透化 → 封闭 → 一抗过夜 → 洗 → 荧光二抗 1h → DAPI → 封片

detailedSteps.en: **Cell preparation**: Seed cells on sterile coverslips in 24-well plate (or chamber slides). Culture to 50–70% confluency
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞准备**: 将无菌盖玻片放入 24 孔板（或使用 chamber slides）。培养至 50–70% 汇合度

detailedSteps.en: For suspension cells: use poly-L-lysine coated coverslips or cytospin onto slides
detailedSteps.zh: 悬浮细胞：使用多聚赖氨酸包被的盖玻片或 cytospin 到载玻片上

detailedSteps.en: **Fixation**: Aspirate media, wash 2× with RT PBS (gentle!). Add 4% PFA, 15 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **固定**: 吸除培养基，室温 PBS 轻柔洗 2 次。加 4% PFA，室温固定 15 min

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Do NOT fix >20 min — over-fixation masks epitopes. For some antigens, try ice-cold methanol 10 min instead
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 不要固定 >20 min——过度固定会遮蔽表位。某些抗原可改用冰冷甲醇固定 10 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Permeabilization**: 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 / PBS, 10 min RT. (Membrane proteins: skip this step or use 0.05%)
detailedSteps.zh: **透化**: 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 / PBS，室温 10 min（膜蛋白：跳过此步或用 0.05%）

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Blocking**: 3% BSA + 5% normal serum (same species as secondary Ab) in PBS-T, 1 h RT
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 3% BSA + 5% 正常血清（与二抗同种属）溶于 PBS-T，室温 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Primary antibody**: Dilute in blocking buffer (typically 1:50–1:500). Apply 200 µL per coverslip. 4°C overnight in humidified chamber
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗**: 用封闭液稀释（通常 1:50–1:500）。每片加 200 µL。4°C 湿盒过夜

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Lay parafilm in dish + wet paper towel to make humidity chamber. Place coverslips cell-side DOWN on antibody drops
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 用保鲜膜铺在培养皿中 + 湿纸巾做湿盒。盖玻片细胞面朝下放在抗体液滴上

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS (from here on, protect from light!)
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min（从此步起避光操作！）

detailedSteps.en: **Secondary antibody**: Fluorescent-conjugated (Alexa Fluor 488/555/647), 1:200–1:1000 in blocking buffer, 1 h RT dark
detailedSteps.zh: **荧光二抗**: Alexa Fluor 488/555/647 等，封闭液 1:200–1:1000 稀释，室温避光 1 h

detailedSteps.en: Wash 3×5 min PBS
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3×5 min

detailedSteps.en: **DAPI**: 1 µg/mL in PBS, 5 min RT. Wash 2× PBS
detailedSteps.zh: **DAPI 染核**: 1 µg/mL PBS 溶液，室温 5 min。PBS 洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: **Mount**: Add small drop of mounting medium on slide. Place coverslip cell-side down. Avoid bubbles. Seal edges with nail polish
detailedSteps.zh: **封片**: 在载玻片上滴少量封片剂。盖玻片细胞面朝下放置。避免气泡。指甲油封边

detailedSteps.en: Let cure 24 h at RT (or 4°C overnight). Image within 1 week for best signal
detailedSteps.zh: 室温固化 24 h（或 4°C 过夜）。1 周内成像信号最佳

name: ChIP Protocol (Chromatin IP)

components.name: 1. 交联: 1% 甲醛 10 min RT
3. 冷 PBS 洗 2×, 收细胞
5. 超声 (200–500 bp 片段)
components.note: Bioruptor: 30s on/30s off, 15–25 cycles, high; 探针超声: 10s pulse × 10, 30% amplitude; 需对每种细胞系优化

components.name: 8. 加抗体 + Protein A/G beads 4°C 过夜
11. 解交联: 65°C 过夜 + Proteinase K

notes.en: Optimize sonication conditions for each cell line. Positive control: H3 antibody; negative: IgG. Recommend ≥1×10⁶ cells. Express results as % Input or Fold Enrichment.
notes.zh: 超声条件需针对不同细胞系优化。阳性对照: H3 抗体；阴性对照: IgG。建议每次至少 1×10⁶ 细胞。结果用 % Input 或 Fold Enrichment 表示。

ref: Nelson et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:179–185; Collas (2010) Mol Biotechnol 45:87–100; Haring et al. (2007) Plant Methods 3:11

usage.en: Map protein-DNA interactions genome-wide. Identifies transcription factor binding sites and histone modifications. Combine with qPCR or sequencing (ChIP-seq).
usage.zh: 全基因组水平检测蛋白-DNA 相互作用。鉴定转录因子结合位点和组蛋白修饰。可结合 qPCR 或测序（ChIP-seq）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3 天实验

briefSteps.en: Crosslink → lyse → sonicate → IP with antibody+beads → wash → elute → reverse crosslink → purify DNA → qPCR/seq
briefSteps.zh: 交联 → 裂解 → 超声 → 抗体+磁珠 IP → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → 解交联 → 纯化 DNA → qPCR/测序

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Crosslinking & Sonication**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 交联与超声**

detailedSteps.en: **Crosslink**: Add 37% formaldehyde directly to culture media to 1% final (270 µL per 10 mL media). Rock 10 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **交联**: 向培养基中直接加入 37% 甲醛至终浓度 1%（每 10 mL 培养基加 270 µL）。室温摇 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Quench**: Add 2.5 M glycine to 125 mM final. Rock 5 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: **终止**: 加 2.5 M 甘氨酸至终浓度 125 mM。室温摇 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× cold PBS. Scrape cells in PBS + protease inhibitors. Pellet 800×g 5 min 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 冷 PBS 洗 2 次。PBS + 蛋白酶抑制剂中刮下细胞。4°C 800×g 离心 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Resuspend pellet in SDS Lysis Buffer (200 µL per 1×10⁶ cells). Incubate ice 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 用 SDS Lysis Buffer 重悬沉淀（每 1×10⁶ 细胞 200 µL）。冰上 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Sonication**: Shear chromatin to 200–500 bp. ⚠️ Must optimize! (e.g., Bioruptor: 30s on/30s off, 15–25 cycles)
detailedSteps.zh: **超声**: 将染色质剪切至 200–500 bp。⚠️ 必须优化条件！（如 Bioruptor: 30s 开/30s 关，15–25 个循环）

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Check shearing: take 10 µL aliquot, reverse crosslink (65°C + Proteinase K), run on 1.5% agarose gel
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 检查剪切效果：取 10 µL，解交联（65°C + Proteinase K），跑 1.5% 琼脂糖凝胶

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 14,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant (= sheared chromatin)
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 14,000×g 离心 10 min。取上清（= 剪切后染色质）

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute**: Add 9 volumes ChIP Dilution Buffer (reduces SDS from 1% to 0.1%)
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释**: 加 9 倍体积 ChIP Dilution Buffer（将 SDS 从 1% 降至 0.1%）

detailedSteps.en: **Save Input**: Remove 1–10% as "Input" control → store at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: **留 Input**: 取 1–10% 作为 Input 对照 → -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1–2 — Immunoprecipitation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1–2 天 — 免疫沉淀**

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-clear** (optional): Add 20 µL protein A/G beads, rotate 1 h at 4°C. Remove beads
detailedSteps.zh: **预清除**（可选）：加 20 µL protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转 1 h。去除磁珠

detailedSteps.en: Add antibody (2–5 µg) + 30 µL protein A/G beads. Rotate overnight at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 加抗体（2–5 µg）+ 30 µL protein A/G 磁珠。4°C 旋转过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2–3 — Washes & Elution**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2–3 天 — 洗涤与洗脱**

detailedSteps.en: Wash sequentially (each 3–5 min, 4°C, rotation): Low-salt → High-salt → LiCl wash → 2× TE buffer
detailedSteps.zh: 依次洗涤（每次 3–5 min, 4°C 旋转）：低盐 → 高盐 → LiCl 洗 → 2× TE 缓冲液

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Add 250 µL elution buffer (1% SDS + 0.1 M NaHCO₃), vortex 15 min RT. Repeat. Pool eluates (500 µL total)
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 加 250 µL 洗脱液（1% SDS + 0.1 M NaHCO₃），室温涡旋 15 min。重复一次。合并洗脱液（共 500 µL）

detailedSteps.en: **Reverse crosslink**: Add NaCl to 200 mM final. Incubate 65°C overnight (or 65°C 4h). Also reverse-crosslink Input
detailedSteps.zh: **解交联**: 加 NaCl 至终浓度 200 mM。65°C 过夜（或 65°C 4h）。Input 同时解交联

detailedSteps.en: Add Proteinase K (20 µg/mL), 45°C, 1 h. Add RNase A, 37°C, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 加 Proteinase K（20 µg/mL），45°C 1 h。加 RNase A，37°C 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Purify DNA**: Phenol-chloroform extraction or column purification (MinElute). Elute in 30 µL TE
detailedSteps.zh: **纯化 DNA**: 酚-氯仿抽提或柱纯化（MinElute）。30 µL TE 洗脱

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: qPCR (% Input method) or library prep for ChIP-seq
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: qPCR（% Input 法）或建库做 ChIP-seq

note.en: Sheared chromatin can be stored at -80°C for weeks
note.zh: 剪切后染色质可 -80°C 保存数周

name: Co-IP Protocol

components.name: 1. 裂解 (IP Lysis Buffer, 冰上 30 min)
4. 预清除: Protein A/G beads 1 h 4°C
5. 加目标抗体 (1–5 µg) 4°C 过夜
8. 加 2× Loading Buffer 煮沸洗脱
9. WB 检测 bait + prey 蛋白

notes.en: Negative control: matched isotype IgG. Do not use RIPA (SDS disrupts protein interactions). Adjust NP-40 concentration to interaction strength (0.1–1%). Recommend ≥500 µg total protein.
notes.zh: 阴性对照: 同种属 IgG。勿用 RIPA (SDS 会破坏互作)。裂解液中 NP-40 浓度根据互作强度调整 (0.1–1%)。建议每样 500 µg–2 mg 蛋白。

ref: Miernyk & Thelen (2008) Plant J 55:415–425; Kaboord & Bhatt (2008) Methods Mol Biol 424:349–364

usage.en: Detect protein-protein interactions in native conditions. Pull down a "bait" protein with its antibody and detect co-precipitated "prey" proteins by WB.
usage.zh: 在天然条件下检测蛋白-蛋白相互作用。用抗体沉淀"诱饵"蛋白，通过 WB 检测共沉淀的"猎物"蛋白。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 天实验

briefSteps.en: Lyse (mild buffer) → quantify → pre-clear → add Ab overnight → beads → wash → elute → WB for bait+prey
briefSteps.zh: 温和裂解 → 定量 → 预清除 → 加抗体过夜 → 磁珠 → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → WB 检测 bait+prey

detailedSteps.en: **Lysis**: Wash cells 1× cold PBS. Add IP Lysis Buffer (500 µL per 10-cm dish). ⚠️ Do NOT use RIPA — SDS disrupts interactions!
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 冷 PBS 洗 1 次。加 IP Lysis Buffer（10 cm 皿每皿 500 µL）。⚠️ 不要用 RIPA——SDS 会破坏蛋白互作！

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice 30 min with occasional vortexing. Centrifuge 14,000×g, 15 min, 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上裂解 30 min，偶尔涡旋。4°C 14,000×g 离心 15 min

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify**: BCA assay. Use 500 µg – 2 mg total protein per IP. Save 5–10% as Input
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: BCA 法。每次 IP 用 500 µg – 2 mg 总蛋白。留 5–10% 做 Input

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-clear**: Add 20 µL protein A/G beads, rotate 1 h at 4°C. Remove beads (reduces non-specific binding)
detailedSteps.zh: **预清除**: 加 20 µL protein A/G 磁珠，4°C 旋转 1 h。去除磁珠（减少非特异结合）

detailedSteps.en: **IP**: Add 1–5 µg target antibody. In parallel, set up IgG control with same amount of normal IgG. Rotate overnight 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: **IP**: 加 1–5 µg 目标抗体。同时设 IgG 对照（同量正常 IgG）。4°C 旋转过夜

detailedSteps.en: Add 30–50 µL protein A/G beads. Rotate 2–4 h at 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: 加 30–50 µL protein A/G 磁珠。4°C 旋转 2–4 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: 4–6× with cold IP Lysis Buffer. Each wash: add 500 µL, rotate 5 min 4°C, pellet beads
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 冷 IP Lysis Buffer 洗 4–6 次。每次：加 500 µL，4°C 旋转 5 min，收集磁珠

detailedSteps.en: 💡 For weak interactions: reduce washes to 3× and use gentler buffer (0.1% NP-40)
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 弱相互作用：减少洗涤至 3 次，使用更温和的缓冲液（0.1% NP-40）

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Add 40 µL 2× Laemmli buffer to beads. Boil 95°C 5 min. Collect supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 向磁珠加 40 µL 2× Laemmli buffer。95°C 煮沸 5 min。收集上清

detailedSteps.en: **WB**: Load IP eluate, IgG control, and Input. Probe for both bait and prey proteins
detailedSteps.zh: **WB 检测**: 上样 IP 洗脱液、IgG 对照和 Input。分别检测 bait 和 prey 蛋白

name: RT-qPCR Protocol
nameCn: 实时荧光定量 PCR 流程

notes.en: Reference genes: GAPDH / ACTB / 18S rRNA. Analysis: 2^(−ΔΔCt) method. ≥3 technical replicates, ≥3 biological replicates. Primer efficiency should be 90–110%.
notes.zh: 内参基因: GAPDH / ACTB / 18S rRNA。分析: 2^(-ΔΔCt) 法。技术重复 ≥3，生物学重复 ≥3。引物效率应在 90–110%。NTC (no template control) 必需。

ref: Bustin et al. (2009) Clin Chem 55:611–622 (MIQE Guidelines); Livak & Schmittgen (2001) Methods 25:402–408

usage.en: Quantify gene expression at mRNA level. Combines reverse transcription with real-time PCR. Gold standard for validating RNA-seq hits. Requires proper controls and MIQE compliance.
usage.zh: 在 mRNA 水平定量基因表达。结合逆转录和实时 PCR。验证 RNA-seq 结果的金标准。需要适当对照并符合 MIQE 规范。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1 天实验（RNA 提取后）

briefSteps.en: Extract RNA → DNase → RT → dilute cDNA → qPCR (SYBR) → melt curve → analyze by 2^(-ΔΔCt)
briefSteps.zh: RNA 提取 → DNase → 反转录 → 稀释 cDNA → qPCR (SYBR) → 溶解曲线 → 2^(-ΔΔCt) 分析

detailedSteps.en: **RNA quality check**: Measure A260/280 (should be ~2.0). A260/230 >1.7. Optionally check on agarose gel (28S:18S ~2:1)
**DNase treatment** (recommended): Use TURBO DNase or on-column DNase. Heat-inactivate 75°C 5 min or use DNase removal reagent
detailedSteps.zh: **DNase 处理**（推荐）：用 TURBO DNase 或柱上 DNase。75°C 5 min 热灭活或用 DNase 去除试剂

detailedSteps.en: **Reverse transcription**: Use 500 ng–2 µg RNA per 20 µL reaction. Use oligo-dT + random hexamer mix for best coverage
detailedSteps.zh: **反转录**: 每 20 µL 反应体系用 500 ng–2 µg RNA。Oligo-dT + 随机六聚体混合引物效果最好

detailedSteps.en: RT program: 25°C 5 min → 42–50°C 30–60 min → 85°C 5 min (inactivation). Store cDNA at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: RT 程序：25°C 5 min → 42–50°C 30–60 min → 85°C 5 min（灭活）。cDNA -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute cDNA**: 1:5 to 1:20 with nuclease-free H₂O (typically 1:10). Include –RT control (no reverse transcriptase)
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释 cDNA**: 用无核酸酶水 1:5 至 1:20 稀释（通常 1:10）。设置 –RT 对照（不加逆转录酶）

detailedSteps.en: **qPCR setup (20 µL)**: 10 µL 2× SYBR Master Mix + 0.4 µL Fw primer (10 µM) + 0.4 µL Rv primer (10 µM) + 2 µL cDNA + 7.2 µL H₂O
detailedSteps.zh: **qPCR 体系 (20 µL)**: 10 µL 2× SYBR Master Mix + 0.4 µL Fw 引物 (10 µM) + 0.4 µL Rv 引物 (10 µM) + 2 µL cDNA + 7.2 µL H₂O

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Set up on ice. Include NTC (no template control) for every primer pair. Technical replicates ≥3
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 冰上操作。每对引物设 NTC（无模板对照）。技术重复 ≥3

detailedSteps.en: **Cycling**: 95°C 10 min (polymerase activation) → [95°C 15 s → 60°C 60 s] × 40 cycles → Melt curve: 60°C→95°C
**Melt curve analysis**: Single peak = specific product ✓. Multiple peaks = non-specific or primer dimers ✗
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解曲线分析**: 单峰 = 特异性产物 ✓。多峰 = 非特异或引物二聚体 ✗

detailedSteps.en: **Primer efficiency**: Make 5-point serial dilution of cDNA (1:4). Plot Ct vs log(dilution). Slope should be -3.2 to -3.5 (efficiency 90–110%)
detailedSteps.zh: **引物效率**: 做 5 点 cDNA 梯度稀释（1:4）。Ct vs log(稀释) 作图。斜率应为 -3.2 ~ -3.5（效率 90–110%）

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: ΔCt = Ct(target) – Ct(reference). ΔΔCt = ΔCt(treated) – ΔCt(control). Fold change = 2^(-ΔΔCt)
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: ΔCt = Ct(目标) – Ct(内参)。ΔΔCt = ΔCt(处理组) – ΔCt(对照组)。倍数变化 = 2^(-ΔΔCt)

detailedSteps.en: Bio reps ≥3. Stats: t-test on ΔCt values (NOT fold changes). Report as mean ± SEM
detailedSteps.zh: 生物学重复 ≥3。统计：对 ΔCt 值做 t 检验（不是倍数变化）。报告 mean ± SEM

note.zh: 参见 TRIzol 提取方案

note.en: cDNA can be stored at -20°C for months

name: Lipofection Transfection Protocol

components.name: 1. 转染前一天铺板 (60–80% 汇合度)
2. 管 A: 质粒 DNA in Opti-MEM
6. 6–8 h 后换新鲜完全培养基

notes.en: siRNA: 25–50 pmol per well + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX. Switching to serum-free medium before transfection improves efficiency.
notes.zh: siRNA 转染: 每孔 25–50 pmol siRNA + 5 µL Lipo RNAiMAX。转染前换无血清培养基效果更好。DNA:Lipo 比例需优化 (1:2–1:4)。

ref: Dalby et al. (2004) Methods 33:95–103; Bhatt et al. (2012) Methods Mol Biol 869:29–40; Thermo Fisher Lipofectamine Protocol

usage.en: Deliver plasmid DNA or siRNA/miRNA into mammalian cells using cationic lipid reagents. Transient expression peaks 24–72h. For stable expression, add selection antibiotics.
usage.zh: 利用阳离子脂质试剂将质粒 DNA 或 siRNA/miRNA 导入哺乳动物细胞。瞬时表达高峰 24–72h。稳定表达需加筛选抗生素。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1h 操作 + 24–72h 表达

briefSteps.en: Plate cells → mix DNA/Opti-MEM (tube A) → mix Lipo/Opti-MEM (tube B) → combine A+B → add to cells → replace media 6h → harvest 24–72h
briefSteps.zh: 铺板 → DNA/Opti-MEM 混合(管A) → Lipo/Opti-MEM 混合(管B) → A+B 混合 → 加入细胞 → 6h 换液 → 24–72h 收样

detailedSteps.en: **Day before**: Plate cells to reach 60–80% confluency at transfection. Do NOT use antibiotics in plating media
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 铺板使转染时达到 60–80% 汇合度。铺板培养基不要加抗生素

detailedSteps.en: 💡 Cell density matters: too sparse = toxicity; too confluent = low efficiency. Optimize for each cell line
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 细胞密度很关键：太稀 = 毒性大；太密 = 效率低。每个细胞系需优化

detailedSteps.en: **Tube A — DNA mix**: For each well of 6-well plate: 2.5 µg DNA + 125 µL Opti-MEM. Mix gently
detailedSteps.zh: **管 A — DNA 混合**: 6 孔板每孔：2.5 µg DNA + 125 µL Opti-MEM。轻柔混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Tube B — Lipid mix**: 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000 (or 3.75 µL Lipo 3000 + 5 µL P3000) + 125 µL Opti-MEM
detailedSteps.zh: **管 B — 脂质混合**: 7.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000（或 3.75 µL Lipo 3000 + 5 µL P3000）+ 125 µL Opti-MEM

detailedSteps.en: Incubate each tube 5 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: 各管室温孵育 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Combine**: Add tube A into tube B (NOT the reverse). Mix gently. Incubate 15–20 min RT. Solution may become slightly cloudy
detailedSteps.zh: **混合**: 将管 A 加入管 B（不要反过来）。轻柔混匀。室温 15–20 min。溶液可能会轻微浑浊

detailedSteps.en: Add complex dropwise to cells. Rock plate gently to distribute
detailedSteps.zh: 将复合物逐滴加入细胞。轻摇培养板使其均匀分布

detailedSteps.en: **Replace media**: After 6–8 h, replace with fresh complete media (with serum, optional antibiotics)
detailedSteps.zh: **换液**: 6–8 h 后换新鲜完全培养基（含血清，可选抗生素）

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Check expression at 24 h (reporter), 48 h (protein), or 72 h (maximum protein accumulation)
detailedSteps.zh: **收样**: 24 h 检查表达（报告基因），48 h（蛋白），72 h（蛋白积累最大化）

detailedSteps.en: 💡 **siRNA transfection**: Use Lipofectamine RNAiMAX instead. 25–50 pmol siRNA per 6-well. Knockdown peaks at 48–72 h
detailedSteps.zh: 💡 **siRNA 转染**: 改用 Lipofectamine RNAiMAX。6 孔板每孔 25–50 pmol siRNA。敲低高峰在 48–72 h

note.zh: 无血清培养基，用于复合物形成

name: Flow Cytometry Surface Staining
nameCn: 流式细胞术表面染色流程

components.name: 3. Fc Block (人: Human TruStain; 鼠: anti-CD16/32)

notes.en: For intracellular staining: fix with 4% PFA 20 min, then permeabilize with 0.1% saponin. Titrate each antibody individually. Compensation controls required.
notes.zh: 胞内染色需先固定 (4% PFA 20 min) 再透化 (0.1% saponin)。每个抗体需单独滴度实验。compensation controls 必需。FMO controls 用于 gating。

ref: Cossarizza et al. (2019) Eur J Immunol 49:1457–1973; Perfetto et al. (2004) Nat Rev Immunol 4:648–655

usage.en: Analyze protein expression on individual cells by fluorescent antibody staining. Enables multi-parameter phenotyping, cell counting, and sorting (FACS).
usage.zh: 通过荧光抗体染色分析单个细胞的蛋白表达。支持多参数表型分析、细胞计数和分选（FACS）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 3 小时

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Fc block → surface Ab stain 4°C 30min → wash → (fix → perm → intracellular stain) → viability dye → acquire ≥10K events
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞 → Fc 封闭 → 表面抗体 4°C 30min → 洗 → (固定 → 透化 → 胞内染色) → 活死染料 → 采集 ≥1 万事件

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Collect cells (trypsinize adherent cells gently, or collect suspension). Count. Use ≥1×10⁵ cells per tube
detailedSteps.zh: **收集**: 收集细胞（贴壁细胞轻柔消化，悬浮细胞直接收集）。计数。每管 ≥1×10⁵ 细胞

detailedSteps.en: Wash 1× PBS (300×g, 5 min). Resuspend in 100 µL FACS buffer
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 洗 1 次（300×g，5 min）。重悬于 100 µL FACS buffer

detailedSteps.en: **Fc Block**: Add Fc receptor blocking reagent. Incubate 4°C 10 min. Do NOT wash
detailedSteps.zh: **Fc 封闭**: 加 Fc 受体封闭试剂。4°C 10 min。不洗

detailedSteps.en: **Surface staining**: Add fluorescent antibodies at titrated amounts. Incubate 4°C 20–30 min in the dark
detailedSteps.zh: **表面染色**: 按滴定量加入荧光抗体。4°C 避光孵育 20–30 min

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ Antibody titration is ESSENTIAL: test 2-fold dilutions from manufacturer's recommendation to find the amount that gives best separation
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 抗体滴定是必须的：从厂商推荐量开始做 2 倍梯度稀释，找到分离度最佳的用量

detailedSteps.en: Wash 2× with 1 mL FACS buffer (300×g, 5 min)
detailedSteps.zh: 1 mL FACS buffer 洗 2 次（300×g, 5 min）

detailedSteps.en: **For surface staining only**: Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer + viability dye. Go to acquisition
detailedSteps.zh: **仅表面染色**: 重悬于 200–500 µL FACS buffer + 活死染料。直接上机

detailedSteps.en: **For intracellular staining** (optional):
detailedSteps.zh: **胞内染色**（可选）:

detailedSteps.en: Fix: 4% PFA 20 min RT. Wash 2× PBS
detailedSteps.zh: 固定：4% PFA 室温 20 min。PBS 洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: Permeabilize: 0.1% saponin or commercial Perm buffer, 15 min RT
detailedSteps.zh: 透化：0.1% 皂苷或商品化 Perm buffer，室温 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Stain intracellular targets in Perm buffer. 30 min RT dark. Wash 2×
detailedSteps.zh: 在 Perm buffer 中染胞内靶标。室温避光 30 min。洗 2 次

detailedSteps.en: **Acquisition**: Resuspend in 200–500 µL FACS buffer. Acquire on flow cytometer
detailedSteps.zh: **上机**: 重悬于 200–500 µL FACS buffer。上流式细胞仪

detailedSteps.en: Acquire ≥10,000 events in live cell gate. For rare populations, acquire ≥100,000
detailedSteps.zh: 在活细胞门中采集 ≥10,000 个事件。稀有细胞群需采集 ≥100,000

detailedSteps.en: **Controls needed**: Unstained, single-stain (for compensation), FMO (for gating), isotype (optional)
detailedSteps.zh: **所需对照**: 未染色、单染（补偿用）、FMO（门控用）、同型对照（可选）

note.zh: Human TruStain FcX / 小鼠 anti-CD16/32
每个抗体需先单独做滴度实验！
DAPI、PI 或可固定 Live/Dead 染料

note.en: Fixed cells can be stored at 4°C for up to a week
note.zh: 固定后的细胞可 4°C 保存最多一周

name: MOPS SDS Running Buffer (NuPAGE)

notes.en: Can be stored as 20× concentrate. Dilute to 1× before use. Optimized for NuPAGE Bis-Tris gels; better resolution for mid-to-high MW proteins (>30 kDa) than MES buffer. Do not adjust pH.
notes.zh: 20× 浓缩液可储存，使用前稀释至 1×。适用于 NuPAGE Bis-Tris 凝胶，分离中-大分子量蛋白 (>30 kDa) 效果优于 MES。不需调 pH。

ref: Invitrogen NuPAGE Technical Guide (Thermo Fisher MAN0003690); Schägger (2006) Nat Protoc 1:16–22

usage.en: NuPAGE MOPS running buffer for Bis-Tris gels. Best for mid-to-high MW proteins (30–200 kDa). Sharper bands than Tris-glycine for proteins >100 kDa.
usage.zh: NuPAGE MOPS 电泳缓冲液，配合 Bis-Tris 凝胶。最适合中-高分子量蛋白 (30–200 kDa)。>100 kDa 蛋白条带比 Tris-glycine 系统更锐利。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月 (20× 储备液)

prepSteps.en: Weigh MOPS, Tris base, SDS, EDTA
prepSteps.zh: 称取 MOPS、Tris base、SDS、EDTA

prepSteps.en: Dissolve in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O. Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O。不需调 pH

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL} for 1× working solution
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL} 得 1× 工作液

prepSteps.en: For 20× stock: multiply all amounts by 20, dissolve in {v:1:L}
prepSteps.zh: 配 20× 浓缩液: 所有量 ×20，溶于 {v:1:L}

name: Colony PCR Protocol

components.name: 1. 挑取单克隆至 PCR 管 (牙签/枪头)

notes.en: Initial 5 min denaturation at 95°C lyses bacteria to release template DNA. Use M13 universal primers (for pUC vectors) or gene-specific primers. Positive clones should be sequence-verified. Streak colonies onto a master plate in parallel.
notes.zh: 初始变性 5 min 用于裂解菌体释放模板。引物可用 M13 通用引物 (pUC 系列) 或基因特异引物。阳性克隆应送测序验证。同时划线保存菌落至新 LB 平板。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.; Bergkessel & Guthrie (2013) Methods Enzymol 529:141–149

usage.en: Screen bacterial colonies for correct insert after transformation. Faster than miniprep + restriction digest. Screen 8–16 colonies per construct.
usage.zh: 转化后筛选含正确插入片段的菌落。比提质粒 + 酶切更快。每个构建体筛选 8–16 个菌落。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 2h

briefSteps.en: Set up PCR mix (25 µL): master mix + primers + water → pick colony with tip → dip in PCR tube → streak on replica plate → PCR: 95°C 10 min → 30 cycles → agarose gel → sequence positives
briefSteps.zh: 配 PCR 体系 (25 µL): master mix + 引物 + 水 → 枪头挑菌落 → 蘸入 PCR 管 → 划线到备份板 → PCR: 95°C 10 min → 30 个循环 → 琼脂糖凝胶 → 阳性送测序

detailedSteps.en: Prepare PCR master mix in a 1.5 mL tube: 12.5 µL 2× Taq mix, 1 µL each primer (10 µM), 10.5 µL water per reaction. Make N+1 reactions
detailedSteps.zh: 在 1.5 mL 管中配 PCR 体系：12.5 µL 2× Taq mix，各 1 µL 引物（10 µM），10.5 µL 水/反应。配 N+1 个反应

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 25 µL into each PCR tube. Label tubes to match colony numbers
detailedSteps.zh: 每管分装 25 µL，标记与菌落编号对应

detailedSteps.en: Using a sterile pipette tip or toothpick, touch a single colony lightly
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌枪头或牙签轻触单个菌落

detailedSteps.en: Dip the tip into the PCR tube and swirl briefly to release cells
detailedSteps.zh: 将枪头在 PCR 管中轻轻搅动释放细菌

detailedSteps.en: (Recommended) Streak the same tip onto a fresh replica plate. Label to match
detailedSteps.zh: （推荐）用同一枪头在备份平板上划线，标记编号

detailedSteps.en: Incubate replica plate at 37°C while PCR runs
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 运行时将备份板 37°C 培养

detailedSteps.en: Include negative control (no colony) and positive control (known template) if available
detailedSteps.zh: 设阴性对照（无菌落）和阳性对照（已知模板，如有）

detailedSteps.en: Run PCR: 95°C 10 min (lyses cells) → (95°C 30s, 55°C 30s, 72°C 1 min/kb) × 30 → 72°C 5 min → hold 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 程序: 95°C 10 min (裂解细菌) → (95°C 30s, 55°C 30s, 72°C 1 min/kb) × 30 → 72°C 5 min → 4°C 保持

detailedSteps.en: Add 5 µL of 6× loading dye to each 25 µL reaction
detailedSteps.zh: 每管加 5 µL 6× loading dye

detailedSteps.en: Run on 1% agarose gel alongside DNA ladder. Image: positive clones show band at expected insert size
detailedSteps.zh: 1% 琼脂糖凝胶电泳，加 DNA ladder。成像：阳性克隆在预期插入片段大小处有条带

detailedSteps.en: Inoculate 2–3 positive clones from replica plate into LB + antibiotic overnight, miniprep, and sequence-verify
detailedSteps.zh: 从备份板挑 2–3 个阳性克隆，接种到 LB + 抗生素过夜培养，提质粒，送测序验证

note.zh: M13 通用引物或基因特异引物
M13 通用引物或基因特异引物

name: Bacterial Glycerol Stock

notes.en: Mix gently by inversion (do not vortex). Label tube with strain name, plasmid, resistance marker, and date. Snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen or dry ice, store at −80°C. To recover, streak directly onto selective plate from frozen stock. Never freeze-thaw. Final glycerol concentration of 15–25% is acceptable.
notes.zh: 轻柔混匀 (不要涡旋)。标记菌株名、质粒、抗性、日期。速冻于液氮或干冰，-80°C 长期保存。复苏时直接划线至含抗生素 LB 平板，切勿反复冻融。终甘油浓度 15–25% 均可。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: Long-term preservation of bacterial strains at -80°C. Glycerol prevents ice crystal formation that would kill cells. Essential for maintaining strain collections.
usage.zh: 细菌菌株 -80°C 长期保存。甘油防止冰晶形成杀死细胞。维护菌种库的必备操作。

label.zh: -80°C, 数年 (切勿反复冻融)

prepSteps.en: Grow bacteria to stationary phase (O/N culture)
prepSteps.zh: 培养细菌至稳定期（过夜培养）

prepSteps.en: Mix 750 µL culture + 250 µL sterile 60% glycerol (final ~15%)
prepSteps.zh: 750 µL 菌液 + 250 µL 无菌 60% 甘油（终浓度 ~15%）

prepSteps.en: Mix gently by inversion. Do NOT vortex
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔颠倒混匀。不要涡旋

prepSteps.en: Label tube (strain, plasmid, resistance, date). Snap-freeze in liquid N₂
prepSteps.zh: 标记管子（菌株、质粒、抗性、日期）。液氮速冻

prepSteps.en: Store at -80°C. To recover: streak directly onto selective plate from frozen stock
prepSteps.zh: -80°C 保存。复苏时：直接从冻存管划线至选择性平板

name: 6× DNA Loading Dye

notes.en: Aliquot and store at −20°C; stable at 4°C for months. Mix 1:5 with sample (1 µL dye + 5 µL sample). Bromophenol blue co-migrates with ~300 bp in 1% agarose; xylene cyanol co-migrates with ~4 kb. Optionally add EDTA (10 mM final) to chelate DNases.
notes.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存，4°C 可存数月。使用时 1:5 混合 (1 µL dye + 5 µL 样品)。Bromophenol Blue 在 1% 琼脂糖中迁移率 ~300 bp，Xylene Cyanol ~4 kb。可选加 EDTA (终浓度 10 mM) 螯合 DNase。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press, Appendix 1

usage.en: 6× loading dye for agarose gel electrophoresis. Adds density (glycerol) so DNA sinks into wells, plus tracking dyes to monitor migration.
usage.zh: 6× 琼脂糖凝胶电泳上样缓冲液。甘油增加密度使 DNA 沉入加样孔，示踪染料监控电泳进程。

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Bromophenol Blue and Xylene Cyanol in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将溴酚蓝和二甲苯青 FF 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add glycerol to 30% final
prepSteps.zh: 加甘油至终浓度 30%

prepSteps.en: Mix well. Aliquot and store at 4°C or -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀。分装后 4°C 或 -20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Use 1 µL per 5 µL DNA sample
prepSteps.zh: 每 5 µL DNA 样品加 1 µL

name: CaCl₂ Competent Cell Preparation
nameCn: CaCl₂ 化学感受态细胞制备

components.name: 1. 过夜培养 DH5α/BL21 → 1:100 接种至 50 mL LB
5. 弃上清，冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ 重悬
8. 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% 甘油 重悬
9. 分装 100 µL/管，液氮速冻，-80°C 保存

notes.en: Keep everything on ice throughout! Typical efficiency: 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg. Overnight incubation at 4°C can improve efficiency. For higher efficiency (>10⁸), use the Inoue method (MnCl₂/CaCl₂).
notes.zh: 全程冰上操作！效率通常 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg。过夜 4°C 孵育可提高效率。如需更高效率 (>10⁸)，使用 Inoue 法 (MnCl₂/CaCl₂)。

ref: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: Prepare chemically competent E. coli cells for heat-shock transformation. Simple and cheap, yields 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg. Sufficient for routine cloning.
usage.zh: 制备化学感受态大肠杆菌用于热激转化。简单便宜，效率 10⁶–10⁷ CFU/µg。足够常规克隆使用。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 4h + 过夜培养

briefSteps.en: Grow to OD 0.3–0.5 → ice 15 min → pellet → resuspend in cold CaCl₂ → ice 30 min → pellet → resuspend in CaCl₂ + glycerol → aliquot → snap-freeze
briefSteps.zh: 培养至 OD 0.3–0.5 → 冰浴 15 min → 离心 → 冷 CaCl₂ 重悬 → 冰浴 30 min → 离心 → CaCl₂ + 甘油重悬 → 分装 → 速冻

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0**: Inoculate single colony into 5 mL LB. Grow O/N at 37°C with shaking
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 挑单克隆接种 5 mL LB。37°C 振荡过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1**: Dilute O/N culture 1:100 into 50 mL fresh LB in 250 mL flask
detailedSteps.zh: **当天**: 过夜菌液 1:100 接种至 250 mL 锥形瓶中 50 mL 新鲜 LB

detailedSteps.en: Grow at 37°C with vigorous shaking until OD₆₀₀ = 0.3–0.5 (~2–3 h). ⚠️ Do NOT overgrow!
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 剧烈振荡至 OD₆₀₀ = 0.3–0.5（约 2–3 h）。⚠️ 不要过度生长！

detailedSteps.en: Transfer to pre-chilled 50 mL tube. Ice 15 min
detailedSteps.zh: 转移至预冷的 50 mL 管。冰浴 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 3000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Decant supernatant completely
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 3000×g 离心 10 min。完全倒掉上清

detailedSteps.en: Gently resuspend pellet in 25 mL ice-cold 100 mM CaCl₂ (pipet gently — do NOT vortex!)
detailedSteps.zh: 用 25 mL 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ 轻柔重悬沉淀（轻柔吹打——不要涡旋！）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴 30 min

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge 3000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Decant carefully
detailedSteps.zh: 4°C 3000×g 离心 10 min。小心倒掉上清

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend in 2.5 mL ice-cold 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% glycerol
detailedSteps.zh: 用 2.5 mL 冰冷 100 mM CaCl₂ + 15% 甘油 轻柔重悬

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 100 µL per pre-chilled 1.5 mL tube. Snap-freeze in liquid N₂. Store -80°C
detailedSteps.zh: 分装 100 µL/预冷管。液氮速冻。-80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Test efficiency**: Transform 1 ng pUC19, plate on LB + Amp. Count colonies next day
detailedSteps.zh: **效率测试**: 转化 1 ng pUC19，涂 LB + Amp 平板。次日计数菌落

name: 2×YT Medium

notes.en: Dissolve in ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH, bring to volume. Autoclave at 121°C for 20 min. Richer than LB (2× yeast extract and tryptone), ideal for phage display and high-density protein expression. Add antibiotics after cooling.
notes.zh: ddH₂O 定容至 1000 mL，调 pH 至 7.0 (NaOH)。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min。比 LB 营养更丰富，适用于噬菌体展示、高密度蛋白表达等。冷却后加抗生素。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed., CSHL Press

usage.en: Nutrient-rich bacterial growth medium, 2× the yeast extract and tryptone of standard LB. Ideal for phage display, high-density protein expression, and M13 phage propagation.
usage.zh: 高营养细菌培养基，酵母提取物和胰蛋白胨含量为标准 LB 的 2 倍。适合噬菌体展示、高密度蛋白表达和 M13 噬菌体扩增。

label.zh: 室温, 3 个月 (高压灭菌后)

prepSteps.en: Dissolve tryptone, yeast extract, and NaCl in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将胰蛋白胨、酵母提取物、NaCl 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with NaOH
prepSteps.zh: 用 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.0

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. Autoclave 121°C 20 min
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min

prepSteps.en: Cool to ~55°C before adding antibiotics
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至 ~55°C 后再加抗生素

name: HEPES Buffer (1 M stock)

notes.en: HEPES maintains pH stability outside the CO₂ incubator, ideal for extended bench work and live imaging.
notes.zh: HEPES 在 CO₂ 培养箱外能维持 pH 稳定，适合长时间台面操作和活细胞成像。

ref: Good et al. (1966) Biochemistry 5:467–477; Sigma-Aldrich HEPES Buffer Protocol

usage.en: 1M HEPES stock for cell culture medium supplementation. Maintains pH 7.2–7.6 in CO₂-free conditions (imaging, bench work). Also used in many biochemical buffers.
usage.zh: 1M HEPES 储备液，用于补充细胞培养基。在无 CO₂ 条件下 (成像、台面操作) 维持 pH 7.2–7.6。也广泛用于各种生化缓冲液。

label.zh: 4°C, 12 个月 (过滤除菌后)

prepSteps.en: Dissolve HEPES in ~{v:80:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 HEPES 溶于约 {v:80:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.2–7.6 with NaOH
prepSteps.zh: 用 NaOH 调 pH 至 7.2–7.6

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:100:mL}
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:100:mL}

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Store at 4°C protected from light
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。4°C 避光保存

prepSteps.en: Add to culture medium at 10–25 mM final concentration
prepSteps.zh: 加入培养基至终浓度 10–25 mM

name: 20× SSC Buffer

notes.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with HCl. Autoclave and store at room temperature. For Southern/Northern blot hybridization use 2×–6× SSC; for stringent washes use 0.1×–0.5× SSC. Also required for in situ hybridization (ISH).
notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.0。高压灭菌后室温保存。杂交 (Southern/Northern blot) 时使用 2×–6× SSC；严格洗膜用 0.1×–0.5× SSC。ISH (原位杂交) 也需要。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8765; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: 20× SSC stock for nucleic acid hybridization (Southern/Northern blot, FISH, ISH). Dilute to various stringencies for wash steps.
usage.zh: 20× SSC 储备液，用于核酸杂交 (Southern/Northern blot, FISH, ISH)。稀释至不同严格度用于洗涤步骤。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月 (高压灭菌后)

prepSteps.en: Dissolve NaCl and sodium citrate in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 NaCl 和柠檬酸钠溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.0 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 7.0

prepSteps.en: Top up to {v:1000:mL}. Autoclave 121°C 20 min
prepSteps.zh: 定容至 {v:1000:mL}。121°C 高压灭菌 20 min

prepSteps.en: Dilute as needed: 6× (hybridization), 2× (mild wash), 0.1× (stringent wash)
prepSteps.zh: 按需稀释: 6×（杂交）、2×（温和洗涤）、0.1×（严格洗涤）

name: Citrate Buffer (Antigen Retrieval)

notes.en: Adjust pH to 6.0 with HCl. Microwave method: submerge slides in buffer, bring to boil then maintain at medium power for 10–20 min. Allow to cool to RT. Can also use pressure cooker or water bath (95–100°C). For FFPE tissue sections.
notes.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 6.0。微波法: 将切片浸入缓冲液，微波加热至沸腾后中低火维持 10–20 min，自然冷却至室温。也可用压力锅或水浴 (95–100°C)。适用于甲醛固定石蜡包埋 (FFPE) 组织。

ref: Shi et al. (1991) J Histochem Cytochem 39:741–748

usage.en: Antigen retrieval buffer for FFPE tissue IHC. Heat-induced epitope retrieval (HIER) unmasks antigens cross-linked during formalin fixation.
usage.zh: 石蜡包埋组织 IHC 的抗原修复液。热诱导表位修复 (HIER) 解除甲醛固定导致的抗原交联。

label.zh: 室温, 3 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve sodium citrate in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将柠檬酸钠溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 6.0 with HCl
prepSteps.zh: 用 HCl 调 pH 至 6.0

prepSteps.en: Add Tween-20 to 0.05%. Top up to {v:1:L}
prepSteps.zh: 加 Tween-20 至 0.05%。定容至 {v:1:L}

prepSteps.en: For retrieval: submerge slides, microwave to boil then medium power 10–20 min
prepSteps.zh: 修复时: 浸没切片，微波煮沸后中火维持 10–20 min

prepSteps.en: Cool to RT in buffer (~20 min). Then proceed to IHC staining
prepSteps.zh: 在缓冲液中自然冷却至室温 (~20 min)。然后进行 IHC 染色

name: Crystal Violet Staining Solution

notes.en: Fix and stain adherent cells: wash with PBS, apply staining solution for 20 min at RT, rinse thoroughly with ddH₂O, air-dry. To quantify: dissolve stain in 10% acetic acid, read absorbance at OD₅₉₅. Used for colony formation assays and biofilm detection.
notes.zh: 固定并染色贴壁细胞: PBS 洗 → 加染色液覆盖 → 室温 20 min → ddH₂O 反复冲洗 → 晾干。定量: 加 10% 冰醋酸溶解结晶紫，OD₅₉₅ 测吸光度。适用于克隆形成实验 (colony formation assay) 和生物膜检测。

ref: Feoktistova et al. (2016) Cold Spring Harb Protoc 2016(4):pdb.prot087379

usage.en: Staining solution for colony formation assays, biofilm quantification, and Gram staining. Crystal violet binds DNA and proteins in fixed cells, producing purple color.
usage.zh: 克隆形成实验、生物膜定量和革兰氏染色用染色液。结晶紫与固定细胞中的 DNA 和蛋白结合，产生紫色。

label.zh: 室温, 12 个月 (密封保存)

prepSteps.en: Dissolve crystal violet in methanol first, then add ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 先将结晶紫溶于甲醇，再加 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix thoroughly. Store in dark bottle
prepSteps.zh: 充分混匀。避光瓶保存

prepSteps.en: For colony assay: fix cells (methanol or PFA) → stain 20 min → wash with water → air dry → photograph or quantify
prepSteps.zh: 克隆形成: 固定细胞 (甲醇或 PFA) → 染色 20 min → 水洗 → 晾干 → 拍照或定量

prepSteps.en: Quantify: dissolve stain in 10% acetic acid, read OD₅₉₅
prepSteps.zh: 定量: 用 10% 冰醋酸溶解染色，测 OD₅₉₅

name: Trypan Blue Cell Counting

components.name: 4. 轻柔混匀，室温 1–2 min (勿超 3 min)
5. 加入血球计数板 / 自动计数仪
6. 计数: 活细胞 (透明) vs 死细胞 (蓝色)

notes.en: Cell density = average cells per large square × dilution factor × 10⁴ cells/mL. Viability = live / (live + dead) × 100%. Staining beyond 3 min causes false positives (live cells begin to take up dye). Dilute further if concentration is too high.
notes.zh: 细胞密度 = 平均每大格细胞数 × 稀释倍数 × 10⁴ cells/mL。活率 = 活细胞/(活+死) × 100%。染色时间 >3 min 会导致假阳性 (活细胞也着色)。如浓度过高，进一步稀释后重新计数。

ref: Strober (2015) Curr Protoc Immunol 111:A.3B.1–A.3B.3

usage.en: Count cells and determine viability before seeding, passaging, or experiments. Dead cells take up trypan blue (blue), live cells exclude it (clear).
usage.zh: 在接种、传代或实验前计数细胞并判断活力。死细胞摄取台盼蓝（蓝色），活细胞排斥（透明）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 5 分钟

briefSteps.en: Prepare single-cell suspension → mix 10 µL cells + 10 µL trypan blue → load 10 µL onto hemocytometer → count 4 corner squares (live = clear, dead = blue) → calculate: cells/mL = (count ÷ 4) × 2 × 10⁴
briefSteps.zh: 制备单细胞悬液 → 10 µL 细胞 + 10 µL 台盼蓝 → 取 10 µL 加入计数板 → 数 4 个角大格（活=透明, 死=蓝色）→ 计算: cells/mL = (计数 ÷ 4) × 2 × 10⁴

detailedSteps.en: Trypsinize adherent cells or resuspend suspension cells. Ensure single-cell suspension (no clumps)
detailedSteps.zh: 消化贴壁细胞或重悬悬浮细胞，确保单细胞悬液（无团块）

detailedSteps.en: Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube. Take a 20 µL aliquot for counting
detailedSteps.zh: 转移到 15 mL 管，取 20 µL 用于计数

detailedSteps.en: Mix 10 µL of cell suspension with 10 µL of 0.4% trypan blue in a microcentrifuge tube
detailedSteps.zh: 在微量离心管中将 10 µL 细胞悬液与 10 µL 0.4% 台盼蓝混匀

detailedSteps.en: Incubate for 1–2 min at RT. Do NOT exceed 5 min (trypan blue becomes toxic to live cells)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温孵育 1–2 分钟。不超过 5 分钟（台盼蓝对活细胞有毒性）

detailedSteps.en: Clean hemocytometer and coverslip with 70% ethanol. Dry completely
detailedSteps.zh: 用 70% 乙醇清洁血球计数板和盖玻片，完全干燥

detailedSteps.en: Place coverslip on hemocytometer. It should adhere by surface tension (Newton rings visible)
detailedSteps.zh: 放置盖玻片，应通过表面张力贴合（可见牛顿环）

detailedSteps.en: Load 10 µL of the trypan blue mixture into one chamber. Let it fill by capillary action
detailedSteps.zh: 取 10 µL 台盼蓝混合物加入一侧计数室，利用毛细作用填充

detailedSteps.en: Place on microscope at 10× magnification
detailedSteps.zh: 放在显微镜下 10× 观察
