detailedSteps.en: Count all four corner squares (each 1 mm × 1 mm). Count live cells (clear/refractile) and dead cells (blue) separately
detailedSteps.zh: 计数四个角大格（每个 1 mm × 1 mm）。分别计数活细胞（透明/折光）和死细胞（蓝色）

detailedSteps.en: Follow convention: count cells touching top and left borders, skip bottom and right
detailedSteps.zh: 规则：计数触碰上线和左线的细胞，不计下线和右线的

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate concentration**: Cells/mL = (total live count ÷ 4 squares) × dilution factor (2) × 10⁴
detailedSteps.zh: **计算浓度**: 细胞/mL = (4 格活细胞总数 ÷ 4) × 稀释倍数 (2) × 10⁴

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate viability**: % viable = (live count ÷ total count) × 100. Should be >90% for healthy cultures
detailedSteps.zh: **计算活率**: 活率% = (活细胞数 ÷ 总细胞数) × 100。健康培养 >90%

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate seeding volume**: Volume (mL) = desired cell count ÷ concentration (cells/mL)
detailedSteps.zh: **计算接种体积**: 体积 (mL) = 所需细胞数 ÷ 浓度 (cells/mL)

name: 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA Solution

notes.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm). Aliquot and store at −20°C; working aliquots at 4°C for up to 2 weeks. Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Optimize digestion time for each cell type (1–5 min). Neutralize with serum-containing medium. EDTA chelates Ca²⁺ to disrupt cell-cell junctions.
notes.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。分装后 -20°C 保存，工作液 4°C (2 周内用完)。使用前预热至 37°C。消化时间需根据细胞类型优化 (1–5 min)。加含血清培养基终止消化。EDTA 螯合 Ca²⁺ 破坏细胞间连接辅助消化。

ref: Freshney (2010) Culture of Animal Cells, 6th ed., Wiley

usage.en: Cell dissociation solution for passaging adherent cells. Trypsin cleaves cell-surface proteins; EDTA chelates Ca²⁺ to disrupt cadherin-mediated adhesion.
usage.zh: 贴壁细胞传代用消化液。胰蛋白酶切割细胞表面蛋白；EDTA 螯合 Ca²⁺ 破坏钙黏蛋白介导的粘附。

label.zh: -20°C 储存, 4°C 工作液 (2 周)

prepSteps.en: Dissolve trypsin and EDTA·4Na in Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺-free PBS
prepSteps.zh: 将胰蛋白酶和 EDTA·4Na 溶于无 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ 的 PBS

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize (0.22 µm)
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 5–10 mL per tube, store -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 5–10 mL/管，-20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Add to washed cells for 1–5 min
prepSteps.zh: 使用前预热至 37°C。加至洗过的细胞上消化 1–5 min

prepSteps.en: Neutralize with equal volume of serum-containing medium
prepSteps.zh: 加等体积含血清培养基中和

name: DEPC-Treated Water

notes.en: Use for RNA work only. Do NOT add DEPC to Tris buffers (reacts with amine groups). Modern alternative: commercial nuclease-free water.
notes.zh: 用于 RNA 实验。不要加 DEPC 到 Tris 缓冲液（与氨基反应）。替代品：商品化无核酸酶水。

ref: CSH Protocols doi:10.1101/pdb.rec8135; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: RNase-free water for RNA work. DEPC inactivates RNases by covalent modification. Essential for RNA extraction, RT-qPCR, in vitro transcription, and Northern blot.
usage.zh: 用于 RNA 实验的无 RNase 水。DEPC 通过共价修饰灭活 RNase。RNA 提取、RT-qPCR、体外转录、Northern blot 必备。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月 (高压灭菌后)

prepSteps.en: Add {v:1:mL} DEPC per {v:1:L} ddH₂O (0.1% v/v)
prepSteps.zh: 每 {v:1:L} ddH₂O 加 {v:1:mL} DEPC (0.1% v/v)

prepSteps.en: Shake vigorously to disperse (DEPC is not readily soluble)
prepSteps.zh: 剧烈摇匀分散（DEPC 不易溶解）

prepSteps.en: Incubate 37°C overnight (12 h) or RT for 2 h
prepSteps.zh: 37°C 过夜（12 h）或室温 2 h

prepSteps.en: Autoclave 121°C 15 min to decompose residual DEPC → CO₂ + ethanol
prepSteps.zh: 121°C 高压灭菌 15 min 分解残余 DEPC → CO₂ + 乙醇

prepSteps.en: ⚠️ Do NOT use DEPC with Tris or other amine-containing buffers (DEPC reacts with primary amines). Prepare those buffers with DEPC-water instead
prepSteps.zh: ⚠️ 不要将 DEPC 直接加入 Tris 或其他含氨基的缓冲液（DEPC 与伯胺反应）。改用 DEPC 水配制这些缓冲液

name: Protein Loading Buffer (Non-Reducing)
nameCn: 蛋白上样缓冲液 (非还原型)

notes.en: No β-mercaptoethanol or DTT. Use for non-reducing SDS-PAGE: preserves disulfide bonds, suitable for detecting multimers, intact IgG heavy/light chains, or ligand-receptor complexes. Mix 1:1 with sample and heat at 70°C for 10 min (do not boil to avoid aggregation).
notes.zh: 不含 β-巯基乙醇或 DTT。用于非还原 SDS-PAGE：保留二硫键，适合检测多聚体、IgG 重/轻链不分离、或配体-受体复合物。与样品 1:1 混合后 70°C 加热 10 min (不要煮沸，避免聚集)。

ref: Laemmli (1970) Nature 227:680–685

usage.en: Non-reducing SDS-PAGE loading buffer. Preserves disulfide bonds — use for detecting multimers, IgG heavy/light chain integrity, or ligand-receptor complexes under native-like conditions.
usage.zh: 非还原 SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液。保留二硫键——用于检测多聚体、IgG 重/轻链完整性、或配体-受体复合物。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 6 个月

prepSteps.en: Mix Tris-HCl pH 6.8, SDS, glycerol, and bromophenol blue in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris-HCl pH 6.8、SDS、甘油、溴酚蓝混合于 ddH₂O 中

prepSteps.en: Heat gently if needed to dissolve SDS. Do NOT add β-ME or DTT
prepSteps.zh: 必要时轻微加热溶解 SDS。不加 β-ME 或 DTT

prepSteps.en: Aliquot and store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装后 -20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Mix 1:1 with sample. Heat 70°C 10 min (do NOT boil at 95°C)
prepSteps.zh: 与样品 1:1 混合。70°C 加热 10 min（不要 95°C 煮沸）

name: 0.1% Triton X-100 Permeabilization Buffer

notes.en: Apply to PFA-fixed cells only. Incubate at RT for 10–15 min. Triton concentration can range 0.1–0.5%; higher concentrations increase permeabilization but reduce morphology preservation. Use 0.5% for nuclear antigens. Wash 3× with PBS before immunostaining.
notes.zh: 用于固定后的细胞透化 (PFA 固定后)。室温处理 10–15 min。Triton 浓度 0.1–0.5% 可选，浓度越高透化越强但形态保存越差。对于核抗原，0.5% 效果更好。使用后 PBS 洗 3 次再做免疫染色。

ref: Donaldson (2015) Curr Protoc Cell Biol 69:4.3.1–4.3.7

usage.en: Permeabilization buffer for immunofluorescence. Triton X-100 creates pores in cell membranes after fixation, allowing antibodies to access intracellular targets.
usage.zh: 免疫荧光用透化缓冲液。Triton X-100 在固定后的细胞膜上形成孔，使抗体能进入胞内。

label.zh: 室温, 1 个月 (推荐现配)

prepSteps.en: Add {v:100:µL} Triton X-100 to {v:100:mL} PBS
prepSteps.zh: 取 {v:100:µL} Triton X-100 加入 {v:100:mL} PBS

prepSteps.en: Mix gently (avoid foaming)
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀（避免起泡）

prepSteps.en: Apply to PFA-fixed cells, 10–15 min at RT
prepSteps.zh: 加至 PFA 固定的细胞上，室温 10–15 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 3× PBS before immunostaining
prepSteps.zh: PBS 洗 3 次后进行免疫染色

name: DAPI Staining Solution

notes.en: DAPI stock: dissolve 5 mg in 1 mL ddH₂O, aliquot and store at −20°C protected from light. Working solution (1 µg/mL) should be prepared fresh. For fixed/permeabilized cells: incubate 5–10 min at RT in the dark, wash 2× with PBS. Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (blue fluorescence). Membrane-impermeant in live cells — used for dead cell exclusion in flow cytometry (0.1–0.5 µg/mL). Mounting media with DAPI is more convenient for microscopy.
notes.zh: DAPI stock: 5 mg 溶于 1 mL ddH₂O，分装后 -20°C 避光保存。工作液 (1 µg/mL) 现配现用。固定透化后的细胞: 室温避光孵育 5–10 min，PBS 洗 2 次。Ex/Em: 358/461 nm (蓝色荧光)。活细胞不透膜，用于死细胞排除 (流式 0.1–0.5 µg/mL)。封片用含 DAPI 的封片剂更方便。

ref: Kapuscinski (1995) Biotech Histochem 70:220–233

usage.en: Fluorescent nuclear stain for microscopy and flow cytometry. DAPI binds AT-rich regions of dsDNA. Membrane-impermeant → stains only dead cells when unfixed (viability dye); stains all nuclei after fixation/permeabilization.
usage.zh: 荧光核染料，用于显微镜和流式。DAPI 结合双链 DNA 的 AT 富集区。不透膜——未固定时仅染死细胞（活力染料）；固定透化后染所有细胞核。

label.en: Stock -20°C 12 months; working solution prepare fresh
label.zh: 母液 -20°C 12 个月；工作液现配现用

prepSteps.en: Prepare 5 mg/mL stock: dissolve 5 mg DAPI in 1 mL ddH₂O. Aliquot, store -20°C light-protected
prepSteps.zh: 配 5 mg/mL 母液: 5 mg DAPI 溶于 1 mL ddH₂O。分装，-20°C 避光保存

prepSteps.en: Dilute to 1 µg/mL in PBS for working solution (1:5000 from stock)
prepSteps.zh: 用 PBS 稀释至 1 µg/mL 工作液（母液 1:5000）

prepSteps.en: Apply to fixed/permeabilized cells. Incubate 5–10 min RT in dark
prepSteps.zh: 加至固定/透化的细胞。室温避光 5–10 min

prepSteps.en: Wash 2× PBS. Mount and image (Ex 358 nm / Em 461 nm = blue)
prepSteps.zh: PBS 洗 2 次。封片后成像 (Ex 358 nm / Em 461 nm = 蓝色)

name: Calcium Phosphate Transfection

components.name: 1. 转染前一天铺板至 50–70% 汇合度
- 2× HBS: 280 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 1.5 mM Na₂HPO₄, pH 7.05
4. 逐滴将管 A 加入管 B，边滴边吹泡 (用巴氏管)
5. 室温静置 20 min (形成 DNA-Ca₃(PO₄)₂ 沉淀)
6. 逐滴加入培养皿，轻柔晃匀
9. 48–72 h 后收获 (蛋白表达 / 病毒上清)

notes.en: 2× HBS pH must be precisely 7.05 ± 0.02; deviations severely reduce efficiency. Optional glycerol shock: treat with 15% glycerol/PBS for 2 min at 8 h post-transfection, wash 2× PBS, replace medium. HEK293/293T efficiency can reach 80–90%. Preferred method for lentivirus packaging (low cost).
notes.zh: 2× HBS 的 pH 必须精确到 7.05 ± 0.02，偏差会严重影响效率！可选 glycerol shock: 转染后 8 h 用 15% 甘油/PBS 处理 2 min，PBS 洗 2 次，换新培养基。HEK293/293T 效率可达 80–90%。慢病毒包装首选此法 (成本低)。

ref: Kingston et al. (2003) Curr Protoc Mol Biol 9.1.1–9.1.11; Graham & van der Eb (1973) Virology 52:456–467

usage.en: Classic, cost-effective transfection method. Transfect HEK293T, HeLa, and other easily transfectable cell lines. 80–90% efficiency for HEK293T. Widely used for lentivirus packaging.
usage.zh: 经典、低成本的转染方法。适用于 HEK293T、HeLa 等易转染细胞系。HEK293T 效率可达 80–90%。广泛用于慢病毒包装。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2–3 天实验

briefSteps.en: Plate cells → mix DNA + CaCl₂ → drop into 2× HBS while bubbling → incubate 20 min → add to cells → O/N → change media → harvest 48–72h
briefSteps.zh: 铺板 → DNA + CaCl₂ 混合 → 逐滴加入 2× HBS 同时吹泡 → 20 min → 加至细胞 → 过夜 → 换液 → 48–72h 收获

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0**: Plate cells to 50–70% confluency by next morning (e.g., 4×10⁶ HEK293T per 10 cm dish)
detailedSteps.zh: **前一天**: 铺板至次日 50–70% 汇合度（如 HEK293T 4×10⁶/10 cm 皿）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Transfection**:
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 转染**:

detailedSteps.en: Change to fresh medium 1–2 h before transfection. Include 25 µM chloroquine (optional, boosts efficiency 2–3×)
detailedSteps.zh: 转染前 1–2 h 换新鲜培养基。可选加 25 µM 氯喹（提高效率 2–3 倍）

detailedSteps.en: Tube A: Mix 20 µg DNA + 50 µL 2.5M CaCl₂ + ddH₂O to 500 µL total
detailedSteps.zh: 管 A: 20 µg DNA + 50 µL 2.5M CaCl₂ + ddH₂O 补至 500 µL

detailedSteps.en: Tube B: Add 500 µL 2× HBS. Insert Pasteur pipet connected to pipet-aid, start bubbling air
detailedSteps.zh: 管 B: 加 500 µL 2× HBS。插入连接移液器的巴斯德吸管，开始吹泡

detailedSteps.en: Add Tube A dropwise to Tube B while continuously bubbling. This ensures fine precipitate formation
detailedSteps.zh: 逐滴将管 A 加入管 B，同时持续吹泡。这确保形成细小沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at RT 15–20 min. Solution should appear slightly turbid (fine precipitate)
detailedSteps.zh: 室温静置 15–20 min。溶液应略显浑浊（细小沉淀）

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ If solution is clear → precipitate did not form (check 2× HBS pH!). If chunky/flocculent → precipitate too large (won't work)
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ 如果溶液澄清 → 未形成沉淀（检查 2× HBS pH！）。如果絮状/块状 → 沉淀太大（不会起效）

detailedSteps.en: Add dropwise to dish while swirling gently. Return to 37°C incubator
detailedSteps.zh: 边轻柔晃动培养皿边逐滴加入。放回 37°C 培养箱

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2**: Replace medium after 12–16 h. Fine granular precipitate on cells is normal and good
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天**: 12–16 h 后换液。细胞上的细颗粒状沉淀是正常的好现象

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3**: Harvest protein expression at 48 h or collect virus supernatant at 48–72 h
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天**: 48 h 收获蛋白表达或 48–72 h 收集病毒上清

name: Bacterial Transformation (Heat Shock)

components.name: 1. Thaw competent cells on ice (5 min)
3. Mix gently by flicking. Ice 30 min
8. Plate on selective LB agar + antibiotic

notes.en: Use 5 µL of ligation product (1/4 to 1/2 of the reaction). DNA volume should not exceed 10% of competent cell volume. Heat shock at 42°C for exactly 30–60 s. SOC medium gives 2–5× better recovery than LB. For Amp resistance: 1 h recovery is sufficient; for Kan resistance: 1.5 h recommended. If transformation efficiency is low, check: (1) competent cell quality, (2) DNA purity, (3) heat shock timing.
notes.zh: 连接产物用 5 µL (= 整个连接体系的 1/4–1/2)。DNA 体积不超过感受态体积的 10%。42°C 热激时间严格控制在 30–60 s。SOC 比 LB 恢复效率高 2–5 倍。Amp 抗性: 1 h 恢复即可；Kan 抗性: 建议恢复 1.5 h。如转化效率低，检查: (1) 感受态效率 (2) DNA 纯度 (3) 热激时间。

ref: Hanahan (1983) J Mol Biol 166:557–580; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.

usage.en: Standard method for introducing plasmid DNA into chemically competent E. coli. Used for cloning, protein expression, and library construction. Quick (2 h from thaw to plating).
usage.zh: 将质粒 DNA 导入化学感受态大肠杆菌的标准方法。用于克隆、蛋白表达和文库构建。快速（从解冻到涂板 2 h）。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 小时 + 过夜培养

briefSteps.en: Thaw cells on ice → add DNA → ice 30 min → 42°C 45 s → ice 2 min → add SOC → 37°C 1 h → plate on selective agar → O/N 37°C
briefSteps.zh: 冰上解冻感受态 → 加 DNA → 冰浴 30 min → 42°C 45 s → 冰浴 2 min → 加 SOC → 37°C 1 h → 涂选择性平板 → 37°C 过夜

detailedSteps.en: **Preparation**: Pre-warm selective LB agar plates at 37°C (at least 30 min to dry surface moisture)
detailedSteps.zh: **准备**: 选择性 LB 琼脂平板 37°C 预热（至少 30 min 烘干表面水分）

detailedSteps.en: Thaw one aliquot of competent cells on ice for 5 min. Do NOT warm with hands
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上解冻一管感受态细胞 5 min。不要用手温暖

detailedSteps.en: **Add DNA**: Gently pipette 1–5 µL DNA (1–50 ng) directly into cells. Flick tube gently 4–5×. Do NOT vortex or pipet up/down
detailedSteps.zh: **加 DNA**: 轻柔移取 1–5 µL DNA (1–50 ng) 直接加入细胞。轻弹管壁 4–5 次。不要涡旋或反复吹打

detailedSteps.en: ⚠️ DNA volume must be ≤10% of cell volume (e.g., ≤5 µL into 50 µL cells). Excess volume reduces efficiency dramatically
detailedSteps.zh: ⚠️ DNA 体积必须 ≤ 感受态体积的 10%（如 50 µL 细胞中加 ≤5 µL）。过量会严重降低效率

detailedSteps.en: Incubate on ice for 30 min. Do not shake or move the tube
detailedSteps.zh: 冰浴 30 min。不要摇动或移动管子

detailedSteps.en: **Heat shock**: Transfer tube to 42°C water bath for exactly 45 seconds. Start timer before placing tube
detailedSteps.zh: **热激**: 将管子转移至 42°C 水浴，精确 45 秒。放入前开始计时

detailedSteps.en: Immediately return to ice for 2 min. This step is critical for survival
detailedSteps.zh: 立即放回冰上 2 min。此步对细胞存活至关重要

detailedSteps.en: **Recovery**: Add 950 µL room-temperature SOC medium (or LB). SOC gives 2–5× better efficiency
detailedSteps.zh: **恢复**: 加入 950 µL 室温 SOC 培养基（或 LB）。SOC 效率高 2–5 倍

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 225 rpm for 1 hour (Amp) or 1.5 hours (Kan/Cm)
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 225 rpm 振荡 1 小时 (Amp) 或 1.5 小时 (Kan/Cm)

detailedSteps.en: **Plating**: For routine cloning: plate 100 µL directly + spin down remainder and plate. For ligation: plate everything
detailedSteps.zh: **涂板**: 常规克隆: 直接涂 100 µL + 剩余离心后涂板。连接产物: 全部涂板

detailedSteps.en: Spread evenly with sterile glass beads or spreader. Allow plates to dry 5 min (lid slightly open)
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌玻璃珠或涂布棒均匀涂开。开盖干燥 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Invert plates. Incubate at 37°C for 12–16 hours. Do not exceed 16 h (satellite colonies form)
detailedSteps.zh: 倒置平板。37°C 培养 12–16 小时。不要超过 16 h（会出现卫星菌落）

detailedSteps.en: **Controls**: Always include: (1) no-DNA negative control, (2) uncut vector positive control, (3) cut-only vector control (background)
detailedSteps.zh: **对照**: 始终设置: (1) 无 DNA 阴性对照, (2) 未切割载体阳性对照, (3) 仅切割载体对照（背景）

name: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis

components.name: 2. 微波加热至完全溶解 (注意防沸)
4. 倒入胶板，插梳，室温凝固 20–30 min
5. 样品与 6× Loading Dye 混合 (5:1)

notes.en: TAE is better for large fragments and gel extraction (low ionic strength, easier to cut bands); TBE provides higher resolution for small fragments (<1 kb). EtBr is carcinogenic — use GelRed/SYBR Safe alternatives. Running buffer and gel buffer must match. Avoid air bubbles. RNA gels require formaldehyde denaturing agarose.
notes.zh: TAE 适合大片段和胶回收 (低离子强度，跑得慢易切胶)；TBE 分辨率更高适合小片段 (<1 kb)。EtBr 致癌，推荐用 GelRed/SYBR Safe 等替代品。电泳缓冲液和制胶缓冲液须一致。避免气泡。RNA 胶需用甲醛变性凝胶。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd ed.; Lee et al. (2012) J Vis Exp 62:e3923

usage.en: Separate DNA fragments by size (100 bp – 25 kb). Use 0.8% for large fragments, 2% for small. Standard for PCR product analysis, restriction digests, quality checks, and gel extraction.
usage.zh: 按大小分离 DNA 片段（100 bp – 25 kb）。大片段用 0.8%，小片段用 2%。用于 PCR 产物分析、酶切鉴定、质量检查和胶回收。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 1.5h

briefSteps.en: Dissolve agarose in buffer → microwave → cool to 55°C → add stain → pour gel → insert comb → solidify 20–30 min → load samples + ladder → run 80–120V 30–60 min → image under UV/blue light
briefSteps.zh: 溶解琼脂糖 → 微波 → 冷至 55°C → 加染料 → 倒胶 → 插梳 → 凝固 20–30 min → 上样 + Ladder → 80–120V 电泳 30–60 min → UV/蓝光成像

detailedSteps.en: **Choose agarose %**: 0.8% for >1 kb, 1% for 0.5–7 kb, 1.5% for 0.2–3 kb, 2% for <500 bp
Weigh agarose powder (e.g. 1 g per 100 mL for 1% gel) into an Erlenmeyer flask. Add 1× TAE or TBE buffer. Swirl
detailedSteps.zh: 称取琼脂糖粉末（如 1% 胶：1 g / 100 mL）放入锥形瓶。加 1× TAE 或 TBE 缓冲液，摇匀

detailedSteps.en: Microwave 1–3 min until agarose is completely dissolved. Watch for boiling over. ⚠️ Loosen cap!
detailedSteps.zh: 微波 1–3 min 至完全溶解，注意防止沸腾溢出。⚠️ 松开瓶盖！

detailedSteps.en: Cool to ~55°C (comfortable to hold). Add DNA stain (0.5 µg/mL EtBr or 1× SYBR Safe). Swirl
detailedSteps.zh: 冷至约 55°C（手可握住）。加 DNA 染料（0.5 µg/mL EtBr 或 1× SYBR Safe）。摇匀

detailedSteps.en: Seal ends of gel tray with tape or gaskets. Place comb(s)
detailedSteps.zh: 用胶带或密封垫密封胶模两端，放置梳子

detailedSteps.en: Pour molten agarose into tray. Pop any bubbles with a pipette tip. Let solidify 20–30 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: 将熔化琼脂糖倒入模具，用枪头戳破气泡。室温凝固 20–30 min

detailedSteps.en: Remove comb(s) gently. Place gel in electrophoresis chamber
detailedSteps.zh: 轻轻拔出梳子，将凝胶放入电泳槽

detailedSteps.en: Fill chamber with 1× TAE/TBE until gel is submerged (2–3 mm above gel surface). Use same buffer as gel
detailedSteps.zh: 加 1× TAE/TBE 没过凝胶 2–3 mm。必须与制胶用同一缓冲液

detailedSteps.en: Mix DNA samples with 6× loading dye (1:5 ratio). Load into wells using a micropipette
detailedSteps.zh: 将 DNA 样品与 6× loading dye 1:5 混合。用微量移液器加样

detailedSteps.en: Load DNA ladder in the first and/or last well
detailedSteps.zh: 在第一和/或最后一个孔加入 DNA ladder

detailedSteps.en: Connect power supply. Run at 5–8 V/cm (e.g., 100–120V for standard mini gel) for 30–60 min
detailedSteps.zh: 连接电源。5–8 V/cm 电泳（标准小胶用 100–120V），30–60 min

detailedSteps.en: Monitor: loading dye should travel ⅔–¾ of gel length. Dye migrates toward + (red) electrode
detailedSteps.zh: 观察：loading dye 应跑到凝胶 ⅔–¾ 处。染料向阳极（红色）迁移

detailedSteps.en: Turn off power. Remove gel from tray
detailedSteps.zh: 关闭电源，取出凝胶

detailedSteps.en: Image on UV transilluminator (254/302 nm for EtBr) or blue light (for SYBR Safe). Photograph and document
detailedSteps.zh: 紫外透射仪（EtBr：254/302 nm）或蓝光（SYBR Safe）下成像。拍照记录

detailedSteps.en: Compare band sizes to ladder. **For gel extraction**: use blue light (less DNA damage), cut band with clean scalpel, purify with gel extraction kit
detailedSteps.zh: 对照 ladder 比较条带大小。**胶回收时**: 使用蓝光（减少 DNA 损伤），用干净手术刀切下条带，用胶回收试剂盒纯化

note.zh: 胶回收用低熔点琼脂糖

materials.name: UV transilluminator or blue light imager

name: MES Running Buffer (20×)

notes.en: Dilute to 1× before use. Optimized for NuPAGE Bis-Tris gels; better resolution for low MW proteins (<30 kDa) compared to MOPS buffer. Do not adjust pH.
notes.zh: 20× 母液。使用前稀释至 1×。适用于 NuPAGE Bis-Tris 凝胶，分辨低分子量蛋白 (<30 kDa) 优于 MOPS。不要调 pH。

ref: Invitrogen NuPAGE Technical Guide (Thermo Fisher MAN0003690)

usage.en: Low-MW protein separation on Bis-Tris gels. Better than MOPS for proteins <30 kDa.
usage.zh: 用于 Bis-Tris 凝胶的低分子量蛋白分离。<30 kDa 蛋白效果优于 MOPS。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月 (20× 储备液)

prepSteps.en: Weigh MES, Tris base, SDS, EDTA
prepSteps.zh: 称取 MES、Tris base、SDS、EDTA

prepSteps.en: Dissolve in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O, bring to {v:1:L}. Do NOT adjust pH
prepSteps.zh: 溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O，定容至 {v:1:L}。不要调 pH

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:20 to 1× before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前 1:20 稀释至 1×

name: NP-40 Lysis Buffer

notes.en: Mild lysis buffer that preserves protein-protein interactions, ideal for Co-IP. NP-40 does not lyse the nuclear membrane. Add protease inhibitors fresh before use. Add phosphatase inhibitors for phosphoprotein detection.
notes.zh: 温和裂解液，保留蛋白-蛋白相互作用，适合 Co-IP。NP-40 不裂解核膜。使用前加蛋白酶抑制剂。可加磷酸酶抑制剂用于磷酸化蛋白检测。

ref: Abcam Co-IP protocol; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: Mild, non-denaturing lysis. Preserves protein complexes for Co-IP and interaction studies. Does not solubilize nuclear proteins.
usage.zh: 温和非变性裂解。保留蛋白复合物，适合 Co-IP 和互作研究。不溶解核蛋白。

label.zh: 4°C, 6 个月；蛋白酶抑制剂现用现加

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris-HCl, NaCl, EDTA in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris-HCl、NaCl、EDTA 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Add NP-40 (IGEPAL CA-630) to 1%
prepSteps.zh: 加入 NP-40 (IGEPAL CA-630) 至 1%

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 7.4, bring to volume
prepSteps.zh: 调 pH 至 7.4，定容

prepSteps.en: Add protease inhibitors fresh before use
prepSteps.zh: 使用前现加蛋白酶抑制剂

name: RNA Loading Dye (2×)

notes.en: For denaturing agarose gel electrophoresis. Mix sample 1:1 with dye, heat at 65°C for 5 min, snap-cool on ice, then load. Formamide denatures RNA secondary structure.
notes.zh: 用于变性琼脂糖凝胶电泳。样品与 dye 1:1 混合后 65°C 加热 5 min，立即冰上冷却后上样。甲酰胺变性 RNA 二级结构。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; Rio et al. (2010) CSH Protocols

usage.en: Denaturing loading buffer for RNA agarose gel electrophoresis. Formamide disrupts secondary structure for accurate size determination.
usage.zh: RNA 变性琼脂糖凝胶电泳上样缓冲液。甲酰胺破坏二级结构以准确判断大小。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Mix deionized formamide with EDTA stock
prepSteps.zh: 将去离子甲酰胺与 EDTA 母液混合

prepSteps.en: Add bromophenol blue and xylene cyanol
prepSteps.zh: 加入溴酚蓝和二甲苯青

prepSteps.en: Aliquot and store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 -20°C 保存

name: Sodium Acetate Buffer (0.1 M)

notes.en: Dissolve sodium acetate, adjust to target pH with glacial acetic acid. Effective buffering range pH 3.6–5.6. Commonly used for enzyme assays and protein purification. Autoclave and store at RT.
notes.zh: 先溶醋酸钠，用冰醋酸调至目标 pH。有效缓冲范围 pH 3.6–5.6。常用于酶学实验和蛋白纯化。高压灭菌后保存。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

usage.en: Buffering range pH 3.6–5.6. Common for enzyme assays, protein purification, and histochemistry at acidic pH.
usage.zh: 缓冲范围 pH 3.6–5.6。常用于酸性 pH 下的酶学实验、蛋白纯化和组化。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月（高压灭菌后）

prepSteps.en: Dissolve sodium acetate trihydrate in ~{v:800:mL} ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将醋酸钠三水合物溶于约 {v:800:mL} ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust to target pH with glacial acetic acid
prepSteps.zh: 用冰醋酸调至目标 pH

prepSteps.en: Bring to final volume, autoclave
prepSteps.zh: 定容，高压灭菌

name: Miniprep Buffer P1 (Resuspension)
nameCn: 质粒提取缓冲液 P1 (重悬液)

notes.en: Prepare Tris-EDTA, autoclave, cool to RT, then add RNase A. RNase A is heat-sensitive — do not autoclave. Store at 4°C.
notes.zh: 先配 Tris-EDTA，高压灭菌后冷却，再加 RNase A。RNase A 热敏，不可高压灭菌。4°C 保存。

ref: Birnboim & Doly (1979) Nucleic Acids Res 7:1513; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: Resuspension buffer for alkaline lysis miniprep. Tris/EDTA stabilize DNA; RNase A degrades RNA during lysis.
usage.zh: 碱裂解质粒提取重悬液。Tris/EDTA 稳定 DNA；RNase A 在裂解过程中降解 RNA。

label.zh: 4°C, 6 个月（加 RNase A 后）

prepSteps.en: Dissolve Tris-HCl and EDTA in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 Tris-HCl 和 EDTA 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 8.0, autoclave
prepSteps.zh: 调 pH 至 8.0，高压灭菌

prepSteps.en: Cool to RT, add RNase A (do NOT autoclave RNase A)
prepSteps.zh: 冷却至室温，加入 RNase A（不可高压灭菌 RNase A）

prepSteps.en: Store at 4°C
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 保存

name: Miniprep Buffer P2 (Lysis)
nameCn: 质粒提取缓冲液 P2 (裂解液)

notes.en: Prepare fresh or store at RT. NaOH denatures genomic DNA and proteins; SDS solubilizes cell membranes. Mix gently by inversion (DO NOT vortex!) to avoid shearing genomic DNA.
notes.zh: 现用现配或室温保存。NaOH 变性基因组 DNA 和蛋白，SDS 溶解细胞膜。使用时轻柔混匀（不可涡旋！），避免剪切基因组 DNA。

ref: Birnboim & Doly (1979) Nucleic Acids Res 7:1513

usage.en: Lysis buffer for alkaline lysis. NaOH denatures genomic DNA and proteins; SDS solubilizes membranes. Must be mixed gently.
usage.zh: 碱裂解液。NaOH 变性基因组 DNA 和蛋白；SDS 溶解细胞膜。必须轻柔混匀。

label.zh: 室温, 6 个月（或现用现配）

prepSteps.en: Dissolve NaOH and SDS in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 NaOH 和 SDS 溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Mix gently — do not autoclave
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀——不需要高压灭菌

name: Miniprep Buffer P3 (Neutralization)
nameCn: 质粒提取缓冲液 P3 (中和液)

notes.en: Dissolve potassium acetate, adjust pH to 5.5 with glacial acetic acid. K⁺ precipitates SDS (forming KDS), co-precipitating denatured proteins and genomic DNA. Plasmid DNA remains in the supernatant.
notes.zh: 溶解醋酸钾，用冰醋酸调 pH 至 5.5。加入后轻柔混匀。K⁺ 使 SDS 沉淀（形成 KDS），携带变性蛋白和基因组 DNA 一起沉淀。质粒 DNA 留在上清。

ref: Birnboim & Doly (1979) Nucleic Acids Res 7:1513

usage.en: Neutralization buffer. K⁺ precipitates SDS as KDS, co-precipitating denatured genomic DNA and proteins. Plasmid DNA renatures and stays in solution.
usage.zh: 中和液。K⁺ 使 SDS 沉淀为 KDS，共沉淀变性的基因组 DNA 和蛋白。质粒 DNA 复性后留在溶液中。

label.zh: 4°C 或室温, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve potassium acetate in ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将醋酸钾溶于 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Adjust pH to 5.5 with glacial acetic acid
prepSteps.zh: 用冰醋酸调 pH 至 5.5

prepSteps.en: Bring to volume
prepSteps.zh: 定容

name: Cell Freezing Medium (10% DMSO)

notes.en: Prepare fresh or pre-chill at 4°C. DMSO is a penetrating cryoprotectant that prevents ice crystal formation. After resuspending cells, transfer quickly to cryovials, use a controlled-rate freezing container (-1°C/min) to -80°C, then move to liquid nitrogen after 24h. DMSO is cytotoxic at 37°C — dilute promptly after thawing.
notes.zh: 使用前现配或 4°C 预冷。DMSO 是渗透性冷冻保护剂，防止冰晶形成。细胞重悬后迅速转移至冻存管，使用梯度降温盒 (-1°C/min) 放入 -80°C，24h 后转液氮。DMSO 在 37°C 对细胞有毒，解冻后尽快稀释。

ref: Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th ed.

usage.en: Standard freezing medium for mammalian cell lines. 90% FBS + 10% DMSO is the most common formulation.
usage.zh: 哺乳动物细胞系的标准冻存液。90% FBS + 10% DMSO 是最常用配方。

label.en: Prepare fresh; DMSO aliquots at RT
label.zh: 现用现配；DMSO 分装室温保存

prepSteps.en: Add DMSO to heat-inactivated FBS (90:10 ratio)
prepSteps.zh: 将 DMSO 加入灭活 FBS（90:10 比例）

prepSteps.en: Mix gently, pre-chill at 4°C before use
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀，使用前 4°C 预冷

name: Complete DMEM (10% FBS)

notes.en: Prepare under sterile conditions. Heat-inactivate FBS at 56°C for 30 min. Complete medium stored at 4°C for up to 4 weeks. Pre-warm to 37°C before use. Suitable for HEK293, HeLa, NIH3T3, and other adherent cell lines.
notes.zh: 无菌操作。FBS 需 56°C 灭活 30 min。完全培养基 4°C 保存不超过 4 周。使用前预热至 37°C。适用于 HEK293、HeLa、NIH3T3 等贴壁细胞系。

ref: Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th ed.; ATCC cell culture guide

usage.en: Standard growth medium for most adherent mammalian cell lines. DMEM high-glucose with 10% FBS, 1% Pen/Strep.
usage.zh: 大多数贴壁哺乳动物细胞系的标准培养基。高糖 DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% 双抗。

label.zh: 4°C, 加血清后 4 周

prepSteps.en: Under sterile conditions, add FBS and Pen/Strep to DMEM
prepSteps.zh: 无菌条件下，向 DMEM 中加入 FBS 和双抗

prepSteps.en: Optional: add sodium pyruvate
prepSteps.zh: 可选：加入丙酮酸钠

prepSteps.en: Mix gently, store at 4°C. Pre-warm to 37°C before use
prepSteps.zh: 轻柔混匀，4°C 保存。使用前预热至 37°C

name: Complete RPMI-1640 (10% FBS)

notes.en: Suitable for suspension cells, lymphocytes, hybridomas. β-ME is important for lymphocyte culture (antioxidant). HEPES maintains pH stability during bench work outside CO₂ incubator.
notes.zh: 适用于悬浮细胞、淋巴细胞、杂交瘤。β-ME 对淋巴细胞培养很重要（抗氧化）。HEPES 维持 pH 稳定（CO₂ 培养箱外操作时）。

ref: Moore et al. (1967) JAMA 199:519; Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells

usage.en: Standard medium for suspension cells (Jurkat, K562), lymphocytes, PBMCs, and hybridomas.
usage.zh: 悬浮细胞（Jurkat、K562）、淋巴细胞、PBMC 和杂交瘤的标准培养基。

label.zh: 4°C, 加血清后 4 周

prepSteps.en: Under sterile conditions, add FBS and Pen/Strep to RPMI-1640
prepSteps.zh: 无菌条件下，向 RPMI-1640 中加入 FBS 和双抗

prepSteps.en: Add β-mercaptoethanol for lymphocyte culture
prepSteps.zh: 淋巴细胞培养需加 β-巯基乙醇

prepSteps.en: Optional: add HEPES for pH stability
prepSteps.zh: 可选：加 HEPES 维持 pH 稳定

prepSteps.en: Store at 4°C. Pre-warm to 37°C before use
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 保存。使用前预热至 37°C

name: Plasmid Miniprep (Alkaline Lysis)

components.name: 3. 250 µL Buffer P2 裂解 (颠倒混匀)
4. 350 µL Buffer P3 中和 (颠倒混匀)
7. 加 0.7 倍体积异丙醇沉淀
10. 风干 → 30–50 µL TE/H₂O 溶解

notes.en: Dilute to 1× before use. Classic alkaline lysis method. Yields 5–20 µg from 3 mL overnight culture. A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0 for pure DNA.
notes.zh: 经典碱裂解法。3 mL 过夜培养物可获 5–20 µg 质粒 DNA。A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0。如需更高纯度，使用商业柱提试剂盒。

ref: Birnboim & Doly (1979) Nucleic Acids Res 7:1513–1523; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: Classic method for extracting plasmid DNA from E. coli. Yields 5–20 µg from 3 mL overnight culture. Quick and inexpensive. For higher purity, use commercial spin columns.
usage.zh: 从大肠杆菌提取质粒 DNA 的经典方法。3 mL 过夜培养物可获得 5–20 µg。快速、经济。如需更高纯度，可使用商业柱提试剂盒。

label.zh: 实验方案 — DNA -20°C 保存

briefSteps.en: Pellet bacteria → resuspend in P1 → lyse with P2 → neutralize with P3 → centrifuge → precipitate DNA with isopropanol → wash with 70% ethanol → dissolve in TE/H₂O
briefSteps.zh: 离心收菌 → P1 重悬 → P2 裂解 → P3 中和 → 离心 → 异丙醇沉淀 DNA → 70% 乙醇洗涤 → TE/水溶解

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Centrifuge 1.5–3 mL overnight culture at 6,000 × g for 2 min. Discard supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **收菌**: 1.5–3 mL 过夜培养物 6,000 × g 离心 2 min，弃上清

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Add 250 µL Buffer P1. Pipet up and down until no clumps remain
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 加 250 µL Buffer P1，反复吹打至无团块

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse**: Add 250 µL Buffer P2. Mix by inverting 6–8 times. **Do NOT vortex.** Solution should become clear and viscous (≤5 min)
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 加 250 µL Buffer P2，颠倒混匀 6–8 次。**不可涡旋！** 溶液应变透明粘稠（≤5 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Neutralize**: Add 350 µL ice-cold Buffer P3. Mix immediately by inverting 6–8 times. White precipitate forms
detailedSteps.zh: **中和**: 加 350 µL 冰冷 Buffer P3，立即颠倒混匀 6–8 次。形成白色沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 10 min at room temperature
detailedSteps.zh: 室温 13,000 × g 离心 10 min

detailedSteps.en: Transfer supernatant (~800 µL) to a clean tube. **Avoid the white pellet**
detailedSteps.zh: 转移上清（约 800 µL）至新管。**避免吸到白色沉淀**

detailedSteps.en: **Precipitate**: Add 0.7 volumes (~560 µL) isopropanol. Mix by inversion
detailedSteps.zh: **沉淀**: 加 0.7 倍体积（约 560 µL）异丙醇，颠倒混匀

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 15 min. DNA pellet may be visible
detailedSteps.zh: 13,000 × g 离心 15 min。DNA 沉淀可能可见

detailedSteps.en: Carefully remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet
detailedSteps.zh: 小心去除上清，勿触碰沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Add 500 µL 70% ethanol. Centrifuge 5 min at 13,000 × g
Remove ethanol completely. Air-dry pellet 5–10 min (do not over-dry)
detailedSteps.zh: 完全去除乙醇。风干沉淀 5–10 min（不要过度干燥）

detailedSteps.en: **Dissolve**: Add 30–50 µL TE buffer or ddH₂O to pellet
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解**: 加 30–50 µL TE 缓冲液或 ddH₂O 溶解沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **QC**: Measure concentration by NanoDrop. A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0
detailedSteps.zh: **质检**: NanoDrop 测浓度。A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0

detailedSteps.en: Store at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: -20°C 保存

note.en: Bacterial pellet can be stored at -20°C
DNA pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at -20°C for months
note.zh: DNA 沉淀在 70% 乙醇中可 -20°C 保存数月

name: MTT Cell Viability Assay

components.name: 5. 每孔加 10 µL MTT (5 mg/mL)
components.note: MTT 母液: 5 mg/mL in PBS, 0.22 µm 过滤, 4°C 避光保存 ≤4 周

components.name: 8. 每孔加 100 µL DMSO 溶解

notes.en: Colorimetric assay measuring cell metabolic activity as proxy for viability. MTT (yellow) is reduced to formazan (purple) by mitochondrial reductases. OD570 proportional to viable cell number. Include blank wells.
notes.zh: 比色法检测细胞代谢活力。MTT 被线粒体还原酶还原为甲臜结晶。OD570 与活细胞数成正比。需设空白对照孔。% 活力 = (OD处理/OD对照) × 100。

ref: Mosmann (1983) J Immunol Methods 65:55–63

usage.en: Colorimetric assay measuring cell metabolic activity as proxy for viability and proliferation. MTT (yellow) is reduced by mitochondrial reductases to formazan crystals (purple). OD570 is proportional to viable cell number.
usage.zh: 比色法，以细胞代谢活性反映活力和增殖。MTT（黄色）被线粒体还原酶还原为甲臜结晶（紫色）。OD570 与活细胞数成正比。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3–5 天实验

briefSteps.en: Seed cells → treat → add MTT → incubate 2–4h → remove medium → add DMSO → shake → read OD570
briefSteps.zh: 接种细胞 → 处理 → 加 MTT → 孵育 2–4h → 去培养基 → 加 DMSO → 振荡 → 读 OD570

detailedSteps.en: Seed cells in 96-well plate at 5,000–10,000 cells/well in 100 µL medium. Include blank wells (medium only)
detailedSteps.zh: 96 孔板接种细胞，每孔 5,000–10,000 个/100 µL。设空白孔（仅培养基）

detailedSteps.en: Incubate 24h at 37°C, 5% CO₂ to allow attachment
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 孵育 24h 使细胞贴壁

detailedSteps.en: Add drug/treatment at desired concentrations. Include vehicle control
detailedSteps.zh: 加入药物/处理至目标浓度。设溶剂对照

detailedSteps.en: Incubate for treatment duration (24–72h)
detailedSteps.zh: 孵育处理时间（24–72h）

detailedSteps.en: Add 10 µL MTT solution (5 mg/mL) to each well (final 0.5 mg/mL)
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 10 µL MTT 溶液（5 mg/mL），终浓度 0.5 mg/mL

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C for 2–4h. Purple formazan crystals should be visible under microscope
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 孵育 2–4h。显微镜下应可见紫色甲臜结晶

detailedSteps.en: Carefully remove medium from each well (aspirate or invert plate onto paper towel)
detailedSteps.zh: 小心去除各孔培养基（吸除或倒扣于纸巾上）

detailedSteps.en: Add 100 µL DMSO to each well to dissolve formazan crystals
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔加 100 µL DMSO 溶解甲臜结晶

detailedSteps.en: Shake plate gently for 10 min (or orbital shaker) until crystals are fully dissolved
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔振荡 10 min（或摇床）至结晶完全溶解

detailedSteps.en: Read absorbance at 570 nm (reference 690 nm). Calculate viability: % = (OD_treated / OD_control) × 100
detailedSteps.zh: 570 nm 读数（参考 690 nm）。计算活力: % = (OD处理 / OD对照) × 100

name: Wound Healing (Scratch) Assay

components.name: 4. 加无血清培养基 ± 处理

notes.en: Simple assay to study cell migration. Create a scratch in confluent monolayer, image gap closure over time. Use serum-free medium to isolate migration from proliferation. Analyze with ImageJ MRI Wound Healing Tool.
notes.zh: 简单经济的细胞迁移实验。用无血清培养基区分迁移和增殖。可选丝裂霉素 C 预处理抑制增殖。% 愈合 = (面积₀ₕ − 面积ₜₕ) / 面积₀ₕ × 100。

ref: Liang et al. (2007) Nat Protoc 2:329–333

usage.en: Simple, inexpensive assay to study cell migration and wound closure in vitro. Create a scratch in a confluent monolayer, then image gap closure over time. Use serum-free medium to isolate migration from proliferation effects.
usage.zh: 简单、经济的体外细胞迁移和伤口愈合实验。在融合单层细胞上划痕，随时间观察间隙闭合。使用无血清培养基区分迁移和增殖效应。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1–3 天实验

briefSteps.en: Grow to confluence → scratch with 200 µL tip → wash → add serum-free medium ± treatment → image at intervals → analyze wound closure
briefSteps.zh: 培养至融合 → 200 µL 枪头划痕 → 洗涤 → 加无血清培养基 ± 处理 → 定时拍照 → 分析愈合率

detailedSteps.en: Seed cells in 6-well or 12-well plate. Grow to >95% confluence (usually 24–48h)
detailedSteps.zh: 在 6 孔或 12 孔板中接种细胞。培养至 >95% 融合（通常 24–48h）

detailedSteps.en: Optional: Pre-treat with mitomycin C (10 µg/mL, 2h) to inhibit proliferation if measuring migration only
detailedSteps.zh: 可选：丝裂霉素 C（10 µg/mL, 2h）预处理抑制增殖（仅测迁移时）

detailedSteps.en: Using a sterile 200 µL pipette tip, draw a straight line through the cell monolayer. Use a ruler as guide
detailedSteps.zh: 用无菌 200 µL 枪头在细胞单层上划一条直线。用尺子导引

detailedSteps.en: Make 2–3 parallel scratches per well. Mark reference lines on plate bottom perpendicular to scratches
detailedSteps.zh: 每孔划 2–3 条平行线。在板底标记与划痕垂直的参考线

detailedSteps.en: Wash gently 2× with PBS to remove detached cells and debris
detailedSteps.zh: PBS 轻柔洗 2 次，去除脱落细胞和碎片

detailedSteps.en: Add serum-free medium (or 1% FBS) with or without treatment compounds
detailedSteps.zh: 加无血清培养基（或 1% FBS），加或不加处理化合物

detailedSteps.en: Image the scratch at 0h under phase-contrast microscope (4× or 10×). Record same positions using reference marks
detailedSteps.zh: 0h 相差显微镜（4× 或 10×）拍照。利用参考线记录相同位置

detailedSteps.en: Return plate to 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator
detailedSteps.zh: 培养板放回 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养箱

detailedSteps.en: Image at regular intervals: 6h, 12h, 24h, 48h (depending on cell type migration speed)
detailedSteps.zh: 定时拍照：6h, 12h, 24h, 48h（取决于细胞迁移速度）

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: Measure wound area at each timepoint using ImageJ (MRI Wound Healing Tool). Calculate % closure = (Area₀ₕ − Areaₜₕ) / Area₀ₕ × 100
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: 用 ImageJ（MRI Wound Healing Tool 插件）测量各时间点伤口面积。% 愈合 = (面积₀ₕ − 面积ₜₕ) / 面积₀ₕ × 100

detailedSteps.en: Plot wound closure (%) vs time. Compare treated vs control groups
detailedSteps.zh: 绘制愈合率 (%) vs 时间曲线。比较处理组与对照组

detailedSteps.en: Representative images: Include 0h and endpoint images for each condition in figures
detailedSteps.zh: 代表性图片：在图中包含每个条件的 0h 和终点图片

name: Cell Freezing (Cryopreservation)

components.name: 1. 选择 70–90% 汇合度、活力 >90% 的细胞
6. 冻存液重悬 (1–5×10⁶/mL)
components.note: 90% FBS + 10% DMSO; 或商用 CryoStor CS10

notes.en: Standard cryopreservation protocol. Controlled-rate freezing (-1°C/min) in 10% DMSO/90% FBS. Use Mr. Frosty or CoolCell. Transfer to liquid nitrogen within 24–48h. Essential for cell banking.
notes.zh: 细胞应处于对数生长期。10% DMSO/90% FBS 冻存液。-1°C/min 程序降温防止冰晶损伤。标记细胞系、代次、日期。

ref: Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th ed.; ATCC Cell Culture Guide

usage.en: Standard protocol for cryopreserving mammalian cell lines. Cells frozen at controlled rate (-1°C/min) in 10% DMSO/90% FBS to prevent ice crystal damage. Essential for cell banking and maintaining low-passage stocks.
usage.zh: 哺乳动物细胞系的标准冻存方案。在 10% DMSO/90% FBS 中以 -1°C/min 程序降温，防止冰晶损伤。对细胞库建立和维持低代次细胞至关重要。

label.en: Protocol — cells stored in liquid nitrogen
label.zh: 实验方案 — 细胞液氮保存

briefSteps.en: Trypsinize → count → centrifuge → resuspend in freezing medium → aliquot to cryovials → Mr. Frosty -80°C overnight → transfer to liquid nitrogen
briefSteps.zh: 消化 → 计数 → 离心 → 冻存液重悬 → 分装至冻存管 → Mr. Frosty -80°C 过夜 → 转液氮

detailedSteps.en: Use cells at 70–90% confluence, in log-phase growth. Ensure viability >90% (trypan blue)
detailedSteps.zh: 选择 70–90% 汇合度、对数生长期细胞。确认活力 >90%（台盼蓝）

detailedSteps.en: Aspirate medium. Wash cells with PBS
detailedSteps.zh: 吸除培养基。PBS 洗涤细胞

detailedSteps.en: Add Trypsin-EDTA. Incubate at 37°C until cells detach (1–5 min depending on cell type)
detailedSteps.zh: 加入胰酶-EDTA。37°C 孵育至细胞脱落（1–5 min，视细胞类型）

detailedSteps.en: Neutralize with 2× volume complete medium. Transfer to centrifuge tube
detailedSteps.zh: 加 2 倍体积完全培养基中和。转移至离心管

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min. Aspirate supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 200 × g 离心 5 min。吸除上清

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend pellet in complete medium. Count cells using hemocytometer
detailedSteps.zh: 完全培养基重悬沉淀。血球计数板计数

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge again at 200 × g for 5 min. Remove supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 再次 200 × g 离心 5 min。去除上清

detailedSteps.en: Resuspend in pre-chilled freezing medium at 1–5 × 10⁶ cells/mL
detailedSteps.zh: 预冷冻存液重悬，密度 1–5 × 10⁶ cells/mL

detailedSteps.en: Aliquot 1 mL per cryovial. Label: cell line, passage number, date, initials
detailedSteps.zh: 每管分装 1 mL。标记：细胞系、代次、日期、姓名缩写

detailedSteps.en: Place cryovials in Mr. Frosty (or CoolCell) at -80°C overnight. Provides -1°C/min cooling rate
detailedSteps.zh: 将冻存管放入 Mr. Frosty（或 CoolCell）-80°C 过夜。提供 -1°C/min 降温速率

detailedSteps.en: Transfer to liquid nitrogen within 24–48h for long-term storage. Record location in cell inventory
detailedSteps.zh: 24–48h 内转入液氮长期保存。在细胞库记录中登记位置

note.en: Cells can remain at -80°C for up to 3 months, but transfer to liquid nitrogen for long-term viability
note.zh: 细胞可在 -80°C 保存最多 3 个月，但建议转入液氮以保持长期活力

name: Cell Thawing (Recovery)

components.name: 4. 转移至 9 mL 预热培养基
components.note: 逐滴加入, 缓冲 DMSO 浓度变化

components.name: 5. 离心 200×g, 5 min (推荐) 或直接铺板
components.note: 大多数细胞系建议离心去 DMSO; 极脆弱细胞可跳过直接铺板

components.name: 6. 弃上清, 新鲜完全培养基重悬, 接种培养瓶
8. 次日换液去除残余 DMSO 和死细胞碎片
9. 恢复 1–2 代后开始实验

notes.en: Quick-thaw to recover frozen cells. Key is speed — DMSO is cytotoxic at 37°C. Most cell lines: centrifuge to remove DMSO. Very fragile cells (e.g., primary neurons): dilute directly without centrifugation. Check viability >90% after recovery. Allow 1–2 passages before experiments.
notes.zh: 关键是速度——DMSO 在 37°C 对细胞有毒。解冻至剩小冰晶即可。大多数细胞系建议离心去 DMSO；极脆弱细胞（如原代神经元）可直接稀释铺板。恢复后确认活力 >90%。

ref: Freshney (2015) Culture of Animal Cells; ATCC Cell Thawing Protocol

usage.en: Quick-thaw protocol to recover frozen cells with minimal DMSO exposure time. The key is speed — DMSO is cytotoxic at 37°C.
usage.zh: 快速解冻恢复冻存细胞，尽量缩短 DMSO 暴露时间。关键是速度——DMSO 在 37°C 对细胞有毒性。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1h 操作时间

briefSteps.en: Pre-warm medium → thaw in 37°C water bath → transfer to flask with medium → incubate → change medium after 6–8h → recover 1–2 passages
briefSteps.zh: 预热培养基 → 37°C 水浴解冻 → 转移至含培养基的培养瓶 → 培养 → 6–8h 后换液 → 恢复 1–2 代

detailedSteps.en: Pre-warm complete medium to 37°C. Prepare flask with 9 mL medium
detailedSteps.zh: 预热完全培养基至 37°C。培养瓶中加 9 mL 培养基

detailedSteps.en: Retrieve cryovial from liquid nitrogen. Transport on dry ice
detailedSteps.zh: 从液氮中取出冻存管。干冰运输

detailedSteps.en: Thaw rapidly in 37°C water bath with gentle agitation. **Stop when a small ice crystal remains** (~1–2 min). Do not submerge cap
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 水浴快速解冻，轻柔晃动。**留小冰晶时即停止**（约 1–2 min）。勿没过管盖

detailedSteps.en: Immediately transfer thawed cells to flask with 9 mL warm medium (dilutes DMSO 1:10)
detailedSteps.zh: 立即将解冻细胞转入含 9 mL 温热培养基的培养瓶（稀释 DMSO 1:10）

detailedSteps.en: Gently rock flask to mix. Do NOT centrifuge — some cell types are fragile post-thaw
detailedSteps.zh: 轻柔摇匀。不要离心——某些细胞解冻后很脆弱

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养

detailedSteps.en: After 6–8h (or next morning), check attachment. Replace medium to remove residual DMSO and dead cells
detailedSteps.zh: 6–8h 后（或次日早上）检查贴壁情况。换液去除残余 DMSO 和死细胞

detailedSteps.en: Allow cells to recover 1–2 passages before starting experiments. Confirm viability >90%
detailedSteps.zh: 恢复 1–2 代后开始实验。确认活力 >90%

name: Bacterial Electroporation

components.name: 1. 冰上解冻电转感受态细胞 (10 min)
4. 电击: 1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω (1 mm 杯)
components.note: 2 mm 杯: 2.5 kV; 时间常数应为 4–5 ms

components.name: 7. 涂板 (含抗生素 LB 平板)

notes.en: High-efficiency transformation (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg). 10–100× more efficient than chemical transformation. DNA must be desalted (salt causes arcing). Essential for large plasmids (>10 kb) and library construction. Pulse: 1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω.
notes.zh: 高效转化 (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg)。DNA 必须脱盐，否则放电弧光。时间常数应为 4–5 ms。适用于大质粒 (>10 kb) 和文库构建。

ref: Dower et al. (1988) Nucleic Acids Res 16:6127–6145; Sambrook & Russell (2001)

usage.en: High-efficiency transformation method (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg). 10–100× more efficient than chemical transformation. Requires desalted DNA (salt causes arcing). Essential for large plasmids (>10 kb) and library construction.
usage.zh: 高效转化方法 (10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg)。效率比化学转化高 10–100 倍。DNA 必须脱盐（盐导致放电弧光）。大质粒 (>10 kb) 和文库构建必须用电转。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 3h + 过夜培养

briefSteps.en: Thaw cells on ice → add DNA → transfer to cuvette → pulse 1.8 kV → add SOC → recover 1h 37°C → plate on selective agar
briefSteps.zh: 冰上解冻细胞 → 加 DNA → 转至电转杯 → 1.8 kV 脉冲 → 加 SOC → 37°C 恢复 1h → 涂抗性平板

detailedSteps.en: Thaw electrocompetent cells on ice for 10 min. Pre-chill electroporation cuvettes on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上解冻电转感受态细胞 10 min。预冷电转杯

detailedSteps.en: Add 1–5 µL desalted DNA (1–100 ng) to cells. Mix by flicking gently. **Do NOT pipette up and down.** Keep on ice
detailedSteps.zh: 加 1–5 µL 脱盐 DNA（1–100 ng）至细胞。轻弹混匀。**不要吹打。** 保持冰上

detailedSteps.en: Transfer cell-DNA mixture to pre-chilled cuvette. Tap to settle, remove air bubbles
detailedSteps.zh: 将细胞-DNA 混合物转至预冷电转杯。轻敲使细胞沉底，去除气泡

detailedSteps.en: Dry outside of cuvette. Place in electroporator
detailedSteps.zh: 擦干电转杯外壁。放入电转仪

detailedSteps.en: Pulse: **1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω** (1 mm cuvettes). Time constant should be 4–5 ms. If arcing (loud pop) — DNA has too much salt, desalt and retry
detailedSteps.zh: 电击: **1.8 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω**（1 mm 电转杯）。时间常数应为 4–5 ms。如发生弧光（啪声）——DNA 盐分过高，脱盐后重试

detailedSteps.en: Immediately add 1 mL pre-warmed SOC medium to cuvette. Mix gently by pipetting
detailedSteps.zh: 立即向电转杯加 1 mL 预热 SOC 培养基。轻柔吹打混匀

detailedSteps.en: Transfer to culture tube. Shake at 37°C, 225 rpm for 1h (recovery)
detailedSteps.zh: 转至培养管。37°C, 225 rpm 振荡 1h（恢复）

detailedSteps.en: Plate 10 µL, 100 µL, and remaining cells on selective LB agar plates
detailedSteps.zh: 分别涂板 10 µL、100 µL 和剩余细胞至含抗生素 LB 平板

detailedSteps.en: Incubate plates at 37°C overnight
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: Count colonies. Typical efficiency: 10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg for supercoiled plasmid
detailedSteps.zh: 计数克隆。典型效率：超螺旋质粒 10⁹–10¹⁰ CFU/µg

note.en: Electrocompetent cells can be refrozen if not contaminated with DNA, but efficiency decreases
note.zh: 未接触 DNA 的电转感受态细胞可重新冻存，但效率会降低

name: Lentivirus Production & Transduction

components.name: 1. Day -1: 接种 4×10⁶ HEK293T 至 10 cm 皿
2. Day 0: 三质粒共转染
components.note: Transfer vector : psPAX2 : pMD2.G = 4:3:1 (如 10:7.5:2.5 µg/10cm 皿); PEI 或 Lipo2000 转染

components.name: 4. Day 3: 收集上清，0.45 µm 过滤
5. 转导: 病毒上清 + Polybrene 感染靶细胞
components.note: Polybrene 8 µg/mL; MOI 0.3–1 (稳转); 可 Day 2+3 收集两批上清合并

notes.en: 2nd-gen packaging: transfer + psPAX2 (Addgene #12260) + pMD2.G (#12259). BSL-2 required. Concentrate by ultracentrifugation (25,000×g 2h) or PEG-8000 for higher titer. Typical: 10⁶–10⁷ TU/mL unconcentrated, 10⁸–10⁹ after concentration. Kill curve for puromycin on parental cells first.
notes.zh: 二代包装体系：转移载体 + psPAX2 (Addgene #12260) + pMD2.G (#12259)。需 BSL-2。浓缩病毒：超速离心 (25,000×g 2h) 或 PEG-8000。未浓缩滴度 10⁶–10⁷ TU/mL，浓缩后 10⁸–10⁹。先做嘌呤霉素杀伤曲线确定筛选浓度。

ref: protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.yxmvm132ov3p; Dull et al. (1998) J Virol 72:8463–8471

usage.en: 2nd-generation lentiviral packaging in HEK293T cells for stable gene delivery. BSL-2 required. Typical titer: 10⁶–10⁷ TU/mL unconcentrated.
usage.zh: 在 HEK293T 中进行第二代慢病毒包装，用于稳定基因递送。需要 BSL-2。典型滴度：未浓缩 10⁶–10⁷ TU/mL。

label.zh: 实验方案 — BSL-2, 多天

briefSteps.en: Plate HEK293T → transfect (Lipo3000 + transfer + psPAX2 + pMD2.G) → collect virus 48h → filter 0.45 µm → transduce target cells + Polybrene → puromycin select
briefSteps.zh: 接种 HEK293T → 转染 (Lipo3000 + 转移质粒 + psPAX2 + pMD2.G) → 48h 收毒 → 0.45 µm 过滤 → 病毒 + Polybrene 感染靶细胞 → puromycin 筛选

detailedSteps.en: **Day -1**: Plate 4×10⁶ HEK293T cells in 10 cm dish with 7 mL complete DMEM. Cells should be 70-80% confluent at transfection
detailedSteps.zh: **Day -1**: 在 10 cm 皿中接种 4×10⁶ HEK293T 细胞，加 7 mL 完全 DMEM。转染时细胞应 70-80% 汇合

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0**: Prepare DNA mix in 15 mL tube: 750 µL Opti-MEM + 15 µg transfer plasmid + 10 µg psPAX2 + 5 µg pMD2.G + 60 µL P3000 reagent
detailedSteps.zh: **Day 0**: 在 15 mL 管中配制 DNA 混合物：750 µL Opti-MEM + 15 µg 转移质粒 + 10 µg psPAX2 + 5 µg pMD2.G + 60 µL P3000 试剂

detailedSteps.en: In separate tube: 750 µL Opti-MEM + 45 µL Lipofectamine 3000. Mix well
detailedSteps.zh: 另取一管：750 µL Opti-MEM + 45 µL Lipofectamine 3000。混匀

detailedSteps.en: Combine DNA and Lipofectamine tubes. Mix gently by inversion
detailedSteps.zh: 合并 DNA 管和 Lipofectamine 管。轻柔颠倒混匀

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at room temperature for 15 min
detailedSteps.zh: 室温孵育 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Add transfection complex drop-wise onto cells. Swirl gently to distribute
detailedSteps.zh: 将转染复合物逐滴加入细胞。轻柔旋转使其均匀分布

detailedSteps.en: Incubate overnight (~16h) at 37°C, 5% CO₂
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 过夜孵育（约 16h）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1**: Aspirate medium. Replace with 5 mL fresh DMEM + 10 mM HEPES
detailedSteps.zh: **Day 1**: 吸去培养基。换 5 mL 新鲜 DMEM + 10 mM HEPES

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3** (48h post-transfection): Collect supernatant into 50 mL tube
detailedSteps.zh: **Day 3**（转染后 48h）：收集上清至 50 mL 管

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 2,000 rpm, 4°C, 5 min to remove cell debris
detailedSteps.zh: 2,000 rpm, 4°C 离心 5 min 去除细胞碎片

detailedSteps.en: Filter through 0.45 µm PES filter. Virus can be used immediately or stored at 4°C for 24h
detailedSteps.zh: 0.45 µm PES 滤膜过滤。病毒可立即使用或 4°C 保存 24h

detailedSteps.en: **Transduction** — Seed target cells at 1-4×10⁵/well in 6-well plate (Day 0)
detailedSteps.zh: **转导** — 在 6 孔板中接种靶细胞 1-4×10⁵/孔（Day 0）

detailedSteps.en: Day 1: Replace medium with 2 mL virus-containing supernatant + 8 µg/mL Polybrene
detailedSteps.zh: Day 1: 换液为 2 mL 含病毒上清 + 8 µg/mL Polybrene

detailedSteps.en: Day 2: Replace virus medium with fresh complete medium
detailedSteps.zh: Day 2: 将病毒培养基换为新鲜完全培养基

detailedSteps.en: Day 4: Begin puromycin selection (1 µg/mL). Continue for 72h
detailedSteps.zh: Day 4: 开始 puromycin 筛选（1 µg/mL）。持续 72h

detailedSteps.en: Day 7+: Maintain selection. Passage at least 2× before removing from BSL-2
detailedSteps.zh: Day 7+: 维持筛选。至少传代 2 次后方可移出 BSL-2

note.en: Filtered virus can be aliquoted and snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen. Store at -80°C (titer drops ~50% per freeze-thaw cycle)
note.zh: 过滤后的病毒可分装并液氮速冻。-80°C 保存（每次冻融滴度下降约 50%）

name: Gibson Assembly

components.name: 1. 设计引物 (15-25 bp 重叠区)
3. 冰上配制反应: Master Mix + DNA 片段

notes.en: Seamless, scarless DNA assembly. Joins 2-6 fragments with 15-25 bp overlaps in a single isothermal reaction. No restriction enzymes or ligase needed separately — T5 exonuclease, Phusion polymerase, and Taq ligase work together in one tube.
notes.zh: 无缝无疤 DNA 组装。通过 15-25 bp 重叠区在单一等温反应中连接 2-6 个片段。无需单独使用限制酶或连接酶——T5 外切酶、Phusion 聚合酶和 Taq 连接酶在同一管中协同工作。

ref: Gibson et al. (2009) Nat Methods 6:343–345; NEB Protocol E5510 (protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.bdddi226)

usage.en: Seamless, scarless DNA assembly. Joins 2-6 fragments with 15-25 bp overlaps in a single isothermal reaction.
usage.zh: 无缝无疤 DNA 组装。通过 15-25 bp 重叠区在单一等温反应中连接 2-6 个片段。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 1h 反应 + 转化

briefSteps.en: Design overlapping primers → PCR amplify fragments → assemble at 50°C (15-60 min) → transform → plate
briefSteps.zh: 设计重叠引物 → PCR 扩增片段 → 50°C 组装 (15-60 min) → 转化 → 涂板

detailedSteps.en: Design primers with 15-25 bp overlapping regions between adjacent fragments. Use NEBuilder (nebuilder.neb.com) for primer design
detailedSteps.zh: 设计引物，使相邻片段间有 15-25 bp 重叠区。使用 NEBuilder (nebuilder.neb.com) 辅助设计

detailedSteps.en: PCR-amplify fragments with high-fidelity polymerase (Q5 or Phusion). Gel-purify or clean up
detailedSteps.zh: 用高保真聚合酶（Q5 或 Phusion）PCR 扩增片段。凝胶纯化或柱纯化

detailedSteps.en: On ice, set up reaction: 10 µL Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2×) + DNA fragments (0.02-0.5 pmol for 2-3 fragments; 0.2-1 pmol for 4-6 fragments) + ddH₂O to 20 µL total
detailedSteps.zh: 冰上配制反应体系：10 µL Gibson Assembly Master Mix (2×) + DNA 片段（2-3 个片段用 0.02-0.5 pmol；4-6 个片段用 0.2-1 pmol）+ ddH₂O 补至 20 µL

detailedSteps.en: Optimal ratio: 3:1 insert:vector molar ratio. Use NEBioCalculator for pmol conversion
detailedSteps.zh: 最佳比例：插入片段:载体 = 3:1 摩尔比。用 NEBioCalculator 计算 pmol

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 50°C for 15 min (2-3 fragments) or 60 min (4-6 fragments) in thermocycler
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 仪中 50°C 孵育 15 min（2-3 个片段）或 60 min（4-6 个片段）

detailedSteps.en: Place on ice or store at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: 置于冰上或 -20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: Transform 2 µL of assembly reaction into competent cells (chemical or electroporation)
detailedSteps.zh: 取 2 µL 组装产物转化感受态细胞（化学转化或电转）

detailedSteps.en: Plate on selective media. Screen colonies by colony PCR or restriction digest
detailedSteps.zh: 涂选择性平板。通过菌落 PCR 或酶切筛选克隆

name: Site-Directed Mutagenesis (Q5/KLD)

components.name: 2. Q5 反向 PCR 扩增

notes.en: Introduce point mutations, insertions, or deletions into plasmid DNA. Based on inverse PCR with phosphorylation, ligation, and DpnI digestion of template in a single KLD step.
notes.zh: 在质粒 DNA 中引入点突变、插入或缺失。基于反向 PCR，在单一 KLD 步骤中完成磷酸化、连接和 DpnI 消化模板。

ref: NEB Q5 SDM Kit Protocol E0554 (protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.bddei23e)

usage.en: Introduce point mutations, insertions, or deletions into plasmid DNA. Based on inverse PCR with KLD (Kinase-Ligase-DpnI) treatment.
usage.zh: 在质粒 DNA 中引入点突变、插入或缺失。基于反向 PCR + KLD（激酶-连接酶-DpnI）处理。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 4h（PCR + KLD + 转化）

briefSteps.en: Design back-to-back mutagenic primers → Q5 inverse PCR → KLD reaction (5 min RT) → transform → sequence-verify
briefSteps.zh: 设计背靠背突变引物 → Q5 反向 PCR → KLD 反应（RT 5 min）→ 转化 → 测序验证

detailedSteps.en: Design mutagenic primers using NEBaseChanger (nebasechanger.neb.com). Primers should be back-to-back on the template
detailedSteps.zh: 使用 NEBaseChanger (nebasechanger.neb.com) 设计突变引物。引物应在模板上背靠背排列

detailedSteps.en: Set up PCR: 12.5 µL Q5 2× Master Mix + 1.25 µL forward primer (10 µM) + 1.25 µL reverse primer (10 µM) + 1 µL template (1-25 ng) + 9 µL ddH₂O
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 PCR 体系：12.5 µL Q5 2× Master Mix + 1.25 µL 正向引物 (10 µM) + 1.25 µL 反向引物 (10 µM) + 1 µL 模板 (1-25 ng) + 9 µL ddH₂O

detailedSteps.en: PCR cycling: 98°C 30s initial denaturation → 25 cycles of (98°C 10s → Tm°C 10-30s → 72°C 20-30s/kb) → 72°C 2 min final extension → hold 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 程序：98°C 30s 初始变性 → 25 个循环（98°C 10s → Tm°C 10-30s → 72°C 20-30s/kb）→ 72°C 2 min 终延伸 → 4°C 保持

detailedSteps.en: Check PCR product on 1% agarose gel. Should see a single band at expected size
detailedSteps.zh: 1% 琼脂糖凝胶检测 PCR 产物。应看到预期大小的单一条带

detailedSteps.en: Set up KLD reaction: 1 µL PCR product + 5 µL KLD Buffer (2×) + 1 µL KLD Enzyme Mix (10×) + 3 µL ddH₂O
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 KLD 反应：1 µL PCR 产物 + 5 µL KLD Buffer (2×) + 1 µL KLD Enzyme Mix (10×) + 3 µL ddH₂O

detailedSteps.en: Mix by pipetting. Incubate at room temperature for 5 min
detailedSteps.zh: 吹打混匀。室温孵育 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Transform 5 µL KLD mix into 50 µL competent cells. Ice 30 min → heat shock 42°C 30s → ice 5 min
detailedSteps.zh: 取 5 µL KLD 混合物转化 50 µL 感受态细胞。冰浴 30 min → 42°C 热激 30s → 冰浴 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Add 950 µL SOC. Shake at 37°C for 1h
detailedSteps.zh: 加 950 µL SOC。37°C 振荡 1h

detailedSteps.en: Plate 50-100 µL on selective plates. Incubate overnight at 37°C
detailedSteps.zh: 取 50-100 µL 涂板。37°C 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: Pick 2-4 colonies for sequencing. Typical mutagenesis efficiency: >80%
detailedSteps.zh: 挑 2-4 个克隆送测序。典型突变效率：>80%

name: Transwell Migration Assay

components.name: 2. 下室加含血清培养基，上室加细胞
4. 棉签擦除上表面未迁移细胞
6. 镜下计数 5 个随机视野

notes.en: Quantitative assay for cell migration/invasion using Boyden chamber principle. Cells migrate through 8 µm pores toward chemoattractant (serum). For invasion assay, coat inserts with Matrigel. Count migrated cells on lower surface after crystal violet staining.
notes.zh: 基于 Boyden 小室原理的定量细胞迁移/侵袭实验。细胞通过 8 µm 孔向趋化因子（血清）迁移。侵袭实验需在膜上涂 Matrigel。结晶紫染色后计数下表面迁移细胞。

ref: Justus et al. (2014) J Vis Exp 88:e51046; protocols.io doi:10.17504/protocols.io.261ge3d5ov47

usage.en: Quantitative assay for cell migration/invasion using Boyden chamber principle. Count migrated cells after crystal violet staining.
usage.zh: 基于 Boyden 小室原理的定量细胞迁移/侵袭实验。结晶紫染色后计数迁移细胞。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 2 天（饥饿 + 迁移）

briefSteps.en: Serum-starve → seed cells in upper chamber (serum-free) → chemoattractant in lower → incubate 16-24h → swab upper surface → fix → crystal violet stain → count
briefSteps.zh: 血清饥饿 → 上室接种细胞（无血清）→ 下室加趋化因子 → 孵育 16-24h → 棉签擦上表面 → 固定 → 结晶紫染色 → 计数

detailedSteps.en: Serum-starve cells for 12-24h before assay to synchronize migration response
detailedSteps.zh: 实验前血清饥饿 12-24h 以同步迁移响应

detailedSteps.en: Optional (invasion assay): Coat upper surface of Transwell insert with 50 µL Matrigel (1:8 dilution in serum-free medium). Incubate 1-2h at 37°C to solidify
detailedSteps.zh: 可选（侵袭实验）：在 Transwell 上表面涂 50 µL Matrigel（无血清培养基 1:8 稀释）。37°C 孵育 1-2h 凝固

detailedSteps.en: Add 600 µL complete medium (10% FBS) to lower chamber of 24-well plate as chemoattractant. For negative control, use serum-free medium in lower chamber
detailedSteps.zh: 在 24 孔板下室加 600 µL 完全培养基（10% FBS）作为趋化因子。阴性对照：下室加无血清培养基

detailedSteps.en: Trypsinize starved cells, count, and resuspend in serum-free medium at 2-5×10⁵ cells/mL
detailedSteps.zh: 消化饥饿细胞，计数，用无血清培养基重悬至 2-5×10⁵ cells/mL

detailedSteps.en: Add 200 µL cell suspension to upper chamber of Transwell insert (4-10×10⁴ cells)
detailedSteps.zh: 取 200 µL 细胞悬液加入 Transwell 上室（4-10×10⁴ 个细胞）

detailedSteps.en: Carefully place insert into well. Avoid air bubbles between insert and lower medium
detailedSteps.zh: 小心将小室放入孔中。避免小室与下室液面间产生气泡

detailedSteps.en: Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 16-24h (varies by cell type; fast migrators like MDA-MB-231 may need only 8h)
detailedSteps.zh: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 孵育 16-24h（因细胞类型而异；快速迁移细胞如 MDA-MB-231 可能只需 8h）

detailedSteps.en: Remove insert. Gently wipe upper surface with moist cotton swab to remove non-migrated cells. Repeat 2-3×
detailedSteps.zh: 取出小室。用湿棉签轻轻擦拭上表面去除未迁移细胞。重复 2-3 次

detailedSteps.en: Fix cells on lower surface: dip in methanol for 10 min or 4% PFA for 15 min
detailedSteps.zh: 固定下表面细胞：浸入甲醇 10 min 或 4% PFA 15 min

detailedSteps.en: Stain with 0.5% crystal violet for 20 min. Rinse excess stain in water
detailedSteps.zh: 0.5% 结晶紫染色 20 min。水洗去多余染液

detailedSteps.en: Air-dry inserts. Image 5 random fields per insert under microscope (20× objective)
detailedSteps.zh: 晾干小室。显微镜下（20× 物镜）每个小室随机拍摄 5 个视野

detailedSteps.en: **Analysis**: Count stained cells per field using ImageJ. Report as average cells/field ± SEM. Compare conditions by t-test or ANOVA
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**：用 ImageJ 计数每视野染色细胞。报告平均 cells/field ± SEM。用 t 检验或 ANOVA 比较各组

name: Mycoplasma Detection by PCR

components.name: 6. 判读: ~270 bp 条带 = 阳性

notes.en: Fast, sensitive PCR-based detection of mycoplasma contamination in cell cultures. Uses universal primers GPO-3/MGSO targeting 16S rRNA gene. Positive result: ~270 bp band. Test every cell line every 2-4 weeks.
notes.zh: 快速灵敏的 PCR 法检测细胞培养支原体污染。使用靶向 16S rRNA 基因的通用引物 GPO-3/MGSO。阳性结果：约 270 bp 条带。每 2-4 周检测一次。

ref: van Kuppeveld et al. (1994) Appl Environ Microbiol 60:149-152; Young et al. (2010) Nat Protoc 5:929-934

usage.en: Fast, sensitive PCR-based detection of mycoplasma contamination in cell cultures. Test every cell line every 2-4 weeks.
usage.zh: 快速灵敏的 PCR 法检测细胞培养支原体污染。每 2-4 周检测一次。

label.zh: 实验方案 — 约 3h（准备 + PCR + 跑胶）

briefSteps.en: Collect conditioned medium → pellet mycoplasma → boil to lyse → PCR (GPO-3/MGSO) → 2% agarose gel → ~270 bp band = positive
briefSteps.zh: 收集条件培养基 → 离心沉淀支原体 → 煮沸裂解 → PCR (GPO-3/MGSO) → 2% 琼脂糖凝胶 → ~270 bp 条带 = 阳性

detailedSteps.en: Collect 1 mL conditioned medium from cells cultured 48-72h without medium change. Use supernatant (mycoplasma is extracellular)
detailedSteps.zh: 收集 1 mL 未换液培养 48-72h 的条件培养基。使用上清（支原体为胞外寄生）

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge at 250 × g for 5 min to pellet cells. Transfer supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: 250 × g 离心 5 min 沉淀细胞。转移上清

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge supernatant at 15,000 × g for 10 min. Discard supernatant. Resuspend pellet in 50 µL ddH₂O
detailedSteps.zh: 上清 15,000 × g 离心 10 min。弃上清。用 50 µL ddH₂O 重悬沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Boil at 95°C for 10 min to lyse mycoplasma and release DNA. Quick-spin
detailedSteps.zh: 95°C 煮沸 10 min 裂解支原体释放 DNA。快速离心

detailedSteps.en: Set up PCR: 12.5 µL Taq 2× Master Mix + 1 µL GPO-3 primer (10 µM) + 1 µL MGSO primer (10 µM) + 2 µL template (boiled supernatant) + 8.5 µL ddH₂O
detailedSteps.zh: 配制 PCR：12.5 µL Taq 2× Master Mix + 1 µL GPO-3 引物 (10 µM) + 1 µL MGSO 引物 (10 µM) + 2 µL 模板（煮沸上清）+ 8.5 µL ddH₂O

detailedSteps.en: Include positive control (known contaminated DNA or synthetic template) and negative control (ddH₂O)
detailedSteps.zh: 设阳性对照（已知污染 DNA 或合成模板）和阴性对照（ddH₂O）

detailedSteps.en: PCR cycling: 94°C 5 min → 35 cycles of (94°C 30s → 55°C 30s → 72°C 30s) → 72°C 5 min
detailedSteps.zh: PCR 程序：94°C 5 min → 35 个循环（94°C 30s → 55°C 30s → 72°C 30s）→ 72°C 5 min

detailedSteps.en: Run products on 2% agarose gel with 100 bp ladder. Look for band at ~270 bp
detailedSteps.zh: 2% 琼脂糖凝胶电泳，加 100 bp ladder。观察 ~270 bp 处条带

detailedSteps.en: **Interpretation**: Band at ~270 bp = POSITIVE (contaminated). No band = NEGATIVE. Positive control must show band for valid test. If contaminated: discard cells, bleach hood, check medium and reagents
detailedSteps.zh: **判读**：~270 bp 条带 = 阳性（污染）。无条带 = 阴性。阳性对照必须出带才有效。若污染：丢弃细胞，漂白超净台，检查培养基和试剂

name: Polybrene Stock (10 mg/mL)

notes.en: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm after dissolving. Aliquot 100-500 µL and freeze. Working concentration typically 4-8 µg/mL. Polybrene enhances viral adsorption by neutralizing charge. Some cells (e.g. primary T cells) are sensitive — reduce concentration or use protamine sulfate instead.
notes.zh: 溶解后 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。分装为 100-500 µL 小份冻存。使用浓度通常为 4-8 µg/mL。Polybrene 通过中和电荷增强病毒吸附。某些细胞（如原代 T 细胞）对 Polybrene 敏感，需降低浓度或改用 protamine sulfate。

ref: Davis et al. (2004) Curr Protoc Mol Biol 9.9

usage.en: Cationic polymer that enhances retroviral/lentiviral transduction by neutralizing charge repulsion between virions and cell surface.
usage.zh: 阳离子聚合物，通过中和病毒颗粒与细胞表面的电荷排斥增强逆转录/慢病毒转导效率。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 12 个月

prepSteps.en: Dissolve {v:100:mg} Polybrene in {v:10:mL} sterile ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 {v:100:mg} Polybrene 溶于 {v:10:mL} 无菌 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 100-500 µL per tube. Store at -20°C

name: Gibson Assembly Master Mix (1.33×)

notes.en: 5× ISO Buffer: 25% PEG-8000, 500 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM MgCl₂, 50 mM DTT, 1 mM each dNTP, 5 mM NAD. Aliquot 15 µL/tube after preparation. Each reaction: 15 µL mastermix + 5 µL DNA fragments. Cost approximately 1/10 of commercial kit.
notes.zh: 5× ISO Buffer: 25% PEG-8000, 500 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM MgCl₂, 50 mM DTT, 1 mM each dNTP, 5 mM NAD. 制备后分装 15 µL/管冻存。每反应加 15 µL mastermix + 5 µL DNA。成本约为商业试剂盒的 1/10。

ref: Gibson et al. (2009) Nat Methods 6:343–345

usage.en: Homemade isothermal assembly master mix. 1/10 cost of commercial kit. T5 exonuclease + Phusion + Taq ligase in optimized buffer.
usage.zh: 自配等温组装反应液。成本约为商业试剂盒的 1/10。T5 外切酶 + Phusion + Taq 连接酶在优化缓冲液中。

label.zh: -20°C 分装 (15 µL), 避免反复冻融

prepSteps.en: Prepare 5× ISO Buffer: 25% PEG-8000, 500 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM MgCl₂, 50 mM DTT, 1 mM each dNTP, 5 mM NAD
prepSteps.zh: 配制 5× ISO Buffer: 25% PEG-8000, 500 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM MgCl₂, 50 mM DTT, 各 1 mM dNTP, 5 mM NAD

prepSteps.en: Mix ISO Buffer with enzymes and ddH₂O on ice
prepSteps.zh: 冰上混合 ISO Buffer、酶和 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Aliquot 15 µL per tube. Store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装 15 µL/管。-20°C 保存

name: Matrigel Coating Solution

notes.en: Keep everything on ice! Matrigel solidifies above 10°C. Use pre-chilled pipette tips and tubes. Working concentration ~1-2 mg/mL (1:8 to 1:6 dilution). Apply 50 µL per Transwell insert, incubate 1-2h at 37°C to solidify.
notes.zh: 全程冰上操作！Matrigel 在 10°C 以上即凝固。使用预冷的枪头和管。工作浓度约 1-2 mg/mL（1:8 到 1:6 稀释）。Transwell 膜需 50 µL/insert，37°C 孵育 1-2h 凝固。

ref: Corning Matrigel Matrix Technical Guide; Justus et al. (2014) J Vis Exp 88:e51046

usage.en: Diluted Matrigel for coating Transwell inserts (invasion assay) or culture surfaces (3D culture, organoids).
usage.zh: 稀释的 Matrigel，用于包被 Transwell 膜（侵袭实验）或培养表面（3D 培养、类器官）。

label.en: Prepare fresh on ice; stock at -20°C
label.zh: 冰上现配；母液 -20°C 保存

prepSteps.en: Thaw Matrigel stock overnight at 4°C on ice (NEVER at RT)
prepSteps.zh: 4°C 冰上过夜解冻 Matrigel 母液（绝不在室温解冻）

prepSteps.en: Dilute 1:8 in ice-cold serum-free medium using pre-chilled tips
prepSteps.zh: 用预冷枪头在冰冷无血清培养基中 1:8 稀释

prepSteps.en: Apply 50 µL per Transwell insert. Incubate 1-2h at 37°C to solidify
prepSteps.zh: 每个 Transwell 加 50 µL。37°C 孵育 1-2h 凝固

name: Chloroquine Diphosphate Stock (25 mM)
nameCn: 氯喹二磷酸盐母液 (25 mM)

notes.en: Filter-sterilize 0.22 µm. Aliquot and protect from light. Working concentration 25 µM (1:1000 dilution). Chloroquine inhibits endosomal acidification, improving CaPO₄ and PEI transfection efficiency. Must replace medium within 5h — prolonged exposure is cytotoxic.
notes.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌。分装避光保存。使用浓度 25 µM（1:1000 稀释）。氯喹抑制内体酸化，提高 CaPO₄ 和 PEI 转染效率。加入培养基后 5h 内须更换培养基，氯喹长时间暴露有细胞毒性。

ref: Luthman & Magnusson (1983) Nucleic Acids Res 11:1295

usage.en: Lysosomotropic agent that inhibits endosomal acidification, enhancing CaPO₄ and PEI transfection efficiency in lentivirus production.
usage.zh: 溶酶体趋向试剂，抑制内体酸化，提高 CaPO₄ 和 PEI 转染效率，用于慢病毒包装。

label.zh: -20°C 分装, 6 个月, 避光

prepSteps.en: Dissolve {v:129:mg} chloroquine diphosphate in {v:10:mL} sterile ddH₂O
prepSteps.zh: 将 {v:129:mg} 氯喹二磷酸盐溶于 {v:10:mL} 无菌 ddH₂O

prepSteps.en: Filter-sterilize through 0.22 µm
prepSteps.zh: 0.22 µm 过滤除菌

prepSteps.en: Aliquot in amber tubes or wrap in foil. Store at -20°C
prepSteps.zh: 分装至棕色管或锡箔包裹。-20°C 保存

name: BSA Standard Curve (BCA/Bradford)

notes.en: Prepare in same buffer as samples. BCA: 37°C 30 min, A562. Bradford: RT 5 min, A595. Triplicate.
notes.zh: 用与样品相同的缓冲液配制。BCA：37°C 30 min，A562。Bradford：室温 5 min，A595。三重复。

ref: Smith et al. (1985) Anal Biochem 150:76 / Bradford (1976) Anal Biochem 72:248

name: EMSA Binding Buffer (5×)

notes.en: Dilute to 1× for binding. Add poly(dI-dC) as competitor. Run non-denaturing PAGE 5-6% in 0.5× TBE at 4°C.
notes.zh: 结合反应稀释至 1×。加 poly(dI-dC) 作为非特异竞争物。4°C 0.5× TBE 中 5-6% 非变性 PAGE。

ref: Garner & Revzin (1981) Nucleic Acids Res 9:3047

name: Kinase Assay Buffer

notes.en: Universal in vitro kinase assay buffer. Add DTT and phosphatase inhibitors fresh.
notes.zh: 通用体外激酶检测缓冲液。DTT 和磷酸酶抑制剂需临用加入。

ref: Cell Signaling Technology #9802

name: Luciferase Reporter Lysis Buffer

notes.en: Gentle lysis preserves luciferase activity. Lyse 15 min RT. Use 20 µL lysate + 100 µL substrate.
notes.zh: 温和裂解保留荧光素酶活性。室温 15 min。20 µL 裂解液 + 100 µL 底物。

ref: Promega E1500

name: Sodium Orthovanadate (100 mM)

notes.en: Tyrosine phosphatase inhibitor. Must activate: pH 10, boil, cool, readjust. Repeat until stable and colorless. Use 1 mM final.
notes.zh: 酪氨酸磷酸酶抑制剂。需活化：调 pH 10，煮沸，冷却，再调 pH。重复至溶液稳定无色。终浓度 1 mM。

ref: Gordon (1991) Methods Enzymol 201:477

name: Tail Lysis Buffer (Mouse Genotyping)

notes.en: Add Proteinase K fresh to 100 µg/mL. Digest 55°C overnight. Inactivate 95°C 10 min. Use 1 µL in PCR.
notes.zh: 临用加 Proteinase K 至 100 µg/mL。55°C 过夜消化。95°C 灭活 10 min。1 µL 直接用于 PCR。

ref: Truett et al. (2000) BioTechniques 29:52

name: Annexin V / PI Apoptosis Assay
nameCn: Annexin V / PI 凋亡检测

components.name: 4. Add 5 µL FITC-Annexin V + 5 µL PI
7. Analyze by flow cytometry within 1 h

notes.en: AV⁻/PI⁻=live; AV⁺/PI⁻=early apoptosis; AV⁺/PI⁺=late apoptosis; AV⁻/PI⁺=necrosis. CaCl₂ essential. Positive control: staurosporine 1 µM 6 h.
notes.zh: AV⁻/PI⁻=活；AV⁺/PI⁻=早期凋亡；AV⁺/PI⁺=晚期凋亡；AV⁻/PI⁺=坏死。需含 CaCl₂。阳性对照：星形孢菌素 1 µM 6 h。

ref: Vermes et al. (1995) J Immunol Methods 184:39

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → wash PBS → resuspend in binding buffer → add Annexin V-FITC + PI → incubate 15 min dark → analyze by flow cytometry
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞 → PBS 洗涤 → 结合缓冲液重悬 → 加 Annexin V-FITC + PI → 避光孵育 15 min → 流式细胞术分析

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare cells**: Treat cells with apoptosis-inducing agent (e.g., staurosporine 1 µM, 6 h) and include untreated control. Aim for 1–5×10⁵ cells per sample
detailedSteps.zh: **准备细胞**: 用凋亡诱导剂处理细胞（如星形孢菌素 1 µM，6 h），并设未处理对照。每个样品准备 1–5×10⁵ 个细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Collect both floating and adherent cells. For adherent cells: collect supernatant (contains dead cells), trypsinize briefly (no EDTA-only dissociation preferred), combine with supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **收集细胞**: 收集悬浮和贴壁细胞。贴壁细胞：先收集上清（含死细胞），短暂胰酶消化（优先用不含EDTA的解离液），合并上清

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Centrifuge 300×g, 5 min, 4°C. Discard supernatant. Wash pellet with 1 mL cold PBS
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 300×g 离心 5 min，4°C。弃上清。用 1 mL 预冷 PBS 洗涤细胞沉淀

detailedSteps.en: Centrifuge again 300×g, 5 min, 4°C. Remove supernatant completely
detailedSteps.zh: 再次 300×g 离心 5 min，4°C。彻底去除上清

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Resuspend cells in 100 µL 1× Binding Buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂). ⚠️ CaCl₂ is essential — Annexin V requires Ca²⁺ for PS binding
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 用 100 µL 1× 结合缓冲液（10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂）重悬细胞。⚠️ CaCl₂ 必不可少——Annexin V 需要 Ca²⁺ 才能结合磷脂酰丝氨酸

detailedSteps.en: **Add dyes**: Add 5 µL Annexin V-FITC and 5 µL PI (50 µg/mL stock) to each sample. Prepare single-stain controls: (1) unstained, (2) Annexin V only, (3) PI only
detailedSteps.zh: **加染料**: 每个样品加 5 µL Annexin V-FITC 和 5 µL PI（50 µg/mL 储液）。准备单染对照：(1) 未染色，(2) 仅 Annexin V，(3) 仅 PI

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Gently vortex and incubate 15 min at RT in the dark. ⚠️ Do not exceed 20 min — PI can penetrate live cells with prolonged exposure
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 轻柔涡旋后室温避光孵育 15 min。⚠️ 不超过 20 min——PI 长时间接触会渗入活细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute**: Add 400 µL 1× Binding Buffer to each tube. Keep on ice
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释**: 每管加 400 µL 1× 结合缓冲液。置于冰上

detailedSteps.en: **Flow cytometry**: Analyze within 1 h on flow cytometer. Use FITC channel (Ex 488 nm / Em 530 nm) for Annexin V and PE-Texas Red channel (Ex 488 nm / Em 617 nm) for PI
detailedSteps.zh: **流式检测**: 1 h 内上机检测。Annexin V 用 FITC 通道（Ex 488 nm / Em 530 nm），PI 用 PE-Texas Red 通道（Ex 488 nm / Em 617 nm）

detailedSteps.en: **Gate and analyze**: Set compensation using single-stain controls. Gate: AV⁻/PI⁻ = live, AV⁺/PI⁻ = early apoptosis, AV⁺/PI⁺ = late apoptosis/necrosis, AV⁻/PI⁺ = necrosis. Collect ≥10,000 events per sample
detailedSteps.zh: **设门分析**: 用单染对照设补偿。设门：AV⁻/PI⁻ = 活细胞，AV⁺/PI⁻ = 早期凋亡，AV⁺/PI⁺ = 晚期凋亡/坏死，AV⁻/PI⁺ = 坏死。每样品收集 ≥10,000 个事件

note.en: 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂
note.zh: 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 140 mM NaCl, 2.5 mM CaCl₂
1 mM DMSO 储液（阳性对照）

name: Bacterial Glycerol Stock Preparation

components.name: 1. 挑单克隆 → 接种 3–5 mL LB + 抗性
3. 取 500 µL 菌液 + 500 µL 50% 甘油
components.note: 终浓度 25% 甘油; 或用 15% DMSO

components.name: 5. 标记管子（菌株、质粒、抗性、日期）

notes.en: Mix 500 µL overnight culture + 500 µL 50% glycerol (final 15-25%). Flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen. Store at -80°C for years. Recovery: streak on LB+antibiotic plate from frozen stock.
notes.zh: 复苏：用无菌枪头刮取少量冻存菌（不要完全解冻！），直接划板或接种液体培养基。正确保存可存活 >10 年。做 2 份备份放不同冰箱。甘油需灭菌。标签用防冻标记笔或防冻标签。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; Addgene Protocol: Making Glycerol Stocks

briefSteps.en: Inoculate single colony → grow overnight → mix with sterile glycerol → flash-freeze → store -80°C
briefSteps.zh: 挑单克隆 → 过夜培养 → 与无菌甘油混合 → 速冻 → -80°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Inoculation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 接种**

detailedSteps.en: **Pick colony**: Using a sterile pipette tip or loop, pick a single isolated colony from a freshly streaked plate (<2 weeks old)
detailedSteps.zh: **挑取单克隆**: 用无菌枪头或接种环，从新划线的平板（<2 周）上挑取一个单克隆

detailedSteps.en: **Inoculate**: Transfer colony into 3–5 mL LB broth supplemented with appropriate antibiotic (e.g., 100 µg/mL ampicillin or 50 µg/mL kanamycin) in a 14 mL culture tube
detailedSteps.zh: **接种**: 将克隆转移至含适当抗生素（如 100 µg/mL 氨苄青霉素或 50 µg/mL 卡那霉素）的 3–5 mL LB 培养基中，使用 14 mL 培养管

detailedSteps.en: **Overnight culture**: Incubate 37°C, 220 rpm shaking, 12–16 h. ⚠️ Do not exceed 16 h — stationary phase bacteria have lower viability for freezing
detailedSteps.zh: **过夜培养**: 37°C, 220 rpm 振荡培养 12–16 h。⚠️ 不超过 16 h——静止期细菌冻存活力降低

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Stock Preparation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 甘油菌制备**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare cryovials**: Label cryovials with strain name, plasmid, antibiotic resistance, date, and your initials. Use cryo-resistant labels or cryo marker
detailedSteps.zh: **准备冻存管**: 标记菌株名、质粒、抗性、日期和姓名缩写。使用防冻标签或防冻记号笔

detailedSteps.en: **Mix culture and glycerol**: Add 500 µL overnight culture to 500 µL sterile 50% glycerol (final concentration ~25% glycerol). Mix by gentle vortexing or inverting 5×
detailedSteps.zh: **混合培养物和甘油**: 取 500 µL 过夜培养物加入 500 µL 无菌 50% 甘油（终浓度约 25% 甘油）。轻柔涡旋或颠倒 5 次混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Flash-freeze**: Immediately snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen or dry ice/ethanol bath. ⚠️ Do NOT let the tube sit at RT — glycerol is toxic to bacteria at room temperature
detailedSteps.zh: **速冻**: 立即液氮或干冰/乙醇浴速冻。⚠️ 不要让管子停留在室温——甘油在室温下对细菌有毒性

detailedSteps.en: **Store**: Transfer to -80°C freezer. Make at least 2 backup vials stored in different freezers if possible
detailedSteps.zh: **保存**: 转移至 -80°C 冰箱。至少制备 2 管备份，可能的话存放在不同冰箱

detailedSteps.en: **Recovery verification** (optional): Streak a small amount from the frozen stock onto a selective plate to verify viability. Incubate 37°C overnight. ⚠️ Never fully thaw the stock — scrape from the surface with a sterile tip
detailedSteps.zh: **复苏验证**（可选）：从冻存管表面刮取少量菌体划线到选择性平板验证活力。37°C 过夜培养。⚠️ 切勿完全解冻——用无菌枪头从表面刮取

note.en: e.g., ampicillin 100 mg/mL stock, kanamycin 50 mg/mL stock
note.zh: 如氨苄青霉素 100 mg/mL 储液，卡那霉素 50 mg/mL 储液

note.en: Glycerol stock stable at -80°C for >10 years
note.zh: 甘油菌 -80°C 可保存 >10 年

name: BCA Protein Assay

components.name: 1. 准备 BSA 标准品稀释系列
2. 配制 BCA 工作液 (Reagent A:B = 50:1)
3. 96 孔板加样：25 µL 标准品/样品 per well
4. 加 200 µL BCA 工作液到每个孔
8. 标准曲线计算样品浓度
components.note: 四参数拟合或线性回归

notes.en: BCA assay is compatible with up to 5% SDS but not with reducing agents (DTT, β-ME). Standard range: 25-2000 µg/mL. For low-concentration samples, use Micro BCA kit (0.5-20 µg/mL). R² > 0.99 for standard curve. Bradford assay is an alternative (Coomassie binding, 595 nm) but incompatible with detergents.
notes.zh: 比 Bradford 更耐去垢剂（兼容 1% SDS, 1% Triton X-100）。还原剂（DTT, β-ME）和 EDTA 会干扰——需用 BCA Compatible 试剂盒或预稀释。工作液可保持稳定 24 h。样品建议做 1:5 和 1:10 两个稀释度确保在标准曲线范围内。

ref: Smith et al. (1985) Anal Biochem 150:76–85; Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit manual

briefSteps.en: Prepare standards → mix samples with BCA working reagent → incubate 37°C 30 min → read A562 → calculate concentration from standard curve
briefSteps.zh: 配制标准品 → 混合样品与 BCA 工作液 → 37°C 孵育 30 min → 读取 A562 → 标准曲线计算浓度

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare BSA standards**: Dilute 2 mg/mL BSA stock in the same buffer as your samples. Prepare 7-point serial dilution: 2000, 1500, 1000, 750, 500, 250, 125 µg/mL, plus blank (buffer only)
detailedSteps.zh: **配制 BSA 标准品**: 用与样品相同的缓冲液稀释 2 mg/mL BSA 储液。配制 7 点倍比稀释系列：2000, 1500, 1000, 750, 500, 250, 125 µg/mL，加空白对照（仅缓冲液）

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare working reagent (WR)**: Mix Reagent A and Reagent B at 50:1 ratio (v/v). Prepare enough for all standards and samples in duplicate (200 µL WR per well). WR is stable for 24 h at RT
detailedSteps.zh: **配制工作液 (WR)**: 按 50:1（v/v）混合试剂 A 和试剂 B。配制足够量（每孔 200 µL WR），所有标准品和样品均做双复孔。工作液室温 24 h 内稳定

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare samples**: Dilute protein lysates as needed (typically 1:5 to 1:20). ⚠️ Ensure samples do not contain >1 mM DTT, >0.01% β-ME, or >5 mM EDTA — these interfere with BCA reaction
detailedSteps.zh: **准备样品**: 根据需要稀释蛋白裂解液（通常 1:5 至 1:20）。⚠️ 确保样品中不含 >1 mM DTT、>0.01% β-ME 或 >5 mM EDTA——这些物质会干扰 BCA 反应

detailedSteps.en: **Load plate**: Pipet 25 µL of each standard and sample into a 96-well plate in duplicate. Use a multichannel pipette for consistency
detailedSteps.zh: **加样**: 用移液器将 25 µL 标准品和样品加入 96 孔板，每样品做双复孔。使用多通道移液器以保证一致性

detailedSteps.en: **Add WR**: Add 200 µL working reagent to each well. Mix on plate shaker for 30 s
detailedSteps.zh: **加工作液**: 每孔加 200 µL 工作液。平板振荡器上混匀 30 s

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Cover plate and incubate at 37°C for 30 min. Solution turns purple in proportion to protein concentration
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 盖上板盖，37°C 孵育 30 min。溶液变紫色，颜色深浅与蛋白浓度成正比

detailedSteps.en: **Cool**: Allow plate to cool to RT for 5 min. Color is stable for ~10 min after cooling
detailedSteps.zh: **冷却**: 室温冷却 5 min。冷却后颜色稳定约 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Read absorbance**: Measure at 562 nm (or 540–590 nm) on a microplate reader. Subtract blank absorbance
detailedSteps.zh: **读取吸光度**: 用酶标仪在 562 nm（或 540–590 nm）测定。减去空白对照吸光度

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate**: Plot standard curve (concentration vs. A562). Fit with 4-parameter logistic or quadratic regression. R² should be >0.99. Calculate sample concentrations from the curve, accounting for any dilution factor
detailedSteps.zh: **计算**: 绘制标准曲线（浓度 vs A562）。用四参数 logistic 或二次回归拟合。R² 应 >0.99。从曲线计算样品浓度，考虑稀释倍数

note.en: Contains Reagent A, Reagent B, and BSA standard (e.g., Thermo Pierce #23225)
note.zh: 含试剂 A、试剂 B 和 BSA 标准品（如 Thermo Pierce #23225）
适当缓冲液中的 2 mg/mL 储液

name: CCK-8 Cell Proliferation / Viability Assay
nameCn: CCK-8 细胞增殖/活力检测

components.name: 1. 96 孔板铺板 (2,000–10,000 cells/well)
components.note: 100 µL 完全培养基; 边缘孔加 PBS 防蒸发

components.name: 3. 加药物/处理因素
components.note: 每个浓度 3–6 复孔; 含空白孔 (培养基+CCK-8)

components.name: 5. 每孔加 10 µL CCK-8 试剂
components.note: 避光操作, 勿产生气泡

components.name: 6. 37°C 孵育 1–4 h
components.note: 颜色从橙红变为深橙; 1 h 后每 30 min 检查

components.name: 7. 450 nm 读板 (参考波长 650 nm)
8. 计算活力 = (OD处理 - OD空白) / (OD对照 - OD空白) × 100%

notes.en: CCK-8 is more sensitive and less toxic than MTT. No need to solubilize crystals. Can re-measure the same plate at different time points. OD450 proportional to viable cells. Avoid bubbles when adding reagent.
notes.zh: CCK-8 优于 MTT：水溶性无需溶解结晶、可连续检测（非终点法）、灵敏度更高。含酚红培养基会稍有背景但不影响结果。细胞数与 OD 值需在线性范围内——首次使用做标准曲线。还原性物质（DTT, β-ME）和高血清浓度可能产生假阳性。WST-1 是类似替代品。

ref: Ishiyama et al. (1997) Talanta 44:1299; Dojindo CCK-8 Technical Manual

briefSteps.en: Seed cells in 96-well plate → treat with drug/stimulus → add CCK-8 reagent → incubate 1–4 h → read OD450
briefSteps.zh: 96 孔板接种细胞 → 加药/刺激处理 → 加 CCK-8 试剂 → 孵育 1–4 h → 读取 OD450

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Cell Seeding**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 细胞接种**

detailedSteps.en: **Seed cells**: Plate cells in 96-well plate at optimized density (typically 2,000–10,000 cells/well in 100 µL complete medium). Include blank wells (medium only, no cells) and untreated control wells. Seed in at least triplicate per condition
detailedSteps.zh: **接种细胞**: 以优化密度（通常 2,000–10,000 细胞/孔，100 µL 完全培养基）接种于 96 孔板。设置空白孔（仅培养基，无细胞）和未处理对照孔。每组至少 3 个重复

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate overnight**: Allow cells to attach at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 12–24 h
detailedSteps.zh: **过夜培养**: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养 12–24 h 使细胞贴壁

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Treatment**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 处理**

detailedSteps.en: **Add treatments**: Replace medium or add drug/stimulus at desired concentrations. For dose-response: use 6–8 concentrations in half-log dilutions. Final volume: 100 µL/well. ⚠️ Avoid bubbles — they cause inaccurate readings
detailedSteps.zh: **加药处理**: 换液或加入所需浓度的药物/刺激物。剂量-反应曲线：使用 6–8 个半对数稀释浓度。终体积：100 µL/孔。⚠️ 避免气泡——会导致读数不准

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Culture for desired treatment time (24, 48, or 72 h depending on experimental design)
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 按实验设计培养所需时间（24、48 或 72 h）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3–4 — CCK-8 Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 3–4 天 — CCK-8 检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Add CCK-8**: Add 10 µL CCK-8 reagent directly to each well (do not remove medium). ⚠️ Avoid touching the well walls — add to center of well. Use multichannel pipette for consistent timing
detailedSteps.zh: **加 CCK-8**: 每孔直接加 10 µL CCK-8 试剂（不需换液）。⚠️ 避免触碰孔壁——加到孔中央。使用多通道移液器保证一致性

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Return plate to 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator for 1–4 h (optimize for your cell line; typically 2 h). Color develops from orange to dark orange
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 放回 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养箱孵育 1–4 h（根据细胞系优化，通常 2 h）。颜色从浅橙变为深橙

detailedSteps.en: **Read plate**: Measure absorbance at 450 nm (reference wavelength 650 nm). Subtract blank well values
detailedSteps.zh: **读板**: 酶标仪测定 450 nm 吸光度（参考波长 650 nm）。减去空白孔数值

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate**: Cell viability (%) = (OD_treated − OD_blank) / (OD_control − OD_blank) × 100. For proliferation curves, plot OD450 vs. time. For IC50, fit dose-response curve with 4-parameter logistic regression
detailedSteps.zh: **计算**: 细胞活力 (%) = (OD_处理 − OD_空白) / (OD_对照 − OD_空白) × 100。增殖曲线绘制 OD450 vs 时间。IC50 用四参数 logistic 回归拟合剂量-反应曲线

note.en: e.g., Dojindo CK04; store at 4°C protected from light
note.zh: 如 Dojindo CK04；4°C 避光保存

note.en: Appropriate for cell line, with serum
note.zh: 适合细胞系的含血清培养基
450 nm 和 650 nm 滤光片
细胞过夜贴壁后再处理

name: Cell Counting (Hemocytometer)

components.name: 1. 胰酶消化 → 制备单细胞悬液
2. 取 10 µL 细胞悬液 + 10 µL 台盼蓝 (1:1)
components.note: 稀释因子 = 2; 密度过高再稀释

components.name: 3. 加盖玻片到血球计数板
components.note: 盖玻片两侧出现牛顿环

components.name: 4. 加 10 µL 混合液到计数室
components.note: 毛细作用自动填充, 勿溢出

components.name: 5. 10× 镜下计数四个大方格
components.note: 活细胞透明; 死细胞蓝色

components.name: 6. 计算浓度
components.note: cells/mL = (四格总数 / 4) × 稀释因子 × 10⁴

components.name: 7. 计算活率
components.note: Viability = 活细胞数 / 总细胞数 × 100%

notes.en: Trypan blue contact ≤5 min (otherwise live cells also stain). Ideal count: 100-200 cells per large square. Cells on grid lines: count top and left, not bottom and right. Clean hemocytometer with 70% ethanol; do not sonicate. Automated counters (Countess, TC20) are more accurate but need calibration.
notes.zh: 台盼蓝接触时间 ≤5 min（否则活细胞也会着色）。每格理想计数 100–200 个细胞。计数线上细胞：计上不计下，计左不计右。清洗计数板：70% 乙醇擦拭，勿用超声。自动计数仪（Countess, TC20）更准确但需校准。

ref: Freshney (2016) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th Ed, Ch. 21; Louis & Bhatt (2015) Methods Mol Biol 1235:31

briefSteps.en: Prepare single-cell suspension → mix with Trypan blue → load hemocytometer → count cells in 4 large squares → calculate concentration
briefSteps.zh: 制备单细胞悬液 → 与台盼蓝混合 → 加载血球计数板 → 计数 4 个大方格 → 计算浓度

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare hemocytometer**: Clean hemocytometer and coverslip with 70% ethanol. Let dry. Moisten the edges of the hemocytometer and press coverslip firmly until Newton's rings appear (rainbow refraction pattern)
detailedSteps.zh: **准备计数板**: 用 70% 乙醇清洁血球计数板和盖玻片。晾干。湿润计数板边缘，按压盖玻片至出现牛顿环（彩虹衍射图案）

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare cell suspension**: Trypsinize adherent cells (or collect suspension cells), centrifuge 300×g 5 min, resuspend in appropriate volume of medium or PBS to get an estimated 5×10⁵–1×10⁶ cells/mL. Pipet up/down 10× to ensure single-cell suspension
