detailedSteps.zh: **准备细胞悬液**: 胰酶消化贴壁细胞（或收集悬浮细胞），300×g 离心 5 min，用适量培养基或 PBS 重悬至估计 5×10⁵–1×10⁶ 细胞/mL。上下吹打 10 次确保单细胞悬液

detailedSteps.en: **Trypan blue staining**: Mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL 0.4% Trypan blue (1:1 dilution, dilution factor = 2). Mix gently by pipetting 3×. ⚠️ Use within 3 min — prolonged exposure kills live cells
detailedSteps.zh: **台盼蓝染色**: 取 10 µL 细胞悬液与 10 µL 0.4% 台盼蓝混合（1:1 稀释，稀释因子 = 2）。轻柔吹打 3 次混匀。⚠️ 3 min 内使用——长时间接触会杀死活细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Load chamber**: Carefully pipet 10 µL of the mixture into the V-shaped groove on one side of the hemocytometer. Liquid fills by capillary action under the coverslip. ⚠️ Do not overfill — excess liquid raises the coverslip and skews the count
detailedSteps.zh: **加样**: 小心吸取 10 µL 混合液滴入计数板一侧的 V 形槽。液体通过毛细作用充满盖玻片下方。⚠️ 不可过量——多余液体会抬高盖玻片导致计数偏差

detailedSteps.en: **Focus**: Place hemocytometer on microscope stage. Focus at 10× magnification. Identify the 4 corner large squares (each 1 mm × 1 mm, subdivided into 16 smaller squares)
detailedSteps.zh: **对焦**: 将计数板放在显微镜载物台上。10× 物镜对焦。辨识 4 个角大方格（每个 1 mm × 1 mm，分为 16 个小方格）

detailedSteps.en: **Count cells**: Count all cells in 4 large corner squares. Live cells are bright/refractile; dead cells are blue. For cells touching gridlines: count top and left borders, exclude bottom and right. Ideal count: 100–200 cells per large square
detailedSteps.zh: **计数**: 计数 4 个大方格中的所有细胞。活细胞明亮有折光性；死细胞染蓝。压线细胞：计上不计下，计左不计右。每个大方格理想计数：100–200 个细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate concentration**: Cells/mL = (total count in 4 squares / 4) × dilution factor × 10⁴. Example: 480 cells counted, dilution = 2 → (480/4) × 2 × 10⁴ = 2.4 × 10⁶ cells/mL
detailedSteps.zh: **计算浓度**: 细胞/mL = (4 格总计数 / 4) × 稀释因子 × 10⁴。例：计数 480 个，稀释因子 2 → (480/4) × 2 × 10⁴ = 2.4 × 10⁶ 细胞/mL

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate viability**: Viability (%) = (live cell count / total cell count) × 100. Acceptable viability for most experiments: >90%
detailedSteps.zh: **计算活率**: 活率 (%) = (活细胞计数 / 总细胞计数) × 100。大多数实验可接受活率：>90%

name: Cell Cycle Analysis (PI)

components.name: 4. PI staining: 50 µg/mL PI + 100 µg/mL RNase A

notes.en: RNase A essential (PI binds RNA). Gate singlets via FSC-H vs FSC-A. G1=2N, S=between, G2/M=4N. Fixed cells stable weeks at -20°C.
notes.zh: RNase A 必需（PI 也结合 RNA）。FSC-H vs FSC-A 门控去除双联体。G1=2N, S=中间, G2/M=4N。固定后 -20°C 可保存数周。

ref: Krishan (1975) J Cell Biol 66:188

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → fix in 70% ethanol → wash → RNase A treatment → PI staining → flow cytometry analysis
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞 → 70% 乙醇固定 → 洗涤 → RNase A 处理 → PI 染色 → 流式细胞术分析

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells**: Collect 1–2×10⁶ cells per sample. For adherent cells: trypsinize briefly, collect in medium, combine with floating cells from supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **收集细胞**: 每个样品收集 1–2×10⁶ 细胞。贴壁细胞：短暂胰酶消化，收集于培养基中，与上清中的悬浮细胞合并

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Centrifuge 300×g, 5 min, 4°C. Discard supernatant. Resuspend in 1 mL cold PBS. Centrifuge again
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 300×g 离心 5 min，4°C。弃上清。用 1 mL 预冷 PBS 重悬。再次离心

detailedSteps.en: **Fix**: Resuspend pellet in 300 µL cold PBS. While vortexing gently, add 700 µL ice-cold 100% ethanol drop-by-drop (final 70% ethanol). ⚠️ Add ethanol slowly while vortexing to prevent cell clumping
detailedSteps.zh: **固定**: 用 300 µL 预冷 PBS 重悬沉淀。轻柔涡旋同时逐滴加入 700 µL 冰冷 100% 乙醇（终浓度 70% 乙醇）。⚠️ 涡旋同时缓慢加入乙醇以防止细胞聚团

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Fix at -20°C for at least 2 h (or overnight). Cells can be stored at -20°C for up to several weeks
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: -20°C 固定至少 2 h（或过夜）。固定后的细胞可在 -20°C 保存数周

detailedSteps.en: **Wash off ethanol**: Centrifuge fixed cells 500×g, 5 min, 4°C. Remove ethanol. Wash once with 1 mL cold PBS. Centrifuge again
detailedSteps.zh: **洗去乙醇**: 固定细胞 500×g 离心 5 min，4°C。去除乙醇。用 1 mL 预冷 PBS 洗涤一次。再次离心

detailedSteps.en: **RNase treatment**: Resuspend in 500 µL PI staining solution: 50 µg/mL PI + 100 µg/mL RNase A in PBS. ⚠️ RNase A is essential — PI binds both DNA and RNA; without RNase, RNA will produce artifactual peaks
detailedSteps.zh: **RNase 处理**: 重悬于 500 µL PI 染色液：PBS 中含 50 µg/mL PI + 100 µg/mL RNase A。⚠️ RNase A 必不可少——PI 同时结合 DNA 和 RNA；不加 RNase 会产生假峰

detailedSteps.en: **Stain**: Incubate 30 min at 37°C in the dark (or RT for 15 min). Protect from light
detailedSteps.zh: **染色**: 37°C 避光孵育 30 min（或室温 15 min）。注意避光

detailedSteps.en: **Filter**: Pass through 40 µm cell strainer to remove clumps before analysis
detailedSteps.zh: **过滤**: 上机前用 40 µm 细胞滤网过滤去除聚团

detailedSteps.en: **Flow cytometry**: Acquire on flow cytometer using PE channel (Ex 488 nm / Em 617 nm). Record FL2-A (area) vs FL2-W (width) for doublet discrimination. Collect ≥20,000 singlet events
detailedSteps.zh: **流式检测**: 使用 PE 通道（Ex 488 nm / Em 617 nm）上机检测。记录 FL2-A（面积）vs FL2-W（宽度）用于双联体去除。收集 ≥20,000 单细胞事件

detailedSteps.en: **Analyze**: Gate singlets using FSC-H vs FSC-A plot. Use Dean-Jett-Fox or Watson model in FlowJo/ModFit to assign G1 (2N), S (between 2N–4N), and G2/M (4N) populations
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: 用 FSC-H vs FSC-A 散点图设门选取单细胞。在 FlowJo/ModFit 中用 Dean-Jett-Fox 或 Watson 模型分配 G1 (2N)、S (2N–4N 之间) 和 G2/M (4N) 群体

note.en: 1 mg/mL stock in H₂O, store at 4°C protected from light
note.zh: 1 mg/mL 水溶液储液，4°C 避光保存
10 mg/mL 储液，无 DNase，-20°C 保存

note.en: Fixed cells in 70% ethanol can be stored at -20°C for weeks
note.zh: 70% 乙醇固定的细胞可在 -20°C 保存数周

name: Cell Passaging (Subculture)

components.name: 3. PBS 洗涤 1–2 次 (去除血清)
4. 加胰酶-EDTA (0.05–0.25%)
components.note: T75: 2–3 mL; 均匀覆盖底面

components.name: 5. 37°C 孵育 2–5 min
components.note: 轻拍瓶壁, 镜下确认脱落

components.name: 6. 加含血清培养基终止消化
7. 吹打混匀成单细胞悬液
8. 按比例接种到新瓶
components.note: 常用传代比: 1:3–1:10; 记录代数

components.name: 9. 补足培养基, 标记, 放入培养箱

notes.en: Over-confluence causes contact inhibition and phenotypic changes. Some cell lines are trypsin-sensitive (e.g., HEK293) — use Accutase or TrypLE instead. Suspension cells: dilute directly. Track passage number — characteristics may change after 20-30 passages. Freeze backup samples at each passage. Use Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺-free PBS.
notes.zh: 过度汇合会导致接触抑制和表型变化。部分细胞系对胰酶敏感（如 HEK293），用 Accutase 或 TrypLE 代替。悬浮细胞直接稀释传代。记录传代数——超过 20–30 代后细胞特性可能改变。每次传代预留样品冻存。用不含 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ 的 PBS。

ref: Freshney (2016) Culture of Animal Cells, 7th Ed, Ch. 13; ATCC Cell Culture Guide

briefSteps.en: Aspirate medium → PBS wash → trypsinize → neutralize → centrifuge → reseed at desired ratio
briefSteps.zh: 吸去培养基 → PBS 洗涤 → 胰酶消化 → 中和 → 离心 → 按所需比例重新接种

detailedSteps.en: **Check confluence**: Examine cells under microscope. Passage when cells reach 70–90% confluence (varies by cell line). ⚠️ Do not let cells become 100% confluent — contact inhibition alters phenotype
detailedSteps.zh: **检查汇合度**: 显微镜观察细胞。细胞达到 70–90% 汇合度时传代（因细胞系而异）。⚠️ 不要让细胞长至 100% 汇合——接触抑制会改变表型

detailedSteps.en: **Warm reagents**: Pre-warm PBS, trypsin-EDTA (0.05% or 0.25%), and complete medium to 37°C in water bath
detailedSteps.zh: **预热试剂**: 将 PBS、胰酶-EDTA（0.05% 或 0.25%）和完全培养基在 37°C 水浴中预热

detailedSteps.en: **Aspirate medium**: Remove spent culture medium by aspiration. Tilt flask and aspirate from the side opposite to cells
detailedSteps.zh: **吸除培养基**: 吸弃旧培养基。倾斜培养瓶，从无细胞一侧吸取

detailedSteps.en: **PBS wash**: Gently add 5 mL (T-25) or 10 mL (T-75) Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺-free PBS. Rock gently to wash away residual serum (which inhibits trypsin). Aspirate PBS
detailedSteps.zh: **PBS 洗涤**: 轻柔加入 5 mL (T-25) 或 10 mL (T-75) 不含 Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ 的 PBS。轻摇洗去残余血清（血清会抑制胰酶）。吸去 PBS

detailedSteps.en: **Trypsinize**: Add 1 mL (T-25) or 2 mL (T-75) of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA. Tilt to cover entire surface. Incubate 2–5 min at 37°C. Check under microscope — cells should round up and detach. ⚠️ Do not over-trypsinize — damages membrane proteins
detailedSteps.zh: **胰酶消化**: 加入 1 mL (T-25) 或 2 mL (T-75) 0.05% 胰酶-EDTA。倾斜使其覆盖整个表面。37°C 孵育 2–5 min。镜下观察——细胞应变圆并脱落。⚠️ 不可过度消化——会损伤膜蛋白

detailedSteps.en: **Neutralize**: Add 3–5× volume of complete medium (contains 10% FBS to inactivate trypsin). Pipet up/down gently to dissociate clumps into single cells
detailedSteps.zh: **中和**: 加入 3–5 倍体积的完全培养基（含 10% FBS 灭活胰酶）。轻柔吹打使团块解散为单细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Centrifuge**: Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube. Centrifuge 300×g, 5 min, RT
detailedSteps.zh: **离心**: 将细胞悬液转移至 15 mL 离心管。300×g 离心 5 min，室温

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Aspirate supernatant. Resuspend pellet in fresh complete medium. Count cells if needed (see hemocytometer protocol)
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 吸去上清。用新鲜完全培养基重悬沉淀。如需计数（参见血球计数板方案）

detailedSteps.en: **Seed**: Seed into new flasks at desired split ratio (typically 1:3 to 1:10). Add fresh complete medium to final volume: 5 mL (T-25), 15 mL (T-75). Record passage number
detailedSteps.zh: **接种**: 按所需传代比（通常 1:3 至 1:10）接种至新培养瓶。加新鲜完全培养基至终体积：5 mL (T-25)、15 mL (T-75)。记录传代次数

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Place in 37°C, 5% CO₂ humidified incubator. Check cell attachment after 4–6 h. Change medium next day if excessive debris is present
detailedSteps.zh: **培养**: 放入 37°C, 5% CO₂ 湿化培养箱。4–6 h 后检查细胞贴壁情况。如残留碎片较多，次日换液

note.en: Pre-warmed to 37°C; for sensitive cells use TrypLE or Accutase
note.zh: 预热至 37°C；敏感细胞用 TrypLE 或 Accutase

note.en: DMEM/RPMI + 10% FBS + 1% Pen/Strep, appropriate for cell line
note.zh: DMEM/RPMI + 10% FBS + 1% 青链霉素，适合细胞系
T-25 或 T-75，细胞培养级

name: ATAC-seq Library Preparation

components.name: 2. Lyse nuclei: cold lysis buffer + 0.1% NP-40

notes.en: Critical: fresh cells, do NOT over-lyse. Nucleosomal laddering = good library. 9-12 PCR cycles typical. ≥50M reads/sample.
notes.zh: 关键：新鲜细胞，不可过度裂解。核小体梯度条带 = 文库合格。通常 9-12 轮 PCR。≥50M reads/样品。

ref: Buenrostro et al. (2013) Nat Methods 10:1213

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → lyse nuclei → Tn5 tagmentation → purify DNA → PCR amplify → library QC → sequence
briefSteps.zh: 收集细胞 → 裂解核膜 → Tn5 转座酶标记 → 纯化 DNA → PCR 扩增 → 文库质控 → 测序

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells**: Collect 50,000–75,000 viable cells per reaction. ⚠️ Use fresh cells only — frozen cells have compromised membranes. Count cells and confirm >90% viability by Trypan blue
detailedSteps.zh: **收集细胞**: 每个反应收集 50,000–75,000 个活细胞。⚠️ 仅使用新鲜细胞——冻存细胞膜结构受损。计数并用台盼蓝确认活率 >90%

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Centrifuge 500×g, 5 min, 4°C. Wash once with 50 µL cold PBS. Centrifuge again
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 500×g 离心 5 min，4°C。用 50 µL 预冷 PBS 洗涤一次。再次离心

detailedSteps.en: **Cell lysis**: Resuspend in 50 µL cold lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl₂, 0.1% NP-40, 0.1% Tween-20). Incubate on ice for 3 min. ⚠️ Do NOT over-lyse — monitor by Trypan blue (nuclei should stain blue but remain intact)
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞裂解**: 用 50 µL 预冷裂解液重悬（10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl₂, 0.1% NP-40, 0.1% Tween-20）。冰上孵育 3 min。⚠️ 不可过度裂解——用台盼蓝监控（细胞核应染蓝但保持完整）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash nuclei**: Add 1 mL cold wash buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl₂, 0.1% Tween-20 — no NP-40). Centrifuge 500×g, 5 min, 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤核**: 加 1 mL 预冷洗涤液（10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl₂, 0.1% Tween-20 — 无 NP-40）。500×g 离心 5 min，4°C

detailedSteps.en: **Tagmentation**: Resuspend nuclei in 50 µL tagmentation reaction: 25 µL 2× TD buffer + 2.5 µL Tn5 transposase (Illumina Tagment DNA Enzyme) + 22.5 µL nuclease-free H₂O. Incubate 37°C, 30 min, 300 rpm in thermomixer
detailedSteps.zh: **转座酶标记**: 用 50 µL 转座反应液重悬核：25 µL 2× TD 缓冲液 + 2.5 µL Tn5 转座酶（Illumina Tagment DNA Enzyme）+ 22.5 µL 无核酸酶水。37°C, 300 rpm 热混仪孵育 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Purify tagmented DNA**: Immediately purify using Qiagen MinElute PCR Purification Kit or Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5. Elute in 10 µL EB
detailedSteps.zh: **纯化标记 DNA**: 立即用 Qiagen MinElute PCR 纯化试剂盒或 Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 纯化。用 10 µL EB 洗脱

detailedSteps.en: **PCR amplification**: Set up 50 µL reaction: 10 µL tagmented DNA + 10 µL nuclease-free H₂O + 2.5 µL i5 index primer (25 µM) + 2.5 µL i7 index primer (25 µM) + 25 µL 2× NEBNext High-Fidelity PCR Master Mix
detailedSteps.zh: **PCR 扩增**: 配制 50 µL 反应体系：10 µL 标记 DNA + 10 µL 无核酸酶水 + 2.5 µL i5 引物（25 µM）+ 2.5 µL i7 引物（25 µM）+ 25 µL 2× NEBNext 高保真 PCR 预混液

detailedSteps.en: **PCR program**: 72°C 5 min → 98°C 30 s → [98°C 10 s → 63°C 30 s → 72°C 1 min] × 9–12 cycles. Use qPCR side-reaction to determine optimal cycle number (stop at 1/3 max fluorescence)
detailedSteps.zh: **PCR 程序**: 72°C 5 min → 98°C 30 s → [98°C 10 s → 63°C 30 s → 72°C 1 min] × 9–12 个循环。用 qPCR 侧反应确定最佳循环数（在荧光达最大值 1/3 时停止）

detailedSteps.en: **Size selection**: Purify PCR product with 1.8× AMPure XP beads (or double-sided selection: 0.5×/1.8× to remove >1000 bp and <150 bp fragments)
detailedSteps.zh: **片段筛选**: 用 1.8× AMPure XP 磁珠纯化 PCR 产物（或双面筛选：0.5×/1.8× 去除 >1000 bp 和 <150 bp 片段）

detailedSteps.en: **Library QC**: Run on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation — expect nucleosomal laddering pattern (peaks at ~200, ~400, ~600 bp). Quantify by Qubit dsDNA HS. Target: 10–20 nM
detailedSteps.zh: **文库质控**: Bioanalyzer/TapeStation 检测——应见核小体梯度条带（~200, ~400, ~600 bp 处有峰）。Qubit dsDNA HS 定量。目标：10–20 nM

detailedSteps.en: **Sequence**: Pool libraries and sequence on Illumina platform. Recommended: paired-end 2×50 bp or 2×75 bp, ≥50 million read pairs per sample
detailedSteps.zh: **测序**: 混合文库后在 Illumina 平台测序。建议：双端 2×50 bp 或 2×75 bp，每样品 ≥5000 万读对

note.en: Illumina Tagment DNA Enzyme and Buffer Kit (or homemade Tn5)
note.zh: Illumina Tagment DNA 酶及缓冲液试剂盒（或自制 Tn5）
各 25 µM，建议使用独特双索引

note.en: Purified tagmented DNA can be stored at -20°C for weeks
note.zh: 纯化后的标记 DNA 可 -20°C 保存数周

note.en: Purified library can be stored at -20°C
note.zh: 纯化后的文库可 -20°C 保存

name: Clonogenic (Colony Formation) Assay

components.name: 1. Seed 200-1000 cells/well (6-well)
components.note: 高 PE 细胞 (HeLa): 200 cells; 低 PE 细胞: 500–1000; 先做预实验确定最佳密度

notes.en: Plating efficiency = colonies/cells × 100%. Surviving fraction = PE(treated)/PE(control). Triplicate.
notes.zh: 接种效率 = 克隆数/细胞数 × 100%。存活分数 = PE(处理)/PE(对照)。三重复。

ref: Franken et al. (2006) Nat Protoc 1:2315

briefSteps.en: Seed cells at low density → treat → incubate 10–14 days → fix with methanol → stain with crystal violet → count colonies
briefSteps.zh: 低密度接种细胞 → 处理 → 培养 10–14 天 → 甲醇固定 → 结晶紫染色 → 计数克隆

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Seeding**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 接种**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare single-cell suspension**: Trypsinize cells, count, and dilute to low density. Seed 200–2,000 cells per well in 6-well plates (optimize for each cell line — start with 500 cells/well). Add 2 mL complete medium per well
detailedSteps.zh: **准备单细胞悬液**: 胰酶消化细胞，计数后稀释至低密度。每孔接种 200–2,000 个细胞于 6 孔板（根据细胞系优化——初次可用 500 细胞/孔）。每孔加 2 mL 完全培养基

detailedSteps.en: **Allow attachment**: Incubate 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 4–6 h (or overnight) to allow cells to attach
detailedSteps.zh: **贴壁**: 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养 4–6 h（或过夜）使细胞贴壁

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Treatment**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 处理**

detailedSteps.en: **Treat**: Add drug at desired concentrations (or irradiate for radiation survival curves). Include untreated control wells. For drugs: replace medium with drug-containing medium. Leave drug on for specified time (continuous or pulse treatment)
detailedSteps.zh: **处理**: 加入所需浓度药物（或照射用于放射存活曲线）。设置未处理对照孔。药物处理：换含药培养基。按需连续处理或脉冲处理

detailedSteps.en: **Days 2–14 — Colony Growth**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 2–14 天 — 克隆生长**

detailedSteps.en: **Culture**: Incubate for 10–14 days (until colonies are visible to naked eye, ~50 cells per colony). Replace medium every 3–4 days. ⚠️ Handle plates gently — do not disturb forming colonies
detailedSteps.zh: **培养**: 培养 10–14 天（直到肉眼可见克隆，每克隆约 50 个细胞）。每 3–4 天换液。⚠️ 轻拿轻放——不要扰动正在形成的克隆

detailedSteps.en: **Day 14+ — Fix and Stain**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 14 天+ — 固定和染色**

detailedSteps.en: **Remove medium**: Aspirate culture medium carefully. Wash once gently with PBS
detailedSteps.zh: **去除培养基**: 小心吸去培养基。用 PBS 轻柔洗涤一次

detailedSteps.en: **Fix**: Add 1 mL methanol (or 4% PFA) per well. Fix for 15 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: **固定**: 每孔加 1 mL 甲醇（或 4% PFA）。室温固定 15 min

detailedSteps.en: **Stain**: Remove fixative. Add 1 mL 0.5% crystal violet in 25% methanol. Stain for 15–30 min at RT
detailedSteps.zh: **染色**: 去除固定液。加 1 mL 0.5% 结晶紫（溶于 25% 甲醇中）。室温染色 15–30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Remove stain. Wash plates gently under running tap water until background is clear. Air dry inverted on paper towels
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 去除染液。在流水下轻柔冲洗至背景干净。倒扣在纸巾上晾干

detailedSteps.en: **Count colonies**: Count colonies with >50 cells (manually or using ImageJ/OpenCFU software). Calculate plating efficiency: PE = (colonies counted / cells seeded) × 100%. Surviving fraction: SF = PE_treated / PE_control
detailedSteps.zh: **计数克隆**: 计数含 >50 个细胞的克隆（手动或用 ImageJ/OpenCFU 软件）。计算接种效率：PE = (克隆数 / 接种细胞数) × 100%。存活分数：SF = PE_处理 / PE_对照

note.zh: 细胞过夜贴壁后再处理

note.en: Fixed and stained plates can be stored dry at RT indefinitely
note.zh: 固定染色后的板可室温干燥保存

name: Comet Assay (Alkaline)

components.name: 1. Embed cells in 0.5% LMP agarose on slides

notes.en: Detects SSBs, DSBs, alkali-labile sites. All steps 4°C and dim light. Metrics: % tail DNA, tail moment. Positive control: H₂O₂ 100 µM 10 min.
notes.zh: 检测 SSB、DSB、碱不稳定位点。全程 4°C 避光。指标：尾部 DNA 百分比、尾矩。阳性对照：H₂O₂ 100 µM 10 min。

ref: Singh et al. (1988) Exp Cell Res 175:184

briefSteps.en: Embed cells in LMP agarose on slides → lyse overnight → alkaline unwinding → electrophoresis → neutralize → stain with SYBR Gold → image and analyze
briefSteps.zh: 将细胞包埋于低熔点琼脂糖 → 裂解过夜 → 碱性解旋 → 电泳 → 中和 → SYBR Gold 染色 → 拍照分析

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Slide Preparation and Lysis**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 制片和裂解**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare base layer**: Dip frosted-end slides in 1% normal melting point (NMP) agarose in PBS. Let set at RT to form a thin base layer. Prepare fresh or use pre-coated slides
detailedSteps.zh: **制备基底层**: 将磨砂端玻片浸入 1% 普通琼脂糖（PBS 配制）。室温凝固形成薄底层。可用新制或预包被玻片

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare cell suspension**: Harvest cells (1–2×10⁵/mL). ⚠️ Keep cells on ice and dim light throughout — UV light causes DNA damage artifacts. Include positive control (100 µM H₂O₂, 10 min on ice)
detailedSteps.zh: **准备细胞悬液**: 收集细胞（1–2×10⁵/mL）。⚠️ 全程冰上操作并避光——紫外线会造成假阳性 DNA 损伤。设阳性对照（100 µM H₂O₂，冰上 10 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Embed cells**: Mix 75 µL cell suspension with 75 µL 1% low melting point (LMP) agarose (pre-cooled to 37°C) in PBS. Quickly pipet 75 µL onto the base layer. Cover with coverslip. Let gel at 4°C for 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **包埋细胞**: 取 75 µL 细胞悬液与 75 µL 1% 低熔点 (LMP) 琼脂糖（PBS 配制，预冷至 37°C）混合。迅速取 75 µL 滴到基底层上。盖上盖玻片。4°C 凝固 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Remove coverslip**: Gently slide off the coverslip. Add a third layer of 75 µL 0.5% LMP agarose. Cover with coverslip. Gel at 4°C for 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **去盖玻片**: 轻柔滑掉盖玻片。加第三层 75 µL 0.5% LMP 琼脂糖。盖上盖玻片。4°C 凝固 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse**: Remove coverslips. Immerse slides in cold lysis solution (2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris, pH 10, 1% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO — add Triton and DMSO fresh). Lyse at 4°C for at least 1 h (overnight preferred)
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 去除盖玻片。将玻片浸入预冷裂解液（2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris, pH 10, 1% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO——Triton 和 DMSO 现用现加）。4°C 裂解至少 1 h（推荐过夜）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Electrophoresis and Staining**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 电泳和染色**

detailedSteps.en: **Alkaline unwinding**: Transfer slides to electrophoresis tank. Fill with cold alkaline buffer (300 mM NaOH, 1 mM EDTA, pH >13). Incubate 20–60 min at 4°C in the dark to allow DNA unwinding
detailedSteps.zh: **碱性解旋**: 将玻片转移至电泳槽。加满预冷碱性缓冲液（300 mM NaOH, 1 mM EDTA, pH >13）。4°C 避光孵育 20–60 min 使 DNA 解旋

detailedSteps.en: **Electrophoresis**: Run at 25 V (~0.7 V/cm), 300 mA for 20–30 min at 4°C. ⚠️ Maintain consistent voltage and time across experiments for comparable results
detailedSteps.zh: **电泳**: 4°C 下 25 V（约 0.7 V/cm），300 mA 运行 20–30 min。⚠️ 实验间保持电压和时间一致以确保结果可比

detailedSteps.en: **Neutralize**: Drain excess buffer. Gently flood slides with 0.4 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5 for 5 min. Repeat 3×
detailedSteps.zh: **中和**: 沥干多余缓冲液。轻柔加 0.4 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5 浸润 5 min。重复 3 次

detailedSteps.en: **Stain**: Apply 50 µL of 1× SYBR Gold (or SYBR Green I, ethidium bromide 20 µg/mL, or propidium iodide 2.5 µg/mL) per slide. Cover with coverslip
detailedSteps.zh: **染色**: 每片玻片加 50 µL 1× SYBR Gold（或 SYBR Green I，或溴化乙锭 20 µg/mL，或碘化丙啶 2.5 µg/mL）。盖上盖玻片

detailedSteps.en: **Image**: View under fluorescence microscope (SYBR Gold: Ex 495 nm / Em 537 nm). Image 50–100 comets per sample using CCD camera at 20× magnification
detailedSteps.zh: **拍照**: 荧光显微镜下观察（SYBR Gold: Ex 495 nm / Em 537 nm）。20× 物镜，每样品拍摄 50–100 个彗星

detailedSteps.en: **Analyze**: Use CometScore or OpenComet (ImageJ plugin) software. Report: % tail DNA, olive tail moment, tail length. Compare treated vs. control using appropriate statistics (e.g., Kruskal-Wallis test)
detailedSteps.zh: **分析**: 使用 CometScore 或 OpenComet（ImageJ 插件）软件。报告：尾部 DNA 百分比、Olive 尾矩、尾长。处理组与对照组用适当统计方法比较（如 Kruskal-Wallis 检验）

note.en: 0.5–1% in PBS, melted and cooled to 37°C
note.zh: PBS 配制 0.5–1%，融化后冷却至 37°C

note.en: 2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 10, 1% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO (fresh)
note.zh: 2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 10, 1% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO（现配）
TE 缓冲液中 1:10,000 稀释

note.en: Slides in lysis buffer can be stored at 4°C for up to 1 week
note.zh: 裂解液中的玻片可在 4°C 保存至多 1 周

name: Coomassie Brilliant Blue Staining (SDS-PAGE)

components.name: 1. 固定：50% 甲醇 / 10% 乙酸, 30 min
components.note: 轻柔摇晃, 防止凝胶变形

components.name: 3. 脱色 I：50% 甲醇 / 10% 乙酸, 30 min
4. 脱色 II：5% 甲醇 / 7% 乙酸
components.note: 换液 2–3 次直到背景清晰; 加纸巾吸附色素加速

notes.en: Sensitivity: ~100 ng protein/band. For higher sensitivity use Colloidal Coomassie (Neuhoff method, ~10 ng) or silver stain (~1 ng). CBB G-250 (Colloidal) requires no fixation and has lower background. Microwave shortcut: stain 30s MW → rock 5 min → destain 30s MW → rock 5 min, complete in ~15 min. Store gel in 7% acetic acid or dry.
notes.zh: 灵敏度：~100 ng 蛋白/条带。更灵敏可用 Colloidal Coomassie (Neuhoff 法, ~10 ng) 或银染 (~1 ng)。CBB G-250 (Colloidal) 不需固定步骤且背景更低。微波加速法：染色液微波 30 s → 摇 5 min → 脱色液微波 30 s → 摇 5 min，可在 15 min 内完成。凝胶可保存在 7% 乙酸中或干燥保存。

ref: Neuhoff et al. (1988) Electrophoresis 9:255; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

briefSteps.en: Run SDS-PAGE → fix gel → stain with Coomassie Blue → destain until bands visible → image
briefSteps.zh: SDS-PAGE 电泳 → 固定凝胶 → 考马斯亮蓝染色 → 脱色至条带可见 → 拍照

detailedSteps.en: **Run SDS-PAGE**: Run gel electrophoresis until dye front reaches bottom (typically 1–1.5 h at 120 V). Include pre-stained protein marker
detailedSteps.zh: **SDS-PAGE 电泳**: 电泳至溴酚蓝前沿到达底部（通常 120 V，1–1.5 h）。加预染蛋白 Marker

detailedSteps.en: **Disassemble**: Carefully remove gel from glass plates. Cut a corner for orientation. Transfer to a clean container (e.g., plastic dish)
detailedSteps.zh: **拆胶**: 小心将凝胶从玻璃板取出。切一角作为方向标记。转移至干净容器（如塑料培养皿）

detailedSteps.en: **Fix** (optional but recommended): Immerse gel in fixation solution (50% methanol, 10% acetic acid) for 30 min with gentle rocking. This prevents protein diffusion and gives sharper bands
detailedSteps.zh: **固定**（推荐）：将凝胶浸入固定液（50% 甲醇, 10% 乙酸）中，轻摇 30 min。可防止蛋白扩散，使条带更清晰

detailedSteps.en: **Stain**: Remove fixative. Add Coomassie staining solution (0.1% Coomassie Brilliant Blue R-250, 50% methanol, 10% acetic acid). Stain 1 h at RT with gentle agitation (or 30 s microwave + 5 min rocking for rapid protocol)
detailedSteps.zh: **染色**: 去除固定液。加考马斯染色液（0.1% 考马斯亮蓝 R-250, 50% 甲醇, 10% 乙酸）。室温轻摇染色 1 h（快速法：微波 30 s + 摇 5 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Destain**: Remove stain solution. Add destaining solution (40% methanol, 10% acetic acid). Change destaining solution every 30 min until background is clear and bands are visible. Include a piece of Kimwipe or sponge to absorb excess dye
detailedSteps.zh: **脱色**: 去除染色液。加脱色液（40% 甲醇, 10% 乙酸）。每 30 min 更换脱色液，直至背景透明、条带清晰。放一块 Kimwipe 或海绵吸附多余染料

detailedSteps.en: **Final wash**: Replace destaining solution with water or 7% acetic acid for storage. Bands may sharpen further overnight in water
detailedSteps.zh: **终洗**: 将脱色液换为水或 7% 乙酸保存。在水中过夜条带可能更清晰

detailedSteps.en: **Image**: Scan gel using white-light transilluminator or flatbed scanner. Save as TIFF for quantification
detailedSteps.zh: **拍照**: 用白光透射仪或平板扫描仪扫描凝胶。保存为 TIFF 格式用于定量分析

detailedSteps.en: **Storage**: Store gel in sealed bag with 7% acetic acid at 4°C, or dry between cellophane sheets using a gel dryer (80°C, 1–2 h under vacuum)
detailedSteps.zh: **保存**: 凝胶密封袋中加 7% 乙酸 4°C 保存，或用凝胶干燥仪在赛璐玢纸间干燥（80°C，真空 1–2 h）

note.en: Gel in fixation solution can remain overnight at RT
note.zh: 凝胶可在固定液中室温放置过夜

note.en: Stained gel in 7% acetic acid stable at 4°C for weeks
note.zh: 染色凝胶在 7% 乙酸中 4°C 可保存数周

name: CRISPR sgRNA Cloning (pX459)

notes.en: pX459 (Addgene #62988) = Cas9 + puromycin. pLentiCRISPRv2 (#52961) for lentiviral. Include non-targeting control.
notes.zh: pX459 (Addgene #62988) = Cas9 + 嘌呤霉素。pLentiCRISPRv2 (#52961) 用于慢病毒。包含非靶向对照。

ref: Ran et al. (2013) Nat Protoc 8:2281

briefSteps.en: Design sgRNA → anneal oligos → digest vector (BbsI) → ligate insert → transform → colony PCR → sequence verify
briefSteps.zh: 设计 sgRNA → 退火引物 → 酶切载体 (BbsI) → 连接 insert → 转化 → 菌落 PCR → 测序验证

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Oligo Design and Vector Digestion**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 引物设计和载体酶切**

detailedSteps.en: **Design sgRNA oligos**: Select 20 nt target sequence adjacent to PAM (NGG for SpCas9). Add BbsI overhangs: Forward: 5'-CACCG[20nt target]-3'; Reverse: 5'-AAAC[20nt reverse complement]C-3'. Order from oligo vendor
detailedSteps.zh: **设计 sgRNA 引物**: 选择 PAM（SpCas9 为 NGG）旁 20 nt 靶序列。加 BbsI 接头：正向：5'-CACCG[20nt 靶序列]-3'；反向：5'-AAAC[20nt 反向互补]C-3'。从引物公司订购

detailedSteps.en: **Digest vector**: Set up 30 µL reaction: 1 µg pX459 (or pLentiCRISPRv2) + 3 µL 10× CutSmart buffer + 1 µL BbsI (BpiI) + H₂O. Incubate 37°C, 1 h. Optional: add 1 µL CIP (alkaline phosphatase) for last 30 min to reduce background
detailedSteps.zh: **酶切载体**: 配制 30 µL 反应：1 µg pX459（或 pLentiCRISPRv2）+ 3 µL 10× CutSmart 缓冲液 + 1 µL BbsI (BpiI) + 水。37°C 孵育 1 h。可选：最后 30 min 加 1 µL CIP（碱性磷酸酶）降低背景

detailedSteps.en: **Gel purify vector**: Run digested vector on 1% agarose gel. Cut out the linearized vector band (~9 kb for pX459). Purify using gel extraction kit. Elute in 30 µL EB. Quantify by NanoDrop
detailedSteps.zh: **凝胶纯化载体**: 酶切产物跑 1% 琼脂糖胶。切下线性化载体条带（pX459 约 9 kb）。凝胶回收试剂盒纯化。30 µL EB 洗脱。NanoDrop 定量

detailedSteps.en: **Anneal oligos**: Mix 1 µL forward oligo (100 µM) + 1 µL reverse oligo (100 µM) + 1 µL 10× T4 Ligation Buffer + 0.5 µL T4 PNK + 6.5 µL H₂O. Program: 37°C 30 min → 95°C 5 min → ramp down to 25°C at 5°C/min
detailedSteps.zh: **退火引物**: 混合 1 µL 正向引物 (100 µM) + 1 µL 反向引物 (100 µM) + 1 µL 10× T4 连接缓冲液 + 0.5 µL T4 PNK + 6.5 µL 水。程序：37°C 30 min → 95°C 5 min → 以 5°C/min 降至 25°C

detailedSteps.en: **Dilute annealed oligos**: Dilute the annealed oligos 1:200 in nuclease-free H₂O (1 µL into 199 µL)
detailedSteps.zh: **稀释退火引物**: 将退火引物用无核酸酶水 1:200 稀释（1 µL 加入 199 µL）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1–2 — Ligation and Transformation**
detailedSteps.zh: **第 1–2 天 — 连接和转化**

detailedSteps.en: **Ligate**: Mix 50 ng digested vector + 1 µL diluted annealed oligos + 1 µL 10× T4 Ligation Buffer + 1 µL T4 DNA Ligase + H₂O to 10 µL. Incubate 16°C overnight (or RT 2 h for quick ligation). Include no-insert control
detailedSteps.zh: **连接**: 混合 50 ng 酶切载体 + 1 µL 稀释后退火引物 + 1 µL 10× T4 连接缓冲液 + 1 µL T4 DNA 连接酶 + 水补至 10 µL。16°C 过夜（或快速连接 RT 2 h）。设无 insert 对照

detailedSteps.en: **Transform**: Transform 2–5 µL ligation product into competent cells (DH5α or Stbl3 for lentiviral vectors). Heat-shock 42°C 45 s. Recover in SOC medium 37°C 1 h. Plate on LB + ampicillin (100 µg/mL). Incubate 37°C overnight
detailedSteps.zh: **转化**: 取 2–5 µL 连接产物转化感受态细胞（DH5α 或 Stbl3 用于慢病毒载体）。42°C 热激 45 s。SOC 培养基 37°C 复苏 1 h。涂 LB + 氨苄（100 µg/mL）平板。37°C 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Screening**
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天 — 筛选**

detailedSteps.en: **Colony PCR**: Pick 4–8 colonies. Screen by colony PCR using U6 forward primer + sgRNA reverse oligo (expected band ~250 bp). Compare insert:no-insert colony ratio (should be >3:1)
detailedSteps.zh: **菌落 PCR**: 挑 4–8 个克隆。用 U6 正向引物 + sgRNA 反向引物做菌落 PCR（预期条带约 250 bp）。比较 insert:无 insert 克隆比（应 >3:1）

detailedSteps.en: **Miniprep**: Inoculate positive colonies into 3 mL LB + ampicillin. Grow overnight 37°C. Miniprep plasmid DNA next day
detailedSteps.zh: **质粒提取**: 将阳性克隆接种到 3 mL LB + 氨苄中。37°C 过夜培养。次日小提质粒 DNA

detailedSteps.en: **Sequence verify**: Send for Sanger sequencing using U6 primer. Confirm correct sgRNA insertion with no mutations. ⚠️ Do not proceed to transfection without sequence confirmation
detailedSteps.zh: **测序验证**: 用 U6 引物送 Sanger 测序。确认 sgRNA 正确插入且无突变。⚠️ 未经测序确认不要进行转染

note.en: Gel-purified vector can be stored at -20°C
note.zh: 凝胶纯化载体可 -20°C 保存

note.en: Annealed oligos can be stored at -20°C for months
note.zh: 退火引物可 -20°C 保存数月

name: DNA Ligation (T4 Ligase)

components.name: Linearized vector
components.note: 去磷酸化可降低自连背景

components.name: Insert DNA
components.note: 摩尔比 vector:insert = 1:3–1:5 (粘性末端) 或 1:5–1:10 (平末端)

components.name: 10× T4 Ligase Buffer
components.note: 含 ATP, 勿反复冻融

components.name: 2a. 粘性末端：室温 10 min 或 16°C 过夜
2b. 平末端：16°C 过夜（或室温 2 h 用高浓度酶）
4. 转化 2–5 µL 连接产物

notes.en: Controls: (1) no ligase → assess background; (2) no insert → assess vector self-ligation; (3) uncut vector → assess transformation efficiency. Insert calculation: ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × molar ratio. Quick Ligation Kit (NEB) completes in 5 min.
notes.zh: 对照组：(1) 无连接酶对照 → 评估自连背景; (2) 无 insert 对照 → 评估载体自连; (3) 未切 vector 对照 → 评估转化效率。Insert 计算公式：ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × molar ratio。Quick Ligation Kit (NEB) 可 5 min 完成。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; NEB T4 DNA Ligase protocol

briefSteps.en: Calculate insert:vector ratio → set up ligation reaction → incubate (16°C overnight or RT 2 h) → transform competent cells
briefSteps.zh: 计算 insert:vector 比例 → 配制连接反应 → 孵育（16°C 过夜或 RT 2 h）→ 转化感受态细胞

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify DNA**: Measure vector and insert concentrations by NanoDrop or gel estimation. ⚠️ Vector must be linearized (restriction digested); insert must have compatible ends (sticky or blunt)
detailedSteps.zh: **DNA 定量**: NanoDrop 或凝胶估算载体和 insert 浓度。⚠️ 载体必须线性化（限制性酶切）；insert 必须有兼容末端（粘性或平端）

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate insert amount**: Use formula: ng insert = (ng vector × insert size in bp / vector size in bp) × molar ratio. Use 3:1 insert:vector molar ratio for sticky ends, 5:1 for blunt ends. Typically use 50 ng vector
detailedSteps.zh: **计算 insert 用量**: 公式：ng insert = (ng vector × insert bp / vector bp) × 摩尔比。粘性末端用 3:1 insert:vector 摩尔比，平端用 5:1。通常用 50 ng 载体

detailedSteps.en: **Set up ligation**: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube on ice, combine: 50 ng linearized vector + calculated ng of insert + 2 µL 10× T4 DNA Ligase Buffer (contains ATP) + 1 µL T4 DNA Ligase (400 U/µL) + nuclease-free H₂O to 20 µL total
detailedSteps.zh: **配制连接反应**: 在冰上 0.2 mL PCR 管中混合：50 ng 线性化载体 + 计算量的 insert + 2 µL 10× T4 DNA 连接酶缓冲液（含 ATP）+ 1 µL T4 DNA 连接酶（400 U/µL）+ 无核酸酶水补至 20 µL

detailedSteps.en: **Set up controls**: (1) Vector + ligase, no insert → measures self-ligation background; (2) Vector only, no ligase → measures uncut vector carryover; (3) Uncut vector → tests transformation efficiency
detailedSteps.zh: **设置对照**: (1) 载体 + 连接酶，无 insert → 检测自连背景；(2) 仅载体，无连接酶 → 检测未切载体残留；(3) 未切载体 → 检测转化效率

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: For sticky ends: 16°C overnight (or RT 2 h). For blunt ends: 16°C overnight (do NOT use RT — blunt-end ligation is much less efficient). ⚠️ Do not heat-inactivate if transforming chemically competent cells immediately
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 粘性末端：16°C 过夜（或 RT 2 h）。平端：16°C 过夜（不要用 RT——平端连接效率低得多）。⚠️ 如果立即转化化学感受态细胞，不需热灭活

detailedSteps.en: **Optional: heat-inactivate**: If not transforming immediately, heat-inactivate at 65°C for 10 min. Cool on ice. Store at -20°C
detailedSteps.zh: **可选：热灭活**: 如不立即转化，65°C 热灭活 10 min。冰上冷却。-20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Transform**: Use 2–5 µL of ligation reaction to transform 50 µL competent cells (DH5α). Heat-shock 42°C for 45 s. Add 250 µL SOC medium, recover at 37°C for 1 h with shaking
detailedSteps.zh: **转化**: 取 2–5 µL 连接产物转化 50 µL 感受态细胞（DH5α）。42°C 热激 45 s。加 250 µL SOC 培养基，37°C 振荡复苏 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Plate**: Spread on LB plates with appropriate antibiotic. For blue/white screening (lacZ vector): add 40 µL X-gal (20 mg/mL) + 4 µL IPTG (200 mg/mL) to plate. Incubate 37°C overnight
detailedSteps.zh: **涂板**: 涂布于含适当抗生素的 LB 平板。蓝白筛选（lacZ 载体）：平板加 40 µL X-gal (20 mg/mL) + 4 µL IPTG (200 mg/mL)。37°C 过夜培养

detailedSteps.en: **Evaluate**: Count colonies. Insert ligation should have 3–10× more colonies than self-ligation control. Pick colonies for miniprep and verify by restriction digestion or colony PCR
detailedSteps.zh: **评估**: 计数菌落。Insert 连接应比自连对照多 3–10 倍菌落。挑取克隆小提质粒，酶切验证或菌落 PCR 确认

note.en: Contains 10 mM ATP; store at -20°C in aliquots (ATP degrades with freeze-thaw)
note.zh: 含 10 mM ATP；-20°C 分装保存（ATP 反复冻融会降解）
限制性酶切后凝胶回收或柱纯化

note.en: Ligation product (heat-inactivated) can be stored at -20°C for weeks
note.zh: 热灭活后的连接产物可 -20°C 保存数周

name: Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay

components.name: 1. 共转染 Firefly 报告质粒 + Renilla 内参质粒
components.note: 比例 10:1 (如 500 ng Firefly + 50 ng Renilla/24 孔); 加实验质粒或 miRNA mimics

components.name: 2. 24–48 h 后弃培养基, PBS 洗 1×
3. 加 1× PLB 裂解
components.note: 24-well: 100 µL/孔; 96-well: 20 µL/孔; 摇床 15 min RT

components.name: 4. 取 20 µL 裂解液至检测板
components.note: 白色不透明板减少串扰

components.name: 5. 加 100 µL LAR II → 读 Firefly (2 s delay, 10 s read)
6. 加 100 µL Stop & Glo → 读 Renilla
components.note: Stop & Glo 猝灭 Firefly 同时激发 Renilla

components.name: 7. 计算 Ratio = Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU
components.note: 归一化后比较各组差异

notes.en: Firefly = experimental reporter, Renilla = internal control for transfection efficiency. LAR II and Stop & Glo should be at RT before use. Prepare only enough for immediate use (LAR II stable ~8h at RT). Background: <100 RLU. Triplicate wells minimum. For 3'UTR/miRNA target validation: clone target site into psiCHECK-2 (Renilla is the reporter).
notes.zh: Firefly = 实验报告基因，Renilla = 内参控制转染效率。LAR II 和 Stop & Glo 使用前恢复至室温。LAR II 室温稳定约 8h，现配现用。背景 <100 RLU。至少 3 个重复孔。3'UTR/miRNA 靶标验证：用 psiCHECK-2（Renilla 为报告基因）。

ref: Sherf et al. (1996) Promega Notes 57:2; Promega Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay System Technical Manual TM040

briefSteps.en: Transfect reporter + Renilla control → incubate 24–48 h → lyse cells → read Firefly luminescence → add Stop & Glo → read Renilla → calculate ratio
briefSteps.zh: 转染报告基因 + Renilla 内参 → 培养 24–48 h → 裂解细胞 → 检测 Firefly 发光 → 加 Stop & Glo → 检测 Renilla → 计算比值

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Transfection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 转染**

detailedSteps.en: **Seed cells**: Plate cells in 96-well (1×10⁴ cells/well) or 24-well (5×10⁴ cells/well) plates. Culture overnight to reach 60–80% confluence at transfection
detailedSteps.zh: **接种细胞**: 在 96 孔板（1×10⁴ 细胞/孔）或 24 孔板（5×10⁴ 细胞/孔）中接种。过夜培养至转染时汇合度 60–80%

detailedSteps.en: **Transfect**: Co-transfect Firefly luciferase reporter construct + pRL-TK or pRL-SV40 (Renilla internal control, 1/10–1/50 of reporter amount) + expression plasmid (if applicable). Use Lipofectamine 2000/3000 or PEI. Include: (1) reporter only control, (2) empty vector control. Triplicate wells minimum
detailedSteps.zh: **转染**: 共转染 Firefly 荧光素酶报告质粒 + pRL-TK 或 pRL-SV40（Renilla 内参，用量为报告质粒的 1/10–1/50）+ 表达质粒（如适用）。用 Lipofectamine 2000/3000 或 PEI。设置：(1) 仅报告基因对照，(2) 空载体对照。至少三重复

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2–3 — Incubation**
**Incubate**: Culture 24–48 h post-transfection at 37°C, 5% CO₂. Change medium 4–6 h after transfection to reduce toxicity
detailedSteps.zh: **培养**: 转染后 37°C, 5% CO₂ 培养 24–48 h。转染后 4–6 h 换液减少毒性

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Assay**
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天 — 检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare reagents**: Thaw 5× Passive Lysis Buffer (PLB) and dilute to 1× with H₂O. Bring LAR II (Luciferase Assay Reagent II) and Stop & Glo Reagent to RT. ⚠️ Prepare only enough for immediate use — LAR II is stable ~8 h at RT
detailedSteps.zh: **准备试剂**: 解冻 5× 被动裂解缓冲液 (PLB) 并用水稀释至 1×。LAR II（荧光素酶检测试剂 II）和 Stop & Glo 试剂恢复至室温。⚠️ 现配现用——LAR II 室温仅稳定约 8 h

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse cells**: Remove medium. Wash once with PBS. Add 1× PLB (20 µL/well for 96-well, 100 µL/well for 24-well). Rock at RT for 15 min. ⚠️ Complete lysis is critical — incomplete lysis causes variable readings
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解细胞**: 去除培养基。PBS 洗涤一次。加 1× PLB（96 孔板 20 µL/孔，24 孔板 100 µL/孔）。室温摇晃 15 min。⚠️ 充分裂解至关重要——裂解不充分导致读数不稳定

detailedSteps.en: **Read Firefly**: Transfer 20 µL lysate to white opaque 96-well plate (if not already in one). Add 100 µL LAR II per well (or use injector). Read Firefly luminescence immediately on luminometer (2 s integration per well)
detailedSteps.zh: **检测 Firefly**: 取 20 µL 裂解液至白色不透明 96 孔板（如不在此板中）。每孔加 100 µL LAR II（或用自动注射器）。立即在发光检测仪上读取 Firefly 发光（每孔积分 2 s）

detailedSteps.en: **Read Renilla**: Add 100 µL Stop & Glo Reagent per well (quenches Firefly, activates Renilla). Read Renilla luminescence immediately (2 s integration)
detailedSteps.zh: **检测 Renilla**: 每孔加 100 µL Stop & Glo 试剂（猝灭 Firefly，激活 Renilla）。立即读取 Renilla 发光（积分 2 s）

detailedSteps.en: **Calculate**: Normalize: Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU = normalized luciferase activity. Compare treated vs. control groups. Express as fold change relative to empty vector or untreated control
detailedSteps.zh: **计算**: 归一化：Firefly RLU / Renilla RLU = 归一化荧光素酶活性。比较处理组与对照组。以空载体或未处理对照的倍数变化表示

note.en: e.g., pGL3/pGL4 with promoter/enhancer of interest
note.zh: 如含目的启动子/增强子的 pGL3/pGL4
pRL-TK 或 pRL-SV40（报告质粒的 1/10–1/50）

note.en: Cell lysates in PLB can be stored at -80°C (but fresh is best)
note.zh: PLB 裂解液可 -80°C 保存（但新鲜最佳）

name: Sandwich ELISA

notes.en: 7-point standard curve + blank. High-binding plates. Wash 3-5× PBST between steps. R² > 0.99.
notes.zh: 7 点标准曲线 + 空白。高结合力板。每步间用 PBST 洗 3-5 次。R² > 0.99。

ref: Engvall & Perlmann (1971) Immunochemistry 8:871

briefSteps.en: Coat plate with capture antibody → block → add samples/standards → detection antibody → enzyme conjugate → substrate → stop → read OD450
briefSteps.zh: 包被捕获抗体 → 封闭 → 加样品/标准品 → 检测抗体 → 酶标结合物 → 底物显色 → 终止 → 读取 OD450

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Plate Coating**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 包被**

detailedSteps.en: **Coat plate**: Dilute capture antibody to working concentration (typically 1–10 µg/mL) in coating buffer (0.05 M carbonate-bicarbonate buffer pH 9.6 or PBS). Add 100 µL/well to high-binding 96-well ELISA plate. Incubate overnight at 4°C (or 2 h at 37°C)
detailedSteps.zh: **包被**: 用包被缓冲液（0.05 M 碳酸盐缓冲液 pH 9.6 或 PBS）将捕获抗体稀释至工作浓度（通常 1–10 µg/mL）。加 100 µL/孔于高结合力 96 孔 ELISA 板。4°C 过夜孵育（或 37°C 2 h）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Assay**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Discard coating solution. Wash 3× with 300 µL/well PBST (PBS + 0.05% Tween-20). Blot plate on paper towels between washes
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 弃包被液。用 300 µL/孔 PBST（PBS + 0.05% Tween-20）洗涤 3 次。每次洗涤间在纸巾上扣干

detailedSteps.en: **Block**: Add 200 µL/well blocking buffer (1% BSA in PBS, or 5% non-fat milk in PBS). Incubate 1–2 h at RT with gentle rocking. Wash 3× PBST
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 每孔加 200 µL 封闭液（1% BSA-PBS 或 5% 脱脂奶粉-PBS）。室温轻摇孵育 1–2 h。PBST 洗涤 3 次

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare standards**: Prepare 7-point 2-fold serial dilution of recombinant protein standard in assay diluent (1% BSA-PBS). Include blank (diluent only). Dilute samples as needed in same diluent
detailedSteps.zh: **配制标准品**: 用检测稀释液（1% BSA-PBS）将重组蛋白标准品做 7 点 2 倍梯度稀释。设空白对照（仅稀释液）。样品用相同稀释液适当稀释

detailedSteps.en: **Add samples and standards**: Add 100 µL/well of standards and samples in duplicate. Incubate 2 h at RT (or overnight at 4°C for higher sensitivity). Wash 5× PBST
detailedSteps.zh: **加样品和标准品**: 每孔加 100 µL 标准品和样品，双复孔。室温孵育 2 h（或 4°C 过夜提高灵敏度）。PBST 洗涤 5 次

detailedSteps.en: **Detection antibody**: Add 100 µL/well biotinylated detection antibody at working concentration (typically 0.5–2 µg/mL in 1% BSA-PBS). Incubate 1 h at RT. Wash 5× PBST
detailedSteps.zh: **检测抗体**: 每孔加 100 µL 生物素化检测抗体工作浓度（通常 1% BSA-PBS 中 0.5–2 µg/mL）。室温孵育 1 h。PBST 洗涤 5 次

detailedSteps.en: **Enzyme conjugate**: Add 100 µL/well Streptavidin-HRP (diluted per manufacturer's instructions, typically 1:200–1:1000 in 1% BSA-PBS). Incubate 30 min at RT. Wash 5× PBST. ⚠️ Wash thoroughly — residual conjugate causes high background
detailedSteps.zh: **酶标结合物**: 每孔加 100 µL Streptavidin-HRP（按说明书稀释，通常 1% BSA-PBS 中 1:200–1:1000）。室温孵育 30 min。PBST 洗涤 5 次。⚠️ 充分洗涤——残留结合物导致高背景

detailedSteps.en: **Substrate**: Add 100 µL/well TMB substrate. Incubate 5–20 min at RT in the dark. Blue color develops proportionally to analyte concentration
detailedSteps.zh: **底物显色**: 每孔加 100 µL TMB 底物。室温避光孵育 5–20 min。蓝色深浅与分析物浓度成正比

detailedSteps.en: **Stop reaction**: Add 50 µL/well 2 N H₂SO₄ (stop solution). Color changes from blue to yellow. ⚠️ Add stop solution in same order and timing as substrate for consistent development time
detailedSteps.zh: **终止反应**: 每孔加 50 µL 2 N H₂SO₄（终止液）。颜色由蓝变黄。⚠️ 终止液加入顺序和时间应与底物一致，确保显色时间均匀

detailedSteps.en: **Read plate**: Measure OD at 450 nm (reference 570 nm) within 30 min of stopping. Subtract blank OD. Plot standard curve and calculate sample concentrations using 4-parameter logistic fit. R² should be >0.99
detailedSteps.zh: **读板**: 终止后 30 min 内测定 OD450（参考波长 570 nm）。减去空白 OD。绘制标准曲线，用四参数 logistic 拟合计算样品浓度。R² 应 >0.99

note.zh: 如 Corning #9018 或 Nunc MaxiSorp

note.en: Purified, matched pair with detection antibody
note.zh: 纯化的，与检测抗体配对
0.05 M 碳酸盐缓冲液 pH 9.6 或 PBS

note.en: Coated plate can be stored sealed at 4°C for up to 1 week
note.zh: 包被好的板密封后 4°C 可保存至多 1 周

note.en: Blocked plate can be stored sealed at 4°C overnight
note.zh: 封闭后的板密封 4°C 可过夜保存

name: Ethanol Precipitation of Nucleic Acids

components.name: 1. 加 1/10 vol 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.2)
components.note: DNA 也可用 NaCl 或 NH₄OAc

components.name: 2. 加 2.5 vol 冰冷 100% 乙醇
components.note: RNA 或低浓度 DNA: 加 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) 做载体

components.name: 3. 混匀, -20°C 放置 ≥30 min
components.note: 过夜可提高低浓度样品回收率

components.name: 5. 弃上清 → 加 500 µL 冰冷 70% 乙醇
7. 彻底去除上清
components.note: 吸管小心吸, 勿碰沉淀

components.name: 9. 溶解于 TE 或 H₂O

notes.en: 70% ethanol wash removes residual salts. Isopropanol precipitation (0.7 vol, no salt needed) uses less volume, good for large samples, but pellet contains more salt — wash extra. SDS co-precipitates — remove with KOAc or phenol-chloroform first. Do not use ethanol precipitation to recover DNA from <10 µL volumes.
notes.zh: 70% 乙醇洗涤去除残余盐。异丙醇沉淀 (0.7 vol, 无需加盐) 体积更小，适合大体积样品，但沉淀含更多盐需多洗一次。SDS 会共沉淀——需先用 KOAc 沉淀去除或酚氯仿提取。不要使用乙醇沉淀从 <10 µL 体积回收 DNA。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; Green & Sambrook (2012) Molecular Cloning, 4th Ed

briefSteps.en: Add salt → add 2–2.5 vol cold ethanol → incubate → centrifuge → wash 70% EtOH → air-dry → resuspend
briefSteps.zh: 加盐 → 加2–2.5倍冷乙醇 → 孵育 → 离心 → 70% EtOH洗涤 → 风干 → 重悬

detailedSteps.en: **Add co-precipitant (optional)**: Add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) if nucleic acid < 1 µg. Mix briefly
detailedSteps.zh: **加共沉淀剂（可选）**: 若核酸 < 1 µg，加 1 µL 糖原（20 mg/mL）。短暂混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Add salt**: Add 1/10 volume 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) for DNA/RNA; or 1/2 volume 7.5 M ammonium acetate for DNA (reduces dNTP carry-over). Mix by flicking
detailedSteps.zh: **加盐**: DNA/RNA 加 1/10 体积 3 M 醋酸钠（pH 5.2）；若 DNA 需去 dNTP 可加 1/2 体积 7.5 M 醋酸铵。弹指混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Add ethanol**: Add 2.5 volumes ice-cold 100% ethanol (for NaOAc) or 2 volumes (for NH₄OAc). Invert tube 5–6×
detailedSteps.zh: **加乙醇**: 加 2.5 倍体积冰冷 100% 乙醇（NaOAc）或 2 倍体积（NH₄OAc）。颠倒混匀 5–6 次

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: Place at −20°C for 30 min (DNA ≥ 100 ng) or −80°C for 15–30 min (low amounts/RNA). ⚠️ Do not freeze overnight with ammonium acetate — salt co-precipitates
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: DNA ≥ 100 ng 放 −20°C 30 min；少量/RNA 放 −80°C 15–30 min。⚠️ 勿用醋酸铵过夜冷冻——盐会共沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Centrifuge**: Spin 16,000×g, 4°C, 15–30 min. Orient tube hinge outward to locate pellet
detailedSteps.zh: **离心**: 16,000×g, 4°C, 15–30 min。管铰链朝外以便定位沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Remove supernatant**: Carefully aspirate with pipette, avoid disturbing the pellet (may be invisible)
detailedSteps.zh: **去上清**: 小心用移液器吸弃上清，避免触碰沉淀（可能不可见）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Add 500 µL ice-cold 70% ethanol. Invert once. Spin 16,000×g, 4°C, 5 min. Remove supernatant
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 加 500 µL 冰冷 70% 乙醇，颠倒一次。16,000×g, 4°C 离心 5 min。去上清

detailedSteps.en: **Repeat wash** (optional): Repeat 70% ethanol wash for higher purity, especially if high salt was used
detailedSteps.zh: **重复洗涤**（可选）: 若盐浓度高，再洗一次 70% 乙醇以提高纯度

detailedSteps.en: **Air-dry**: Leave tube open 5–10 min at RT. ⚠️ Do not over-dry (> 15 min) — pellet becomes difficult to resuspend. Do not use vacuum concentrator for RNA
detailedSteps.zh: **风干**: 室温开盖干燥 5–10 min。⚠️ 勿过度干燥（> 15 min）——沉淀难以重悬。RNA 勿用真空浓缩仪

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Add appropriate volume of TE buffer (pH 8.0) or nuclease-free water (5–50 µL). Pipet gently 10×. Incubate 5 min at 55°C if pellet is stubborn
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 加适量 TE 缓冲液（pH 8.0）或无核酸酶水（5–50 µL）。轻柔吹打 10 次。若难溶可 55°C 孵育 5 min

note.en: Alternative for DNA; reduces dNTP carry-over
Sample in ethanol can be stored at −20°C overnight
note.zh: 乙醇中样品可 −20°C 过夜保存

note.en: Pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at −20°C for weeks
note.zh: 沉淀在70%乙醇中可 −20°C 保存数周

name: Gel Extraction (DNA Recovery)

components.name: 1. 琼脂糖凝胶电泳分离 DNA 片段
2. UV/蓝光灯下切取目的条带
components.note: 低功率短时间暴露, 减少 UV 损伤; 蓝光更安全

components.name: 3. 称重胶块 → 加 3 vol Buffer QG
4. 50°C 孵育 10 min, 每 2–3 min 涡旋
components.note: 完全溶解, 颜色应为黄色 (pH ≤7.5)

components.name: 5. 加 1 gel vol 异丙醇 (>4 kb 片段可选)
6. 转移至柱, 离心 1 min
7. 洗涤 Buffer PE 750 µL, 离心 1 min
8. 空转离心 1 min 去残留乙醇
9. 洗脱: 30 µL EB 或 H₂O, 静置 1 min → 离心
components.note: 预热至 50°C 可提高大片段回收率

notes.en: Typical recovery 70-80%. Small fragments (<100 bp) recover poorly — use AMPure XP beads instead. Low-melting-point (LMP) agarose melts at 37°C, reducing DNA damage. TAE gels give better recovery than TBE. Do not use >2% agarose for large fragment recovery.
notes.zh: 回收率通常 70–80%。小片段 (<100 bp) 回收率低，建议用 Agencourt AMPure XP 磁珠代替。低熔点琼脂糖 (LMP agarose) 可直接在 37°C 溶解，减少 DNA 损伤。TAE 胶回收率优于 TBE。勿使用 >2% 琼脂糖凝胶做大片段回收。

ref: QIAGEN QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit Handbook; Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning

briefSteps.en: Run gel → excise band → dissolve in buffer → bind to column → wash → elute DNA
briefSteps.zh: 跑胶 → 切胶 → 溶胶 → 柱结合 → 洗涤 → 洗脱DNA

detailedSteps.en: **Run agarose gel**: Run 1–2% TAE or TBE agarose gel with DNA sample + loading dye. Include ladder
detailedSteps.zh: **琼脂糖凝胶电泳**: 用 1–2% TAE 或 TBE 琼脂糖凝胶跑样品 + 上样缓冲液。加 ladder

detailedSteps.en: **Visualize**: View gel on UV transilluminator (312 nm) or blue-light box. ⚠️ Minimize UV exposure time (< 30 s) to prevent DNA damage; use blue light for cloning applications
detailedSteps.zh: **观察**: 在 UV 透射仪（312 nm）或蓝光灯下观察。⚠️ 尽量缩短 UV 照射（< 30 s）防止 DNA 损伤；克隆用途请用蓝光

detailedSteps.en: **Excise band**: Using a clean scalpel, cut out the target band as tightly as possible. Trim excess agarose. Transfer to a 1.5 mL tube and weigh
detailedSteps.zh: **切胶**: 用干净手术刀尽量紧密切出目的条带，去除多余琼脂糖。转入 1.5 mL 管并称重

detailedSteps.en: **Dissolve gel**: Add 3 volumes (w/v) Buffer QG (or equivalent solubilization buffer). Incubate at 50°C for 10 min with vortexing every 2–3 min until fully dissolved. Solution should be yellow (pH ≤ 7.5)
detailedSteps.zh: **溶胶**: 加 3 倍体积（w/v）Buffer QG（或等效溶胶缓冲液）。50°C 孵育 10 min，每 2–3 min 涡旋一次至完全溶解。溶液应为黄色（pH ≤ 7.5）

detailedSteps.en: **Add isopropanol**: Add 1 gel volume isopropanol, mix. This increases yield for fragments > 500 bp or < 4 kb
detailedSteps.zh: **加异丙醇**: 加 1 倍凝胶体积的异丙醇，混匀。此步骤提高 > 500 bp 或 < 4 kb 片段的回收率

detailedSteps.en: **Bind to column**: Transfer to spin column. Centrifuge 17,900×g, 1 min. Discard flow-through. Repeat if volume > 700 µL
detailedSteps.zh: **柱结合**: 转入离心柱。17,900×g 离心 1 min，弃流出液。若体积 > 700 µL 分次加载

detailedSteps.en: **Wash (QG)**: Add 500 µL Buffer QG to column. Centrifuge 17,900×g, 1 min. Discard flow-through. This removes residual agarose
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤(QG)**: 加 500 µL Buffer QG。17,900×g 离心 1 min，弃流出液。去除残余琼脂糖

detailedSteps.en: **Wash (PE)**: Add 750 µL Buffer PE (ethanol-based). Stand 2–5 min. Centrifuge 17,900×g, 1 min. Discard flow-through
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤(PE)**: 加 750 µL Buffer PE（含乙醇）。静置 2–5 min。17,900×g 离心 1 min，弃流出液

detailedSteps.en: **Dry column**: Centrifuge empty column 17,900×g, 1 min to remove residual ethanol. ⚠️ Residual ethanol inhibits downstream ligation and sequencing
detailedSteps.zh: **干燥柱**: 空柱 17,900×g 离心 1 min 去除残余乙醇。⚠️ 残余乙醇会抑制后续连接和测序

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Place column in clean 1.5 mL tube. Add 30–50 µL Buffer EB (10 mM Tris-Cl, pH 8.5) or water to center of membrane. Stand 1 min. Centrifuge 17,900×g, 1 min
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 将柱转入干净 1.5 mL 管。加 30–50 µL Buffer EB（10 mM Tris-Cl, pH 8.5）或水于膜中心。静置 1 min。17,900×g 离心 1 min

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify**: Measure concentration by NanoDrop or Qubit. Typical recovery: 70–80% for 500 bp–4 kb fragments
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: 用 NanoDrop 或 Qubit 测浓度。典型回收率：500 bp–4 kb 片段 70–80%

note.zh: 溶胶/结合缓冲液（试剂盒组分）
含乙醇洗涤缓冲液（试剂盒组分）

note.en: Excised gel slice can be stored at −20°C in a sealed tube
note.zh: 切下的胶块可密封 −20°C 保存

note.en: Dissolved gel in QG buffer can be stored at −20°C
note.zh: 溶解在QG缓冲液中的胶可 −20°C 保存

name: Genomic DNA Extraction (Cells/Tissue)
nameCn: 基因组 DNA 提取（细胞/组织）

components.name: 1. 裂解：加 Lysis Buffer + Proteinase K
components.note: 56°C 孵育 1–3 h 或过夜; 组织需剪碎

components.name: 2. RNase A 处理 (可选, 37°C 30 min)
3. 蛋白沉淀 (加 Protein Precipitation Sol)
components.note: 涡旋 20 s → 冰上 5 min → 离心 16,000×g 3 min

components.name: 4. 异丙醇沉淀 DNA
components.note: 加等体积异丙醇到上清, 轻柔翻转

components.name: 7. 风干 5–15 min → 溶解于 TE
components.note: 室温或 65°C 孵育助溶解; 勿涡旋以避免剪切

notes.en: Phenol-chloroform method: replace step 3 with equal volume phenol:chloroform:IAA (25:24:1) extraction → chloroform:IAA extraction → ethanol precipitation. Use wide-bore tips for high-MW gDNA to avoid shearing. Blood samples: lyse RBCs first. FFPE tissue: deparaffinize first. Column extraction (DNeasy) is faster but yields lower MW DNA.
notes.zh: 酚氯仿提取法：步骤 3 换为等体积 phenol:chloroform:IAA (25:24:1) 提取 → 再用 chloroform:IAA 提取 → 乙醇沉淀。高分子量 gDNA 用宽口枪头操作，避免剪切。血液样品需先裂解红细胞。FFPE 组织需去石蜡。柱提取法 (DNeasy) 更快但产量和分子量较低。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; QIAGEN DNeasy Blood & Tissue Handbook

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells/tissue with Proteinase K → RNase treat → precipitate or column purify → wash → elute gDNA
briefSteps.zh: 蛋白酶K裂解细胞/组织 → RNase处理 → 沉淀或柱纯化 → 洗涤 → 洗脱gDNA

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells/tissue**: Pellet 1–5×10⁶ cells (300×g, 5 min) or mince 10–25 mg tissue finely with a scalpel
detailedSteps.zh: **收获细胞/组织**: 离心收集 1–5×10⁶ 细胞（300×g, 5 min）或用手术刀将 10–25 mg 组织切碎

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse**: Add 500 µL Lysis Buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM EDTA, 0.5% SDS) + 20 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL). Mix by inversion
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 加 500 µL 裂解缓冲液（10 mM Tris pH 8.0、100 mM NaCl、10 mM EDTA、0.5% SDS）+ 20 µL 蛋白酶K（20 mg/mL）。颠倒混匀

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: 56°C for 1–3 h (cells) or overnight (tissue). Invert occasionally. Solution should clarify
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 56°C 1–3 h（细胞）或过夜（组织）。偶尔颠倒。溶液应变澄清

detailedSteps.en: **RNase treatment**: Add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL). Incubate 37°C, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: **RNase处理**: 加 5 µL RNase A（10 mg/mL）。37°C 孵育 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Protein precipitation**: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution (or saturated NaCl, ~6 M). Vortex vigorously 20 s. Place on ice 5 min
detailedSteps.zh: **蛋白沉淀**: 加 200 µL 蛋白沉淀液（或饱和 NaCl ~6 M）。剧烈涡旋 20 s。冰上放置 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Centrifuge**: Spin 16,000×g, 10 min, RT. Transfer clear supernatant to a new tube. ⚠️ Avoid carrying over the white protein pellet
detailedSteps.zh: **离心**: 16,000×g, 10 min, 室温。将澄清上清转入新管。⚠️ 勿吸入白色蛋白沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Precipitate DNA**: Add 500 µL isopropanol. Invert gently 30×. DNA should appear as visible threads/clump
detailedSteps.zh: **DNA沉淀**: 加 500 µL 异丙醇。轻柔颠倒 30 次。应可见 DNA 丝状/团状沉淀

detailedSteps.en: **Centrifuge**: Spin 16,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Remove supernatant carefully
detailedSteps.zh: **离心**: 16,000×g, 4°C 离心 10 min。小心去除上清

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Add 1 mL 70% ethanol. Invert 5×. Spin 16,000×g, 5 min, 4°C. Remove ethanol completely
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 加 1 mL 70% 乙醇，颠倒 5 次。16,000×g, 4°C 离心 5 min。彻底去除乙醇

detailedSteps.en: **Air-dry**: Invert tube on clean paper towel 5–10 min. ⚠️ Do not over-dry — gDNA becomes very difficult to resuspend
detailedSteps.zh: **风干**: 倒扣管于干净纸巾上 5–10 min。⚠️ 勿过度干燥——gDNA 极难重悬

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Add 50–200 µL TE buffer (pH 8.0). Allow to dissolve at 65°C for 1 h or 4°C overnight with gentle rocking. Do NOT vortex — shears high-MW DNA
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 加 50–200 µL TE 缓冲液（pH 8.0）。65°C 溶解 1 h 或 4°C 过夜轻摇。⚠️ 勿涡旋——会剪切高分子量 DNA

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify & QC**: Measure by NanoDrop (A260/280 should be 1.8–2.0). Check integrity on 0.5% agarose gel — should run as a tight high-MW band > 20 kb
detailedSteps.zh: **定量与质控**: NanoDrop 测量（A260/280 应为 1.8–2.0）。0.5% 琼脂糖凝胶检测完整性——应为 > 20 kb 紧密高分子量条带

note.en: Lysate can be stored at −20°C after Proteinase K digestion
note.zh: 蛋白酶K消化后裂解液可 −20°C 保存

note.en: DNA pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at −20°C for weeks
note.zh: DNA沉淀在70%乙醇中可 −20°C 保存数周

name: Immunoprecipitation (IP)

components.name: 1. 裂解细胞 (IP Lysis Buffer + protease inhibitors)
components.note: 冰上 30 min, 间歇涡旋

components.name: 3. 定量 → 取 500 µg–1 mg 总蛋白
4. 预清除 (Protein A/G beads, 4°C, 1 h)
components.note: 去除非特异结合; 可选

components.name: 6. 加抗体 (1–5 µg) → 4°C 旋转孵育 2–4 h 或过夜
7. 加 Protein A/G beads (20–40 µL) → 4°C 旋转 1–2 h
8. 洗涤 3–5 次 (Lysis Buffer, 4°C)
components.note: 每次 1 mL, 旋转 5 min, 磁力架吸附

components.name: 9. 洗脱: 2× SDS Loading Buffer, 95°C 5 min
10. Western Blot 检测
components.note: IP 样品 + Input + IgG 对照

notes.en: Controls: (1) Normal IgG (same species) negative control; (2) Input positive control. For Co-IP: use mild lysis buffer (avoid SDS). Ab light/heavy chain interference in WB: use Clean-Blot IP Detection Reagent or crosslink Ab to beads. Magnetic beads have lower background than agarose. Endogenous IP is more physiologically relevant than overexpression IP.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) Normal IgG (同种属) 阴性对照; (2) Input 阳性对照。共免疫沉淀 (Co-IP)：使用温和裂解液（避免 SDS）。抗体轻链/重链干扰 WB 检测：用 Clean-Blot IP Detection Reagent 或交联抗体到 beads。磁珠比琼脂糖珠背景更低。内源性 IP 比 overexpression IP 更有生理意义。

ref: Harlow & Lane (1988) Antibodies: A Laboratory Manual; Cell Signaling Technology IP Protocol

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells → pre-clear → incubate with antibody → capture on beads → wash → elute → analyze by WB
briefSteps.zh: 裂解细胞 → 预清除 → 抗体孵育 → 磁珠/琼脂糖珠捕获 → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → WB分析

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Cell Lysis & Antibody Binding**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 细胞裂解与抗体结合**

detailedSteps.en: **Cell lysis**: Wash cells 1× with ice-cold PBS. Add 500–1000 µL IP Lysis Buffer (+ 1× protease inhibitors + 1× phosphatase inhibitors if studying phosphoproteins). Incubate on ice 30 min, vortex briefly every 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **细胞裂解**: 用冰冷 PBS 洗 1 次。加 500–1000 µL IP 裂解缓冲液（+ 1× 蛋白酶抑制剂 + 1× 磷酸酶抑制剂（若研究磷酸化蛋白））。冰上 30 min，每 10 min 短暂涡旋

detailedSteps.en: **Clarify lysate**: Centrifuge 16,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Transfer supernatant to a new pre-chilled tube. Measure protein concentration by BCA/Bradford
detailedSteps.zh: **澄清裂解液**: 16,000×g, 4°C 离心 15 min。上清转入预冷新管。BCA/Bradford 测蛋白浓度

detailedSteps.en: **Save input**: Remove 5–10% of lysate (50 µg) as input control. Add 1× Laemmli buffer, boil 5 min, store at −20°C
detailedSteps.zh: **留取input**: 取 5–10% 裂解液（50 µg）作为 input 对照。加 1× Laemmli 缓冲液，煮沸 5 min，−20°C 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-clear (optional)**: Add 20 µL Protein A/G agarose to remaining lysate (500 µg–2 mg). Rotate 4°C, 30 min. Spin 2,500×g, 2 min. Transfer supernatant to new tube
detailedSteps.zh: **预清除（可选）**: 向剩余裂解液（500 µg–2 mg）中加 20 µL Protein A/G 琼脂糖珠。4°C 旋转 30 min。2,500×g 离心 2 min。上清转入新管

detailedSteps.en: **Add antibody**: Add 1–5 µg target antibody (or species-matched IgG control to a parallel tube). Rotate 4°C overnight (or 2 h minimum)
detailedSteps.zh: **加抗体**: 加 1–5 µg 目标抗体（另设一管加同种属 IgG 对照）。4°C 旋转过夜（最少 2 h）

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Capture, Wash & Elution**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 捕获、洗涤与洗脱**

detailedSteps.en: **Capture**: Add 30–50 µL pre-washed Protein A/G magnetic beads (or agarose). Rotate 4°C, 1–2 h
detailedSteps.zh: **捕获**: 加 30–50 µL 预洗 Protein A/G 磁珠（或琼脂糖珠）。4°C 旋转 1–2 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Place on magnet (or spin 2,500×g, 1 min). Remove supernatant. Wash 3–5× with 1 mL ice-cold IP Lysis Buffer. ⚠️ For stringent wash, use RIPA for the last wash
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 上磁力架（或 2,500×g 离心 1 min），去上清。用 1 mL 冰冷 IP 裂解缓冲液洗 3–5 次。⚠️ 最后一次可用 RIPA 严格洗涤

detailedSteps.en: **Final wash**: Wash 1× with ice-cold PBS to remove detergent
detailedSteps.zh: **最终洗涤**: 用冰冷 PBS 洗 1 次以去除去垢剂

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Add 40–60 µL 2× Laemmli buffer. Boil 95°C, 5 min (or 70°C, 10 min to reduce IgG heavy chain dissociation). Collect eluate on magnet/by spinning
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 加 40–60 µL 2× Laemmli 缓冲液。95°C 煮沸 5 min（或 70°C 10 min 以减少 IgG 重链解离）。磁力架/离心收集洗脱液

detailedSteps.en: **Western blot**: Load IP eluate, IgG control, and input on SDS-PAGE. Proceed with standard WB protocol
detailedSteps.zh: **Western blot**: 上样 IP 洗脱液、IgG 对照和 input。按标准 WB 流程进行

note.en: Clarified lysate can be snap-frozen and stored at −80°C
note.zh: 澄清裂解液可速冻后 −80°C 保存

note.en: Antibody-lysate can incubate overnight at 4°C (standard practice)
note.zh: 抗体-裂解液 4°C 过夜孵育（标准操作）

name: Northern Blot

components.name: 1. RNA 提取 + 定量 (5–30 µg total RNA)
2. 变性琼脂糖凝胶（1.2% + 甲醛）
3. RNA 变性：65°C 15 min + 冰上
6. 毛细转印至尼龙膜 (过夜, 20× SSC)
8. 预杂交 (42°C, 1 h)
components.note: 含 50% 甲酰胺的杂交液

components.name: 9. 杂交 (探针 + 杂交液, 42°C 过夜)
components.note: DIG 标记或 ³²P 标记探针

components.name: 10. 低严格洗涤 (2× SSC/0.1% SDS, RT, 2×5 min)
12. 检测（放射自显影 / DIG 化学发光）

notes.en: Use RNase-free reagents and equipment throughout. Run formaldehyde gel in fume hood. DIG-labeled probes are safer than radioactive, slightly less sensitive. Positive control: housekeeping gene (GAPDH, β-actin). RNA quality assessed by 28S/18S ratio (~2:1).
notes.zh: 所有操作使用 RNase-free 试剂和器具。甲醛凝胶在通风橱中操作。DIG 标记探针比放射性标记更安全，灵敏度稍低。阳性对照：管家基因（GAPDH, β-actin）。RNA 质量可通过 28S/18S 比值（~2:1）评估。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, Ch. 7; Alwine et al. (1977) PNAS 74:5350

briefSteps.en: Extract RNA → denature → run formaldehyde gel → transfer to membrane → UV crosslink → hybridize probe → wash → detect
briefSteps.zh: 提取RNA → 变性 → 甲醛凝胶电泳 → 转膜 → UV交联 → 探针杂交 → 洗涤 → 检测

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Gel Electrophoresis & Transfer**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 凝胶电泳与转膜**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare RNA**: Use 5–30 µg total RNA per lane. Measure concentration and check integrity (RIN > 7 or clear 28S/18S bands on agarose). ⚠️ Work RNase-free: use DEPC-treated water, clean surfaces with RNaseZap
detailedSteps.zh: **准备RNA**: 每泳道 5–30 µg 总 RNA。测浓度并检查完整性（RIN > 7 或琼脂糖凝胶上清晰 28S/18S 条带）。⚠️ 无 RNase 操作：用 DEPC 水，RNaseZap 擦拭台面

detailedSteps.en: **Denature RNA**: Mix RNA with 2× RNA Loading Dye containing formamide and formaldehyde. Heat 65°C, 15 min. Snap-cool on ice 5 min. Add 1 µL EtBr (10 mg/mL) per sample
detailedSteps.zh: **RNA变性**: RNA 与含甲酰胺和甲醛的 2× RNA 上样缓冲液混合。65°C 加热 15 min。冰上速冷 5 min。每样加 1 µL EtBr（10 mg/mL）

detailedSteps.en: **Cast denaturing gel**: Prepare 1.2% agarose in 1× MOPS buffer + 6.6% formaldehyde. Pour in fume hood. Let solidify 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: **制变性凝胶**: 1× MOPS 缓冲液中制 1.2% 琼脂糖 + 6.6% 甲醛。通风橱中灌胶。凝固 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Electrophoresis**: Load denatured RNA. Run at 3–5 V/cm in 1× MOPS running buffer for 2–3 h. Check separation under UV
detailedSteps.zh: **电泳**: 上样变性 RNA。1× MOPS 电泳缓冲液中 3–5 V/cm 跑 2–3 h。UV 下检查分离

detailedSteps.en: **Photograph gel**: Document gel with UV to confirm RNA quality and equal loading (compare 28S/18S rRNA intensity)
detailedSteps.zh: **拍照**: UV 下拍照记录凝胶，确认 RNA 质量及上样均一性（比较 28S/18S rRNA 强度）

detailedSteps.en: **Capillary transfer**: Set up overnight transfer to nylon membrane (positively charged, e.g. Hybond-N+) using 20× SSC. Stack: wick → gel (face down) → membrane → filter papers → paper towels → weight
detailedSteps.zh: **毛细转移**: 用 20× SSC 组装过夜转膜至带正电尼龙膜（如 Hybond-N+）。顺序：引液纸 → 凝胶（面朝下）→ 膜 → 滤纸 → 纸巾 → 重物

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Crosslink & Hybridization**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 交联与杂交**

detailedSteps.en: **Disassemble & crosslink**: Remove membrane. Rinse briefly in 2× SSC. UV crosslink at 120 mJ/cm² (or bake 80°C, 2 h). Mark RNA side. ⚠️ Do not let membrane dry before crosslinking
detailedSteps.zh: **拆装并交联**: 取出膜，2× SSC 短暂漂洗。UV 交联 120 mJ/cm²（或 80°C 烘烤 2 h）。标记 RNA 面。⚠️ 交联前勿让膜干燥

detailedSteps.en: **Pre-hybridize**: Place membrane in hybridization tube with 10 mL pre-warmed hybridization buffer (e.g. ULTRAhyb or Church buffer). Incubate 42°C (or 68°C for Church), 1–2 h with rotation
detailedSteps.zh: **预杂交**: 膜放入杂交管，加 10 mL 预热杂交缓冲液（如 ULTRAhyb 或 Church 缓冲液）。42°C（Church 用 68°C）旋转孵育 1–2 h

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare probe**: Label antisense probe (³²P-dCTP random priming for radioactive, or DIG/biotin for non-radioactive). Denature at 95°C, 5 min; snap-cool on ice
detailedSteps.zh: **制备探针**: 标记反义探针（放射性用 ³²P-dCTP 随机引物标记，非放射性用 DIG/biotin）。95°C 变性 5 min；冰上速冷

detailedSteps.en: **Hybridize**: Add denatured probe to hybridization buffer (final ~1×10⁶ cpm/mL for ³²P). Incubate overnight at 42°C (ULTRAhyb) or 68°C (Church) with rotation
detailedSteps.zh: **杂交**: 将变性探针加入杂交液（³²P 终浓度 ~1×10⁶ cpm/mL）。42°C（ULTRAhyb）或 68°C（Church）旋转过夜杂交

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Wash & Detection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天 — 洗涤与检测**

detailedSteps.en: **Low-stringency wash**: 2× SSC / 0.1% SDS, RT, 5 min × 2
detailedSteps.zh: **低严格洗涤**: 2× SSC / 0.1% SDS，室温 5 min × 2 次

detailedSteps.en: **High-stringency wash**: 0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS, 42–68°C, 15–30 min × 2. ⚠️ Adjust stringency based on probe homology
detailedSteps.zh: **高严格洗涤**: 0.1× SSC / 0.1% SDS，42–68°C，15–30 min × 2 次。⚠️ 根据探针同源性调整严格度

detailedSteps.en: **Detection**: For ³²P: expose to phosphor screen 4–24 h, scan on PhosphorImager. For DIG: follow chemiluminescent detection kit. For biotin: streptavidin-HRP + ECL
detailedSteps.zh: **检测**: ³²P：磷屏曝光 4–24 h，PhosphorImager 扫描。DIG：按化学发光检测试剂盒操作。Biotin：链霉亲和素-HRP + ECL

detailedSteps.en: **Strip & re-probe (optional)**: Strip membrane in boiling 0.1% SDS, 15 min. Verify by re-exposing. Re-probe with loading control (e.g. GAPDH, 18S)
detailedSteps.zh: **剥离与重探（可选）**: 沸腾 0.1% SDS 中剥离膜 15 min。重新曝光验证。用内参探针（如 GAPDH、18S）重探

note.en: Molecular biology grade, use in fume hood
note.zh: 分子生物学级，通风橱中使用
ULTRAhyb 或 Church 缓冲液

note.en: UV-crosslinked membrane can be stored dry at RT or −20°C for months
note.zh: UV交联后的膜可室温或 −20°C 干燥保存数月
杂交可过夜进行（标准操作）

note.en: Washed membrane can be wrapped in plastic wrap and exposed later
note.zh: 洗涤后的膜可用保鲜膜包裹后延后曝光

name: Standard PCR Amplification

components.name: 1. 冰上配制反应体系 (做 master mix)
3. 琼脂糖凝胶验证
components.note: 取 5 µL + loading dye, 1–2% 琼脂糖凝胶

notes.en: Use Q5/Phusion for high-fidelity PCR (proofreading, 100× lower error rate). Tm calculator: NEB Tm Calculator (tmcalculator.neb.com). NTC (no template control) required. Multiple bands: reduce primer concentration, raise annealing temp, reduce cycles. Smear: optimize Mg²⁺. No product: lower annealing temp, increase template, check primer orientation. GC-rich templates: add 3-5% DMSO or GC enhancer.
notes.zh: 高保真 PCR 用 Q5/Phusion（校对功能, 错误率低 100×）。Tm 计算：NEB Tm Calculator (tmcalculator.neb.com)。无模板对照 (NTC) 必须。多条带：降低引物浓度、提高退火温度、减少循环数。涂片：优化 Mg²⁺ 浓度。无产物：降低退火温度、增加模板量、检查引物方向。GC-rich 模板加 3–5% DMSO 或用 GC enhancer。

ref: Saiki et al. (1988) Science 239:487; NEB PCR Protocol (neb.com)

briefSteps.en: Design primers → set up reaction → run thermocycler (denature–anneal–extend) → verify on gel
briefSteps.zh: 设计引物 → 配反应体系 → 运行PCR仪（变性–退火–延伸）→ 凝胶验证

detailedSteps.en: **Design primers**: 18–25 nt, Tm 55–65°C (ΔTm < 3°C between pair), 40–60% GC, avoid 3′ complementarity. Check for secondary structures and off-targets with NCBI Primer-BLAST
detailedSteps.zh: **设计引物**: 18–25 nt，Tm 55–65°C（引物对 ΔTm < 3°C），GC 含量 40–60%，避免 3′ 互补。用 NCBI Primer-BLAST 检查二级结构和脱靶

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare master mix**: Per 50 µL reaction: 25 µL 2× Taq Master Mix, 2 µL forward primer (10 µM, final 0.4 µM), 2 µL reverse primer (10 µM, final 0.4 µM), 1–100 ng template DNA, nuclease-free water to 50 µL. ⚠️ Set up on ice. Include no-template control (NTC)
detailedSteps.zh: **配主混液**: 每 50 µL 反应：25 µL 2× Taq Master Mix、2 µL 正向引物（10 µM，终 0.4 µM）、2 µL 反向引物（10 µM，终 0.4 µM）、1–100 ng 模板 DNA、无核酸酶水补至 50 µL。⚠️ 冰上操作。设无模板对照（NTC）

detailedSteps.en: **Mix & spin**: Pipet mix gently or flick tube. Quick-spin to collect liquid at bottom
detailedSteps.zh: **混匀离心**: 轻柔吹打混匀或弹管。快速离心收集液体

detailedSteps.en: **Initial denaturation**: 95°C, 3–5 min (hot-start enzyme may need 95°C, 15 min)
detailedSteps.zh: **初始变性**: 95°C, 3–5 min（热启动酶可能需 95°C, 15 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Cycling (25–35 cycles)**: Denature 95°C, 30 s → Anneal (Tm − 5°C), 30 s → Extend 72°C, 1 min/kb. ⚠️ Use ≤ 30 cycles for cloning to minimize errors
detailedSteps.zh: **循环（25–35个循环）**: 变性 95°C 30 s → 退火（Tm − 5°C）30 s → 延伸 72°C 1 min/kb。⚠️ 克隆用途 ≤ 30 个循环以减少错误

detailedSteps.en: **Final extension**: 72°C, 5–10 min to complete all partial products
detailedSteps.zh: **末端延伸**: 72°C, 5–10 min，使所有未完成产物充分延伸

detailedSteps.en: **Hold**: 4°C hold (indefinitely on thermocycler, but transfer to −20°C for long-term storage)
detailedSteps.zh: **保持**: 4°C 保持（可留在 PCR 仪上，但长期保存需转 −20°C）

detailedSteps.en: **Gel verification**: Load 5 µL product + 1 µL 6× loading dye on 1–2% agarose/TAE gel. Run alongside 100 bp or 1 kb ladder. Expect single band at predicted size. NTC should be clean
detailedSteps.zh: **凝胶验证**: 取 5 µL 产物 + 1 µL 6× 上样缓冲液，上 1–2% 琼脂糖/TAE 凝胶。同时跑 100 bp 或 1 kb ladder。预期为预测大小的单一条带。NTC 应无条带

detailedSteps.en: **Troubleshooting**: No band → lower annealing temp, increase Mg²⁺ or template; multiple bands → increase annealing temp, reduce cycles; smear → reduce template amount, check primer design
detailedSteps.zh: **故障排除**: 无条带 → 降低退火温度、增加 Mg²⁺ 或模板量；多条带 → 升高退火温度、减少循环数；弥散 → 减少模板量、检查引物设计

note.zh: 基因组DNA 1–100 ng 或质粒 0.1–1 ng
100 bp 或 1 kb，视需要选择

note.en: PCR product at 4°C is stable overnight; −20°C for longer
note.zh: PCR产物 4°C 过夜稳定；长期保存 −20°C

name: Plasmid Maxiprep (Alkaline Lysis)

components.name: 1. 过夜培养 100–500 mL LB + 抗性
3. 重悬 (Buffer P1/Resuspension)
components.note: 含 RNase A, 彻底重悬无颗粒

components.name: 4. 碱裂解 (Buffer P2/Lysis)
components.note: 轻柔翻转 4–6 次, 室温 ≤5 min

components.name: 5. 中和 (Buffer P3/Neutralization)
components.note: 立即翻转混匀, 冰上 15–20 min

components.name: 12. 70% 乙醇洗涤 → 风干 → TE 溶解

notes.en: Typical yield: 100 mL high-copy plasmid culture → 500-1000 µg DNA. Endotoxin-free plasmid for transfection/in vivo use requires endotoxin removal column. Avoid excessive vortexing to prevent genomic DNA contamination.
notes.zh: 典型产量：100 mL 高拷贝质粒 → 500–1000 µg DNA。Endotoxin-free 质粒用于转染/体内实验需使用 endotoxin removal column。避免过度涡旋导致基因组 DNA 污染。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning, 3rd Ed; QIAGEN Plasmid Purification Handbook

briefSteps.en: Grow overnight culture → pellet bacteria → alkaline lysis → neutralize → column bind → wash → elute → precipitate → resuspend
briefSteps.zh: 过夜培养 → 收菌 → 碱裂解 → 中和 → 柱结合 → 洗涤 → 洗脱 → 沉淀 → 重悬

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Overnight Culture**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 过夜培养**

detailedSteps.en: **Inoculate**: Pick a single colony into 200–500 mL LB + appropriate antibiotic (e.g. 100 µg/mL ampicillin). Grow 37°C, 225 rpm, 12–16 h. ⚠️ Do not exceed 16 h — overgrowth reduces yield and increases genomic DNA contamination
detailedSteps.zh: **接种**: 挑单克隆至 200–500 mL LB + 相应抗生素（如 100 µg/mL 氨苄青霉素）。37°C, 225 rpm 培养 12–16 h。⚠️ 勿超过 16 h——过度生长降低产量并增加基因组 DNA 污染

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — Harvest & Purification**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — 收菌与纯化**

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest**: Centrifuge 6,000×g, 15 min, 4°C. Pour off supernatant. Drain well
detailedSteps.zh: **收菌**: 6,000×g, 4°C 离心 15 min。倒弃上清。充分沥干

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Add 10 mL Buffer P1 (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA, 100 µg/mL RNase A). Vortex until no clumps remain
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 加 10 mL Buffer P1（50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0、10 mM EDTA、100 µg/mL RNase A）。涡旋至无颗粒

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse**: Add 10 mL Buffer P2 (200 mM NaOH, 1% SDS). Invert 6× gently. Incubate RT, 5 min. ⚠️ Do not vortex or exceed 5 min — shears genomic DNA
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解**: 加 10 mL Buffer P2（200 mM NaOH, 1% SDS）。轻柔颠倒 6 次。室温 5 min。⚠️ 勿涡旋或超过 5 min——会剪切基因组 DNA

detailedSteps.en: **Neutralize**: Add 10 mL ice-cold Buffer P3 (3 M KOAc, pH 5.5). Invert 6× immediately. White precipitate forms. Incubate on ice 20 min
detailedSteps.zh: **中和**: 加 10 mL 冰冷 Buffer P3（3 M KOAc, pH 5.5）。立即颠倒 6 次。出现白色沉淀。冰上 20 min

detailedSteps.en: **Clarify**: Centrifuge 20,000×g, 30 min, 4°C. Transfer clear supernatant through cheesecloth or syringe filter to a new tube
detailedSteps.zh: **澄清**: 20,000×g, 4°C 离心 30 min。将澄清上清通过纱布或注射器过滤器转入新管

detailedSteps.en: **Equilibrate column**: Apply 10 mL Buffer QBT to QIAGEN-tip 500 (or equivalent anion-exchange column). Allow to drain by gravity
detailedSteps.zh: **平衡柱**: 向 QIAGEN-tip 500（或等效阴离子交换柱）加 10 mL Buffer QBT。重力流排液

detailedSteps.en: **Bind**: Apply cleared lysate to column. Allow to drain by gravity (~30 min)
detailedSteps.zh: **结合**: 将澄清裂解液加至柱上。重力流排液（~30 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash column 2× with 30 mL Buffer QC. Allow to drain completely
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 用 30 mL Buffer QC 洗柱 2 次。完全排液

detailedSteps.en: **Elute**: Elute DNA with 15 mL Buffer QF (1.25 M NaCl, 50 mM Tris pH 8.5, 15% isopropanol) into a clean 50 mL tube
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 用 15 mL Buffer QF（1.25 M NaCl、50 mM Tris pH 8.5、15% 异丙醇）洗脱 DNA 至干净 50 mL 管

detailedSteps.en: **Precipitate**: Add 10.5 mL (0.7 vol) isopropanol. Mix. Centrifuge 15,000×g, 30 min, 4°C
detailedSteps.zh: **沉淀**: 加 10.5 mL（0.7 倍体积）异丙醇。混匀。15,000×g, 4°C 离心 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash pellet with 5 mL 70% ethanol. Spin 15,000×g, 10 min, 4°C. Remove ethanol carefully
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 用 5 mL 70% 乙醇洗沉淀。15,000×g, 4°C 离心 10 min。小心去除乙醇

detailedSteps.en: **Air-dry & resuspend**: Air-dry 10 min. Resuspend in 200–500 µL TE buffer or nuclease-free water. Let dissolve 10 min at RT. ⚠️ For transfection, use endotoxin-free water and verify A260/280 ≥ 1.8
detailedSteps.zh: **风干与重悬**: 风干 10 min。加 200–500 µL TE 缓冲液或无核酸酶水重悬。室温溶解 10 min。⚠️ 转染用途需用无内毒素水，确认 A260/280 ≥ 1.8

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify**: Measure by NanoDrop. Typical yield: 500–2000 µg from 500 mL culture. Check A260/280 (1.8–2.0) and A260/230 (> 2.0)

note.en: Overnight culture grows while you sleep (Day 1→2)
note.zh: 过夜培养（第一天→第二天）

note.en: Neutralized lysate can be stored at −20°C before column
note.zh: 中和裂解液可在上柱前 −20°C 保存

note.en: DNA pellet in 70% ethanol can be stored at −20°C
note.zh: DNA沉淀在70%乙醇中可 −20°C 保存

name: Proximity Ligation Assay (PLA)

notes.en: Each fluorescent dot = one interaction (<40 nm). Include single-Ab controls. Quantify dots per cell with ImageJ.
notes.zh: 每个荧光点 = 一次互作（<40 nm）。包含单抗体对照。用 ImageJ 定量每细胞点数。

ref: Söderberg et al. (2006) Nat Methods 3:995

briefSteps.en: Fix → permeabilize → block → primary antibodies → PLA probes → ligation → amplification → mount → image
briefSteps.zh: 固定 → 透化 → 封闭 → 一抗 → PLA探针 → 连接 → 扩增 → 封片 → 成像

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Fixation & Primary Antibodies**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 固定与一抗**

detailedSteps.en: **Fix cells**: Remove media, wash 1× PBS. Fix with 4% PFA at RT for 15 min (or −20°C methanol 10 min for nuclear targets)
detailedSteps.zh: **固定细胞**: 去培养基，PBS 洗 1 次。4% PFA 室温固定 15 min（核内靶点可用 −20°C 甲醇 10 min）

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash 3× with PBS, 5 min each on shaker
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: PBS 洗 3 次，每次 5 min，摇床上

detailedSteps.en: **Permeabilize**: Incubate with 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS, RT, 10 min
detailedSteps.zh: **透化**: 0.1–0.5% Triton X-100/PBS 室温孵育 10 min

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash 2× with PBS, 5 min each
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: PBS 洗 2 次，每次 5 min

detailedSteps.en: **Block**: Add Duolink Blocking Solution. Incubate 37°C, 1 h in humidified chamber
detailedSteps.zh: **封闭**: 加 Duolink 封闭液。37°C 湿盒中孵育 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Primary antibodies**: Dilute two primary antibodies (from different host species, e.g. mouse + rabbit) in Duolink Antibody Diluent. Apply to cells. Incubate 4°C overnight in humidified chamber. ⚠️ Antibodies must be from different species
detailedSteps.zh: **一抗**: 用 Duolink 抗体稀释液稀释两种一抗（来自不同宿主，如鼠 + 兔）。加至细胞。4°C 湿盒过夜。⚠️ 两种抗体必须来自不同物种

detailedSteps.en: **Day 2 — PLA Probes, Ligation & Amplification**
detailedSteps.zh: **第二天 — PLA探针、连接与扩增**

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Remove antibodies. Wash 2× with Duolink Wash Buffer A, 5 min each, RT
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 去除抗体。Duolink Wash Buffer A 洗 2 次，每次 5 min，室温

detailedSteps.en: **PLA probes**: Dilute PLUS and MINUS PLA probes 1:5 in Duolink Antibody Diluent. Apply to cells. Incubate 37°C, 1 h in humidified chamber
detailedSteps.zh: **PLA探针**: 用 Duolink 抗体稀释液 1:5 稀释 PLUS 和 MINUS PLA 探针。加至细胞。37°C 湿盒 1 h

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash 2× with Wash Buffer A, 5 min each, RT
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: Wash Buffer A 洗 2 次，每次 5 min，室温

detailedSteps.en: **Ligation**: Dilute Duolink Ligation stock 1:5 in water, add ligase 1:40. Apply to cells. Incubate 37°C, 30 min
detailedSteps.zh: **连接**: Duolink 连接母液用水 1:5 稀释，加连接酶 1:40。加至细胞。37°C 30 min

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash 2× with Wash Buffer A, 2 min each, RT
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: Wash Buffer A 洗 2 次，每次 2 min，室温

detailedSteps.en: **Amplification**: Dilute Duolink Amplification stock 1:5 in water, add polymerase 1:80. Apply to cells. Incubate 37°C, 100 min. ⚠️ Protect from light from this step onward
detailedSteps.zh: **扩增**: Duolink 扩增母液用水 1:5 稀释，加聚合酶 1:80。加至细胞。37°C 100 min。⚠️ 从此步骤开始避光

detailedSteps.en: **Wash**: Wash 2× with 1× Wash Buffer B, 10 min each, RT, in the dark
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤**: 1× Wash Buffer B 避光洗 2 次，每次 10 min，室温

detailedSteps.en: **Final wash**: Wash 1× with 0.01× Wash Buffer B, 1 min
detailedSteps.zh: **末洗**: 0.01× Wash Buffer B 洗 1 次，1 min

detailedSteps.en: **Mount**: Apply Duolink In Situ Mounting Medium with DAPI. Coverslip. Seal edges with nail polish. ⚠️ Store slides at −20°C in dark; image within 1 week for best signal
detailedSteps.zh: **封片**: 加 Duolink In Situ 含 DAPI 封片剂。盖盖玻片。指甲油封边。⚠️ 玻片 −20°C 避光保存；1 周内成像信号最佳

detailedSteps.en: **Image**: Acquire on fluorescence or confocal microscope. PLA signals appear as discrete fluorescent dots. Quantify dots per cell using ImageJ/FIJI (Analyze Particles)
detailedSteps.zh: **成像**: 荧光或共聚焦显微镜采集。PLA 信号为离散荧光点。用 ImageJ/FIJI（Analyze Particles）量化每细胞荧光点数

note.en: Includes blocking solution, antibody diluent, PLA probes, ligation, amplification reagents, wash buffers, mounting medium
note.zh: 包含封闭液、抗体稀释液、PLA探针、连接、扩增试剂、洗涤缓冲液、封片剂
一抗 4°C 过夜孵育（标准操作）

name: Restriction Enzyme Digestion

components.name: DNA template
components.note: 质粒 0.5–1 µg; 基因组 DNA 5–10 µg

components.name: Restriction Enzyme(s)
components.note: 5–10 U per µg DNA; 体积 ≤10% 总反应 (避免甘油抑制)

components.name: 2. 37°C 孵育 1–2 h（或按酶推荐温度）
3. 热灭活 65°C 20 min（如适用）
components.note: 部分酶不可热灭活，需柱纯化

notes.en: For double digestion, confirm buffer compatibility (NEB recommends rCutSmart universal buffer). Star activity: avoid excess enzyme, prolonged incubation, high glycerol. Methylation-sensitive enzymes (DpnI cuts only methylated DNA, used for template removal). Some sticky ends may need blunting (Klenow) before ligation.
notes.zh: 双酶切时确认 buffer 兼容性（NEB 推荐使用 rCutSmart 通用 buffer）。Star activity：避免过量酶、长时间孵育、高甘油浓度。甲基化敏感酶（DpnI 仅切甲基化 DNA，用于去除模板）。部分粘性末端可能需要补平（Klenow）后连接。

ref: Sambrook & Russell (2001) Molecular Cloning; NEB Technical Reference: Restriction Enzymes

briefSteps.en: Set up reaction (DNA + enzyme + buffer) → incubate 37°C → heat-inactivate → verify on gel
briefSteps.zh: 配反应体系（DNA+酶+缓冲液）→ 37°C孵育 → 热灭活 → 凝胶验证

detailedSteps.en: **Plan digest**: Check enzyme(s) on NEB/manufacturer website for compatible buffer, optimal temperature, methylation sensitivity, and star activity conditions. For double digests, use NEBcloner or Double Digest Finder
detailedSteps.zh: **规划酶切**: 在 NEB/厂商网站查酶的兼容缓冲液、最适温度、甲基化敏感性及星号活性条件。双酶切用 NEBcloner 或 Double Digest Finder

detailedSteps.en: **Set up reaction**: In a 1.5 mL tube on ice, combine: DNA (0.5–1 µg plasmid or 5–10 µg gDNA), 5 µL 10× reaction buffer, 1–2 µL restriction enzyme (5–20 U), nuclease-free water to 50 µL. ⚠️ Enzyme should be ≤ 10% of total volume (glycerol inhibition)
detailedSteps.zh: **配反应体系**: 冰上 1.5 mL 管中加：DNA（质粒 0.5–1 µg 或 gDNA 5–10 µg）、5 µL 10× 反应缓冲液、1–2 µL 限制酶（5–20 U）、无核酸酶水补至 50 µL。⚠️ 酶体积 ≤ 总体积 10%（甘油抑制）

detailedSteps.en: **Mix gently**: Pipet up and down or flick tube. Do not vortex. Quick-spin
detailedSteps.zh: **轻柔混匀**: 吹打或弹管。勿涡旋。快速离心

detailedSteps.en: **Incubate**: 37°C (or enzyme-specific temperature), 1 h for analytical digest, 1–4 h for preparative digest. For genomic DNA Southern blot digests: overnight at 37°C with additional enzyme added after 2 h
detailedSteps.zh: **孵育**: 37°C（或酶特异温度），分析性酶切 1 h，制备性酶切 1–4 h。基因组 DNA Southern 酶切：37°C 过夜，2 h 后追加酶

detailedSteps.en: **Heat-inactivate**: 65°C, 20 min (for most enzymes) or 80°C, 20 min (for some enzymes — check datasheet). Some enzymes cannot be heat-inactivated — purify by column or phenol-chloroform
detailedSteps.zh: **热灭活**: 65°C 20 min（多数酶）或 80°C 20 min（部分酶——查说明书）。某些酶无法热灭活——需柱纯化或酚氯仿纯化

detailedSteps.en: **Add phosphatase (optional)**: For vector preparation, add 1 µL CIP/SAP/rSAP and incubate 37°C, 30 min to prevent self-ligation
detailedSteps.zh: **加磷酸酶（可选）**: 载体制备时，加 1 µL CIP/SAP/rSAP，37°C 30 min，防止自连

detailedSteps.en: **Gel verification**: Load 5 µL on 0.8–1.5% agarose gel alongside uncut DNA and ladder. Confirm expected fragment sizes. Complete digestion shows no uncut band
detailedSteps.zh: **凝胶验证**: 取 5 µL 上 0.8–1.5% 琼脂糖凝胶，同时跑未切 DNA 和 ladder。确认片段大小符合预期。完全酶切应无未切条带

detailedSteps.en: **Purify (if needed)**: For downstream cloning, purify digested DNA by column cleanup or gel extraction to remove enzyme, buffer salts, and small fragments
detailedSteps.zh: **纯化（如需）**: 用于后续克隆时，柱纯化或凝胶回收去除酶、缓冲盐和小片段

note.zh: 酶特异性缓冲液或 CutSmart（NEB）
质粒 0.5–1 µg 或 gDNA 5–10 µg
磷酸酶用于载体去磷酸化
1 kb 或 100 bp，视需要选择

note.en: Digest can incubate overnight at 37°C for genomic DNA applications
Heat-inactivated digest can be stored at −20°C
note.zh: 热灭活后的酶切产物可 −20°C 保存

name: RNA Column Extraction (Silica-based)

components.name: 1. 裂解：加 Buffer RLT + β-ME，涡旋
2. 匀浆（组织用匀浆器/针头 5–10 次）
3. 加等体积 70% 乙醇，混匀
4. 转移至 RNeasy 柱，离心 15 s ≥8,000×g
6. On-column DNase I 消化（可选）
components.note: 加 80 µL DNase I mix, 室温 15 min

components.name: 8. 洗涤 Buffer RPE 2× (500 µL)
components.note: 第二次离心 2 min 干燥膜

components.name: 9. 洗脱：30–50 µL RNase-free H₂O
components.note: 静置 1 min → 离心, 可重复一次提高产量

notes.en: Fast (~30 min) and reproducible. Lower yield than TRIzol but higher purity, ideal for RT-qPCR/RNA-seq. Small RNAs (<200 nt, including miRNA) require miRNA enrichment column. Tissue must be stored in RNAlater or flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen.
notes.zh: 快速（~30 min）且重现性好。产量低于 TRIzol，但纯度高，适合 RT-qPCR/RNA-seq。小量 RNA（<200 nt, 含 miRNA）需用 miRNA enrichment column。组织需在 RNAlater 中保存或液氮速冻。

ref: QIAGEN RNeasy Mini Handbook; Chomczynski & Sacchi (2006) Nat Protoc 1:581

briefSteps.en: Lyse cells → homogenize → add ethanol → bind to silica column → wash → DNase digest on column → wash → elute RNA
briefSteps.zh: 裂解细胞 → 匀浆 → 加乙醇 → 硅胶柱结合 → 洗涤 → 柱上DNase消化 → 洗涤 → 洗脱RNA

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells**: Aspirate media. Wash 1× with ice-cold PBS. For adherent cells (≤ 5×10⁶): add 350 µL Buffer RLT + 1% β-mercaptoethanol directly to well. For suspension cells: pellet 300×g, 5 min, then lyse. ⚠️ Work quickly — RNA degrades rapidly
detailedSteps.zh: **收获细胞**: 吸去培养基。冰冷 PBS 洗 1 次。贴壁细胞（≤ 5×10⁶）：直接加 350 µL Buffer RLT + 1% β-巯基乙醇。悬浮细胞：300×g 离心 5 min 后裂解。⚠️ 快速操作——RNA 降解极快

detailedSteps.en: **Homogenize**: Pass lysate through QIAshredder column (spin 16,000×g, 2 min) or vortex vigorously 1 min. For tissue: use rotor-stator homogenizer
detailedSteps.zh: **匀浆**: 裂解液过 QIAshredder 柱（16,000×g 离心 2 min）或剧烈涡旋 1 min。组织：用转子-定子匀浆器

detailedSteps.en: **Add ethanol**: Add 1 volume (350 µL) 70% ethanol to homogenized lysate. Mix by pipetting (do not spin)
detailedSteps.zh: **加乙醇**: 加 1 倍体积（350 µL）70% 乙醇至匀浆裂解液。吹打混匀（勿离心）
