nameCn: 差速离心法分离线粒体

components.name: 1. Collect tissue (0.5–2 g liver/heart) or cells (≥5×10⁷); keep ice-cold

note.en: All steps at 4°C. Pre-chill all tools, buffers, centrifuge rotors.
note.zh: 全程 4°C 操作。预冷所有工具、缓冲液、离心转头。

note.en: Transfer to Dounce homogenizer, 5–10 mL buffer/g tissue.
note.zh: 转入 Dounce 匀浆器，每克组织加 5–10 mL 缓冲液。

note.en: Gentle, even pressure. Over-homogenization destroys mitochondria. Cells: N₂ cavitation (1,000 psi, 10 min, 4°C) or 25G syringe needle × 10 strokes.
note.zh: 轻柔均匀推拉。过度匀浆破坏线粒体。细胞：氮气空化（1,000 psi，10 min，4°C）或 25G 针头 × 10 次。

note.en: Keep supernatant (PNS). Discard pellet (nuclei, unbroken cells). Repeat if pellet is large.
note.zh: 保留上清（PNS）。弃沉淀（核、未破碎细胞）。沉淀大时重复一次。

note.en: Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction. Pellet = crude mitochondria.
note.zh: 上清 = 细胞质组分。沉淀 = 粗线粒体。

components.name: 6. Wash: resuspend pellet in 5 mL buffer; repeat 7,000×g spin (×2–3)

note.en: Pellet becomes tighter and less brownish with each wash.
note.zh: 每次洗涤后沉淀更紧实、颜色更浅（去除肌红蛋白和细胞色素 c）。

components.name: 7. Optional: Percoll gradient for pure mitochondria

note.en: 18%/30% Percoll gradient in buffer. 95,000×g 30 min 4°C (SW-41 Ti). Mitochondria at 18/30% interface. Wash 2× at 6,000×g 10 min.
note.zh: 18%/30% Percoll 梯度（缓冲液配制）。95,000×g 30 min 4°C（SW-41 Ti 转头）。线粒体在 18/30% 界面。6,000×g 洗 2 次。

components.name: 8. Resuspend in assay buffer (without BSA for functional assays); quantify by BCA

note.en: 1–10 mg/mL protein. Integrity: cytochrome c oxidase activity ± detergent.
note.zh: 蛋白浓度 1–10 mg/mL。完整性验证：细胞色素 c 氧化酶活性（± 去污剂）。

components.name: 9. Functional integrity check: OCR (Seahorse/Clark electrode) or JC-1/TMRM

note.en: Healthy mito: JC-1 red aggregates; depolarized: green monomers. Use within 4–6 h of isolation.
note.zh: 健康线粒体：JC-1 红色聚集体；去极化：绿色单体。分离后 4–6 h 内使用。

notes.en: Differential centrifugation gives ~70% pure mitochondria. For functional studies, Percoll gradient recommended. Keep at 4°C; use within 4–6 h. WB markers: VDAC/TOMM20 (outer membrane), HSP60 (matrix), cytochrome c (IMS).
notes.zh: 差速离心纯度约 70%。功能性实验推荐 Percoll 梯度纯化。4°C 保存，4–6 h 内使用。WB 标记：VDAC/TOMM20（外膜）、HSP60（基质）、细胞色素 c（膜间隙）。

ref: Frezza et al. (2007) Nat Protoc 2:287–295; Wieckowski et al. (2009) Nat Protoc 4:1582–1590

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Homogenize in isotonic buffer → Low-speed spin (remove nuclei/debris) → High-speed spin (pellet mitochondria) → Wash → Resuspend → QC by Western blot
briefSteps.zh: 收获细胞 → 等渗缓冲液匀浆 → 低速离心（去除细胞核/碎片）→ 高速离心（沉淀线粒体）→ 洗涤 → 重悬 → Western blot质控

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells**: Collect 2–5 × 10⁷ cells by scraping (adherent) or centrifugation (suspension) at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C. Wash once with ice-cold PBS.
detailedSteps.zh: **收获细胞**: 刮取（贴壁）或300 × g离心5分钟（悬浮）收集2-5 × 10⁷个细胞，4°C。用冰冷PBS洗涤一次。

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend in isolation buffer**: Resuspend pellet in 2 mL Mitochondria Isolation Buffer (MIB: 220 mM mannitol, 70 mM sucrose, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 1 mM EGTA, 0.2% BSA, 1× protease inhibitors). Keep on ice. ⚠️ BSA in buffer scavenges free fatty acids that damage mitochondria.
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬于分离缓冲液**: 将沉淀重悬于2 mL线粒体分离缓冲液（MIB：220 mM甘露醇、70 mM蔗糖、10 mM HEPES pH 7.4、1 mM EGTA、0.2% BSA、1×蛋白酶抑制剂）中。保持冰上。⚠️ 缓冲液中的BSA可清除损害线粒体的游离脂肪酸。

detailedSteps.en: **Homogenize**: Pass cells through a Dounce homogenizer (tight pestle) 30–40 strokes on ice. Alternatively, use a 25G needle (10 passes) or nitrogen cavitation (100 psi, 20 min). Check lysis under microscope — aim for >80% broken cells with intact nuclei.
detailedSteps.zh: **匀浆**: 在冰上使用Dounce匀浆器（紧密研杵）研磨30-40次。或者用25G针头（10次通过）或氮气空化（100 psi，20分钟）。显微镜下检查裂解——目标>80%细胞破碎但细胞核完整。

detailedSteps.en: **Low-speed spin 1**: Centrifuge homogenate at 800 × g for 10 min at 4°C to pellet nuclei, unbroken cells, and large debris. Transfer supernatant (S1) to a clean tube. Save pellet (P1).
detailedSteps.zh: **低速离心1**: 4°C、800 × g离心匀浆液10分钟，沉淀细胞核、未破碎细胞和大碎片。将上清（S1）转移至干净管中。保留沉淀（P1）。

detailedSteps.en: **Low-speed spin 2 (optional)**: Re-centrifuge S1 at 800 × g for 5 min to remove residual nuclear contamination.
detailedSteps.zh: **低速离心2（可选）**: 将S1再次800 × g离心5分钟，去除残余核污染。

detailedSteps.en: **High-speed spin**: Centrifuge S1 at 10,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C. The pellet (P2) is the crude mitochondrial fraction. Save supernatant (S2 = cytosolic fraction).
detailedSteps.zh: **高速离心**: 4°C、10,000 × g离心S1 15分钟。沉淀（P2）为粗线粒体组分。保留上清（S2 = 胞浆组分）。

detailedSteps.en: **Wash mitochondria**: Gently resuspend P2 in 1 mL MIB (without BSA). Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C. Repeat once.
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤线粒体**: 轻柔地将P2重悬于1 mL MIB（不含BSA）中。4°C、10,000 × g离心10分钟。重复一次。

detailedSteps.en: **Resuspend**: Resuspend final mitochondrial pellet in 100–200 µL MIB (without BSA). Keep on ice for immediate use.
detailedSteps.zh: **重悬**: 将最终线粒体沉淀重悬于100-200 µL MIB（不含BSA）中。冰上保存以立即使用。

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify**: Measure protein concentration by Bradford assay. Typical yield: 0.5–2 mg protein from 5 × 10⁷ cells.
detailedSteps.zh: **定量**: 用Bradford法测定蛋白浓度。典型产量：5 × 10⁷个细胞约0.5-2 mg蛋白。

detailedSteps.en: **QC by Western blot**: Probe fractions (P1, P2, S2) for mitochondrial markers (VDAC/porin, COX IV, Tom20) and purity markers: nuclear (Lamin B1, histone H3), cytosolic (GAPDH, tubulin), ER (calnexin). Enrichment in mito markers with depletion of others confirms purity.
detailedSteps.zh: **Western blot质控**: 对各组分（P1、P2、S2）检测线粒体标记物（VDAC/porin、COX IV、Tom20）和纯度标记物：核（Lamin B1、组蛋白H3）、胞浆（GAPDH、微管蛋白）、内质网（钙联蛋白）。线粒体标记物富集且其他标记物缺失确认纯度。

note.en: 2 mL or 7 mL, tight-fitting pestle (B pestle)
note.zh: 2 mL或7 mL，紧密研杵（B型研杵）

note.en: Crude mitochondria can be snap-frozen in liquid N₂ and stored at -80°C, but membrane potential is lost — only suitable for protein/lipid analysis, not functional assays
note.zh: 粗线粒体可液氮速冻-80°C保存，但膜电位会丧失——仅适用于蛋白/脂质分析，不适用于功能性检测

name: Protein Dialysis and Buffer Exchange

components.name: 1. Prepare dialysis tubing or membrane device

note.en: Tubing: boil in 2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA 10 min, rinse thoroughly. Slide-A-Lyzer: soak in buffer 2 min. MWCO: 3.5 kDa (<20 kDa protein), 12–14 kDa (most proteins), 50 kDa (large complexes).
note.zh: 透析袋：2% NaHCO₃ + 1 mM EDTA 煮 10 min，彻底冲洗。Slide-A-Lyzer：缓冲液浸泡 2 min。MWCO：3.5 kDa（<20 kDa 蛋白）、12–14 kDa（大多数蛋白）、50 kDa（大型复合体）。

note.en: Sample expands ~10–20% by osmosis. Seal securely.
note.zh: 渗透作用导致样品膨胀 ~10–20%。密封牢固。

components.name: 3. Dialyze change 1: 500 mL buffer, 2 h, 4°C, gentle stirring

note.en: ≥200× volume ratio. Slow stir bar (no foam = no protein denaturation).
note.zh: ≥200 倍体积比。慢速搅拌（无泡沫 = 无蛋白变性）。

components.name: 4. Dialyze change 2: fresh 500 mL buffer, 2 h, 4°C

note.en: Each change removes >90% of target small molecule.
note.zh: 每次换液去除 >90% 的目标小分子。

note.en: Add 10% glycerol to final buffer if storing at −80°C.
note.zh: 若需 −80°C 保存，末次透析液加 10% 甘油。

note.en: Volume may increase. Quantify: Bradford or BCA. Concentrate if needed: Amicon Ultra (4,000×g, 4°C).
note.zh: 体积可能增加。Bradford 或 BCA 定量。如需浓缩：Amicon Ultra（4,000×g，4°C）。

notes.en: Faster alternatives: (a) HiTrap Desalting column (5 mL, 5 min on AKTA); (b) Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter + dilution (3 cycles removes >99.9%); (c) ZebaSpin Desalting Column (2 min spin). Amicon: do not let protein dry on membrane.
notes.zh: 更快替代方案：(a) HiTrap Desalting 脱盐柱（5 mL，AKTA 5 min）；(b) Amicon Ultra 离心浓缩管 + 稀释换液（3 次去除 >99.9%）；(c) ZebaSpin 脱盐柱（2 min）。Amicon 注意勿让蛋白干在膜上。

ref: Scopes (1994) Protein Purification 3rd ed.; Wingfield (2001) Curr Protoc Protein Sci A.3B.1; ThermoFisher Slide-A-Lyzer Manual

briefSteps.en: Prepare dialysis membrane → Load sample → Dialyze against buffer (3 changes) → Recover sample → Measure concentration → Store
briefSteps.zh: 准备透析膜 → 加载样品 → 对缓冲液透析（换液3次）→ 回收样品 → 测定浓度 → 保存

detailedSteps.en: **Choose membrane MWCO**: Select a molecular weight cutoff ≤ ½ the molecular weight of your protein. Common choices: 3.5 kDa for small proteins, 10 kDa for most proteins, 20 kDa for large proteins.
detailedSteps.zh: **选择膜截留分子量**: 选择≤蛋白分子量½的截留分子量。常用选择：小蛋白3.5 kDa，大多数蛋白10 kDa，大蛋白20 kDa。

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare dialysis membrane**: Cut tubing to appropriate length (allow ~2× sample volume). Boil in 2% sodium bicarbonate + 1 mM EDTA for 10 min. Rinse thoroughly with distilled water. Store in 20% ethanol at 4°C until use. For Slide-A-Lyzer cassettes, hydrate in buffer for 2 min.
detailedSteps.zh: **准备透析膜**: 剪取适当长度的透析管（留~2×样品体积）。在2%碳酸氢钠 + 1 mM EDTA中煮沸10分钟。用蒸馏水充分冲洗。使用前在20%乙醇中4°C保存。Slide-A-Lyzer盒式透析，在缓冲液中水化2分钟。

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare dialysis buffer**: Use ≥500× sample volume of target buffer (e.g., 500 mL buffer for 1 mL sample). Common: PBS pH 7.4, or 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 + 150 mM NaCl. Pre-chill to 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: **准备透析缓冲液**: 使用≥500×样品体积的目标缓冲液（如1 mL样品用500 mL缓冲液）。常用：PBS pH 7.4，或20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 + 150 mM NaCl。预冷至4°C。

detailedSteps.en: **Load sample**: Clamp one end of tubing, load sample using a pipette, remove air bubbles, clamp the other end. Leave room for volume increase due to osmosis. For cassettes, inject sample through port with syringe.
detailedSteps.zh: **加载样品**: 夹住管的一端，用移液器加入样品，去除气泡，夹住另一端。留出空间以应对渗透引起的体积增大。盒式透析用注射器通过端口注入样品。

detailedSteps.en: **Dialyze — Round 1**: Place loaded membrane into first beaker of pre-chilled dialysis buffer. Stir gently with magnetic stirrer at 4°C for 2–4 h.
detailedSteps.zh: **透析——第一轮**: 将装载好的膜放入第一杯预冷透析缓冲液中。4°C磁力搅拌器轻柔搅拌2-4小时。

detailedSteps.en: **Buffer change 1**: Transfer membrane to fresh pre-chilled buffer (same volume). Dialyze 2–4 h at 4°C with stirring.
detailedSteps.zh: **第一次换液**: 将膜转移至新鲜预冷缓冲液（同体积）。4°C搅拌透析2-4小时。

detailedSteps.en: **Buffer change 2**: Transfer to final fresh buffer. Dialyze overnight at 4°C with stirring. ⚠️ Three buffer changes achieve >99.99% exchange for small molecules.
detailedSteps.zh: **第二次换液**: 转移至最后一份新鲜缓冲液。4°C搅拌过夜透析。⚠️ 三次换液可实现小分子>99.99%的交换。

detailedSteps.en: **Recover sample**: Remove membrane from buffer. Open clamp carefully over a clean tube and collect sample. Rinse inside of tubing with small volume of buffer if needed. ⚠️ Sample volume may have increased 10–20% due to osmosis.
detailedSteps.zh: **回收样品**: 从缓冲液中取出膜。在干净管上小心打开夹子收集样品。必要时用少量缓冲液冲洗管内壁。⚠️ 由于渗透作用，样品体积可能增加10-20%。

detailedSteps.en: **Measure concentration**: Determine protein concentration by Bradford assay or A280. Calculate recovery (typically 80–95%). If concentration is too low, use centrifugal concentrator.
detailedSteps.zh: **测定浓度**: 用Bradford法或A280测定蛋白浓度。计算回收率（通常80-95%）。若浓度过低，使用离心浓缩管。

detailedSteps.en: **Store**: Aliquot, add glycerol to 10% if desired for -80°C storage. Snap-freeze in liquid N₂.
detailedSteps.zh: **保存**: 分装，如需-80°C保存可加入甘油至10%。液氮速冻。

note.en: Choose MWCO ≤ ½ protein MW. SnakeSkin or Slide-A-Lyzer (Thermo)
Overnight dialysis is standard; sample is stable in buffer at 4°C
note.zh: 过夜透析是标准步骤；样品在4°C缓冲液中稳定

note.en: Aliquoted protein at -80°C for long-term storage

name: RNA-seq Library Preparation (PolyA Selection)

note.en: trizol_extraction or rna_column_extraction. Bioanalyzer RIN ≥7.0 (≥8 preferred). Nanodrop: A260/280 ≥2.0, A260/230 ≥1.8. Qubit RNA HS for accurate quantification.
note.zh: trizol_extraction 或 rna_column_extraction。Bioanalyzer RIN ≥7.0（≥8 优选）。Nanodrop：A260/280 ≥2.0、A260/230 ≥1.8。Qubit RNA HS 精确定量。

components.name: 2. Input: 100 ng–1 µg total RNA (optimal 500 ng)

note.en: Degraded RNA: use RiboZero rRNA depletion instead of polyA. Single-cell: 10× Chromium or Smart-seq2.
note.zh: 降解 RNA：用 RiboZero rRNA 去除替代 polyA。单细胞：10× Chromium 或 Smart-seq2。

components.name: 3. PolyA selection: oligo-dT magnetic beads, 65°C 5 min → RT 5 min → wash × 2 → elute 80°C 2 min; repeat once

note.en: 2× binding buffer: 10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 500 mM LiCl, 1 mM EDTA. Double selection reduces rRNA contamination to <5%.
note.zh: 2× 结合缓冲液：10 mM Tris pH 7.5、500 mM LiCl、1 mM EDTA。双次选择将 rRNA 污染降至 <5%。

components.name: 4. Fragmentation: 94°C, 2–8 min in First Strand Buffer

note.en: Target 150–300 bp inserts for Illumina short-read. Stop with 0.5 M EDTA. 2 min → ~300 bp; 8 min → ~130 bp.
note.zh: 目标片段 150–300 bp（Illumina 短读）。0.5 M EDTA 终止。2 min → ~300 bp；8 min → ~130 bp。

components.name: 5. First-strand cDNA: random hexamers + RT (SuperScript III/IV)

note.en: 65°C 5 min (denature) → ice 1 min → add RT mix (1× FS Buffer, 5 mM DTT, RNaseOUT, RT enzyme) → 25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min → RNase H 37°C 20 min.
note.zh: 65°C 5 min（变性）→ 冰 1 min → 加 RT 混合物（1× FS 缓冲液、5 mM DTT、RNaseOUT、逆转录酶）→ 25°C 10 min → 50°C 50 min → 70°C 15 min → RNase H 37°C 20 min。

components.name: 6. Second-strand cDNA: DNA Pol I + E. coli ligase + RNase H, 16°C 2.5 h

note.en: For strand-specific: replace dTTP with dUTP. Purify with 1.8× AMPure XP (SPRI) beads.
note.zh: 链特异性建库：将 dTTP 替换为 dUTP。1.8× AMPure XP（SPRI）磁珠纯化。

note.en: End repair: T4 DNA Pol + T4 PNK + Klenow, 30°C 30 min. dA-tailing: Klenow (exo-), 37°C 30 min. Purify 1× AMPure XP.
note.zh: 末端修复：T4 DNA Pol + T4 PNK + Klenow，30°C 30 min。加 A 尾：Klenow（exo-），37°C 30 min。1× AMPure XP 纯化。

components.name: 8. Adapter ligation: dual-index Y-adapters, T4 ligase, RT 15 min

note.en: Adapter:insert 10:1 molar. Heat inactivate 65°C 10 min. Size select: 0.8× then 0.2× AMPure XP (removes adapter-dimers at ~130 bp).
note.zh: 接头:插入片段 10:1 摩尔比。65°C 10 min 灭活。双面选择：0.8× + 0.2× AMPure XP（去除 ~130 bp 接头二聚体）。

note.en: 8 cycles for 500 ng input; 12–14 for <100 ng. KAPA HiFi or Q5 polymerase. 1× AMPure XP cleanup.
note.zh: 500 ng 投入量 8 个循环；<100 ng 用 12–14 个循环。KAPA HiFi 或 Q5 聚合酶。1× AMPure XP 纯化。

note.en: Expect ~280–350 bp (insert + adapters). No adapter-dimer (<1% at 130 bp). Qubit dsDNA HS + NEBNext Library Quant qPCR. Sequence: 20–50 M 150 bp PE reads/sample.
note.zh: 预期 ~280–350 bp（插入片段 + 接头）。无接头二聚体（130 bp 处 <1%）。Qubit dsDNA HS + NEBNext Library Quant qPCR 定量。测序：每样品 2,000–5,000 万条 150 bp PE reads。

notes.en: Strand-specific: replace dTTP with dUTP, then UNG digest before PCR → preserves strand info. Low input (<10 ng): Smart-seq2 or NEBNext Single Cell. rRNA depletion (RiboZero) for degraded RNA or non-polyA transcripts (lncRNA, histone mRNA).
notes.zh: 链特异性：第二链合成 dTTP→dUTP，PCR 前 UNG 酶切 → 保留链信息。低投入（<10 ng）：Smart-seq2 或 NEBNext Single Cell。降解 RNA 或非 polyA 转录本：RiboZero rRNA 去除。

ref: Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Reference Guide 15031047; Adiconis et al. (2013) Nat Methods 10:623–629

briefSteps.en: QC RNA → mRNA enrichment (polyA) or rRNA depletion → Fragment → Reverse transcribe → 2nd strand synthesis → End repair → A-tail → Adapter ligation → PCR amplification → Library QC
briefSteps.zh: RNA质控 → mRNA富集（polyA）或rRNA去除 → 片段化 → 反转录 → 第二链合成 → 末端修复 → 加A尾 → 接头连接 → PCR扩增 → 文库质控

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — RNA QC and library construction**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — RNA质控和文库构建**

detailedSteps.en: **RNA QC**: Assess RNA quality on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation — require RIN ≥ 7 for polyA selection. Quantify by Qubit RNA HS. Start with 100 ng – 1 µg total RNA. ⚠️ Use RNase-free tips, tubes, and water throughout.
detailedSteps.zh: **RNA质控**: 在Bioanalyzer/TapeStation上评估RNA质量——polyA选择要求RIN ≥ 7。用Qubit RNA HS定量。起始100 ng - 1 µg总RNA。⚠️ 全程使用无RNase的枪头、管和水。

detailedSteps.en: **mRNA enrichment**: Add oligo-dT magnetic beads to total RNA. Heat to 65°C for 5 min to denature, cool to RT to allow polyA binding. Place on magnet, wash 2× with wash buffer. Elute mRNA with 15 µL elution buffer at 80°C for 2 min.
detailedSteps.zh: **mRNA富集**: 向总RNA中加入oligo-dT磁珠。65°C加热5分钟变性，冷却至室温使polyA结合。放置磁力架，用洗涤缓冲液洗涤2次。80°C 2分钟用15 µL洗脱缓冲液洗脱mRNA。

detailedSteps.en: **Fragmentation**: Add fragmentation buffer (divalent cations in Tris buffer). Incubate at 94°C for exactly 8 min (for ~200 bp inserts) or adjust time for desired size. ⚠️ Timing is critical — too long = very short fragments, too short = poor cluster density.
detailedSteps.zh: **片段化**: 加入片段化缓冲液（Tris缓冲液中的二价阳离子）。94°C精确孵育8分钟（用于~200 bp插入片段），或调整时间以获得所需大小。⚠️ 时间至关重要——太长=片段过短，太短=簇密度低。

detailedSteps.en: **First strand cDNA synthesis**: Add random hexamer primers, dNTPs, first strand buffer, RNase inhibitor, and reverse transcriptase (SuperScript III/IV). Incubate: 25°C for 10 min (primer annealing), 42°C for 50 min (extension), 70°C for 15 min (inactivation).
detailedSteps.zh: **第一链cDNA合成**: 加入随机六聚体引物、dNTPs、第一链缓冲液、RNase抑制剂和反转录酶（SuperScript III/IV）。孵育：25°C 10分钟（引物退火）、42°C 50分钟（延伸）、70°C 15分钟（失活）。

detailedSteps.en: **Second strand synthesis**: Add second strand buffer (with dUTP for strand-specific protocols), DNA Pol I, and RNase H. Incubate at 16°C for 1 h. The dUTP incorporation marks the second strand for later removal.
detailedSteps.zh: **第二链合成**: 加入第二链缓冲液（链特异性方案含dUTP）、DNA Pol I和RNase H。16°C孵育1小时。dUTP掺入标记第二链以便后续去除。

detailedSteps.en: **Purify double-stranded cDNA**: Clean up with 1.8× AMPure XP beads. Elute in 50 µL nuclease-free water.
detailedSteps.zh: **纯化双链cDNA**: 用1.8× AMPure XP磁珠纯化。50 µL无核酸酶水洗脱。

detailedSteps.en: **End repair**: Add End Repair Mix (T4 DNA polymerase, Klenow, T4 PNK). Incubate 30 min at 20°C. Purify with 1.8× AMPure XP beads.
detailedSteps.zh: **末端修复**: 加入末端修复混合液（T4 DNA聚合酶、Klenow、T4 PNK）。20°C孵育30分钟。用1.8× AMPure XP磁珠纯化。

detailedSteps.en: **A-tailing**: Add dATP and Klenow fragment (exo-). Incubate 30 min at 37°C. This adds a single 3' A overhang for adapter ligation.
detailedSteps.zh: **加A尾**: 加入dATP和Klenow片段（exo-）。37°C孵育30分钟。在3'端添加单个A突出以便接头连接。

detailedSteps.en: **Adapter ligation**: Add diluted indexed adapters (use 1:10 dilution for <100 ng input) and T4 DNA Ligase. Incubate 15 min at 20°C. ⚠️ For multiplexing, use unique dual index (UDI) adapters to prevent index hopping.
detailedSteps.zh: **接头连接**: 加入稀释的索引接头（<100 ng起始量用1:10稀释）和T4 DNA连接酶。20°C孵育15分钟。⚠️ 多重测序时使用唯一双索引（UDI）接头防止索引跳转。

detailedSteps.en: **Size selection**: Perform double-sided size selection with AMPure XP: first 0.6× to remove large fragments (discard beads), then 0.2× additional (0.8× total) to capture 200–500 bp fragments. Elute in 20 µL.
detailedSteps.zh: **大小选择**: 用AMPure XP进行双侧大小选择：首先0.6×去除大片段（丢弃磁珠），然后额外0.2×（总共0.8×）捕获200-500 bp片段。20 µL洗脱。

detailedSteps.en: **PCR amplification**: Add PCR master mix and universal/index primers. Cycle: 98°C 30 s; then 10–15 cycles of 98°C 10 s, 60°C 30 s, 72°C 30 s; final extension 72°C 5 min. ⚠️ Minimize cycles to reduce PCR duplicates — use 10 cycles for ≥100 ng input, up to 15 for low input.
detailedSteps.zh: **PCR扩增**: 加入PCR预混液和通用/索引引物。循环：98°C 30秒；然后10-15个循环的98°C 10秒、60°C 30秒、72°C 30秒；最终延伸72°C 5分钟。⚠️ 尽量减少循环数以降低PCR重复——≥100 ng起始量用10个循环，低起始量最多15个。

detailedSteps.en: **Final cleanup**: Purify with 0.8× AMPure XP beads. Elute in 20 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
detailedSteps.zh: **最终纯化**: 用0.8× AMPure XP磁珠纯化。用20 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0洗脱。

detailedSteps.en: **Library QC**: Run 1 µL on Bioanalyzer/TapeStation (expect peak at 300–400 bp including adapters). Quantify by Qubit dsDNA HS and qPCR (KAPA Library Quant). Libraries should be 2–20 nM for sequencing.
detailedSteps.zh: **文库质控**: 取1 µL在Bioanalyzer/TapeStation上分析（期望峰值在300-400 bp含接头）。用Qubit dsDNA HS和qPCR（KAPA Library Quant）定量。文库浓度应为2-20 nM用于测序。

note.en: NEB M0202 or included in kit
For RNA QC and library size
note.zh: 用于RNA质控和文库大小评估

note.en: Purified ds-cDNA can be stored at -20°C overnight
note.zh: 纯化的双链cDNA可-20°C过夜保存

note.en: Final libraries can be stored at -20°C for weeks before sequencing
note.zh: 最终文库可-20°C保存数周后再测序

name: Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC / Gel Filtration)
nameCn: 分子排阻色谱（SEC / 凝胶过滤）蛋白纯化

components.name: 1. Prepare sample: ≥1 mg/mL, centrifuge 20,000×g 20 min 4°C, filter 0.22 µm

note.en: Remove aggregates before injection. Analytical: ≤500 µL; preparative: ≤5 mL (16/60 column).
note.zh: 进样前去除聚集体。分析型：≤500 µL；制备型：≤5 mL（16/60 柱）。

components.name: 2. Select SEC column by MW range

note.en: Superdex 75 (3–70 kDa), Superdex 200 (10–600 kDa), Superose 6 (5–5,000 kDa). Analytical: 10/300 GL (24 mL). Preparative: 16/60 (120 mL) or 26/60 (320 mL).
note.zh: Superdex 75（3–70 kDa）、Superdex 200（10–600 kDa）、Superose 6（5–5,000 kDa）。分析型：10/300 GL（24 mL）。制备型：16/60（120 mL）。

note.en: Flow rate: 0.4–0.5 mL/min (10/300 GL); 1.0–1.5 mL/min (16/60). Pressure limit: 1.5–1.8 MPa. Monitor A280 baseline stability.

components.name: 4. Inject sample via clean sample loop

note.en: Rinse loop with water then running buffer before injection. Inject at 0.5 mL/min.
note.zh: 上样环先用水再用运行缓冲液冲洗。0.5 mL/min 注入。

components.name: 5. Run: 1.2 CV at constant flow; collect 0.5 mL (analytical) or 1–2 mL (preparative) fractions

note.en: Monitor A280 (protein), A260 (nucleic acids). V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV; Vt ≈ CV.
note.zh: 监测 A280（蛋白）、A260（核酸）。V₀ ≈ 0.35 CV；Vt ≈ CV。

components.name: 6. Pool symmetric peak fractions; verify by SDS-PAGE

note.en: Asymmetric tailing = aggregation or multiple species. Only pool the main symmetric peak.
note.zh: 不对称拖尾 = 聚集体或多组分。仅合并对称峰组分。

components.name: 7. Optional: run MW calibration standards (first time per column)

note.en: GE LMW/HMW kit. Plot log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀). Couple with SEC-MALS for absolute MW.
note.zh: GE LMW/HMW 校准套装。绘 log(MW) vs Kav = (Ve−V₀)/(Vt−V₀)。联用 SEC-MALS 可测绝对分子量。

components.name: 8. Clean column: 1 CV 2 M NaCl, re-equilibrate; store in 20% EtOH at 4°C

note.en: Never run column dry. Monthly: 0.5 CV 0.5 M NaOH for biofilm removal (check column compatibility).
note.zh: 切勿让柱子跑干。每月：0.5 CV 0.5 M NaOH 清除生物膜（需确认柱子兼容性）。

notes.en: SEC is gold-standard polishing step. Separates by hydrodynamic radius. Excellent for: removing aggregates, determining oligomeric state, buffer exchange. Keep sample:column volume ≤1–2% for best resolution. Run at 4°C for labile proteins.
notes.zh: SEC 是蛋白精修的金标准。按流体力学半径分离。适合去除聚集体、确定寡聚状态、换液。样品:柱体积 ≤1–2% 以获最佳分辨率。不稳定蛋白在 4°C 进行。

ref: Wyatt et al. (2017) Nat Protoc 12:1683–1701; GE Healthcare SEC Application Note 18-1114-02

briefSteps.en: Choose column (by MW range) → Equilibrate → Concentrate sample → Load ≤2% CV → Isocratic elution → Collect fractions → SDS-PAGE/Western → Pool and concentrate
briefSteps.zh: 选择柱（按分子量范围）→ 平衡 → 浓缩样品 → 上样≤2% CV → 等度洗脱 → 收集组分 → SDS-PAGE/Western → 合并浓缩

detailedSteps.en: **Choose column**: Select resin based on target MW range. Superdex 75: 3–70 kDa. Superdex 200: 10–600 kDa. Superose 6: 5–5,000 kDa. Use prepacked columns (10/300 GL = 24 mL, or 16/600 = 120 mL).
detailedSteps.zh: **选择柱**: 根据目标分子量范围选择树脂。Superdex 75：3-70 kDa。Superdex 200：10-600 kDa。Superose 6：5-5,000 kDa。使用预装柱（10/300 GL = 24 mL，或16/600 = 120 mL）。

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare running buffer**: Use the same buffer for column equilibration and elution (isocratic). Typical: 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl (or PBS). Filter (0.22 µm) and degas thoroughly. ⚠️ Include 150 mM NaCl minimum to prevent non-specific interactions.
detailedSteps.zh: **准备流动缓冲液**: 柱平衡和洗脱使用同一缓冲液（等度）。典型：20 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5、150 mM NaCl（或PBS）。0.22 µm过滤并充分脱气。⚠️ 至少含150 mM NaCl以防止非特异性相互作用。

detailedSteps.en: **Equilibrate column**: Wash with 2 CV of running buffer at recommended flow rate (0.5 mL/min for 10/300, 1.0 mL/min for 16/600). Monitor A280, conductivity, and pressure.
detailedSteps.zh: **平衡柱**: 以推荐流速（10/300用0.5 mL/min，16/600用1.0 mL/min）用2 CV流动缓冲液洗涤。监测A280、电导率和压力。

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare sample**: Concentrate protein to ≤ 10 mg/mL in running buffer using centrifugal concentrator. Sample volume must be ≤ 2% of column volume (≤ 500 µL for 10/300, ≤ 2.5 mL for 16/600). Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C to remove aggregates. ⚠️ Sample volume is the most critical parameter for resolution.
detailedSteps.zh: **制备样品**: 用离心浓缩管将蛋白浓缩至≤10 mg/mL的流动缓冲液中。样品体积必须≤柱体积的2%（10/300≤500 µL，16/600≤2.5 mL）。4°C 16,000 × g离心10分钟去除聚集体。⚠️ 样品体积是影响分辨率的最关键参数。

detailedSteps.en: **Load sample**: Inject sample via injection loop or directly onto column. Start run immediately.
detailedSteps.zh: **上样**: 通过进样环或直接注入样品至柱上。立即开始运行。

detailedSteps.en: **Elution**: Run 1.5 CV of buffer at constant flow rate. Collect fractions (0.5 mL for 10/300, 2 mL for 16/600). Large proteins elute first (void volume ~8 mL for 10/300).
detailedSteps.zh: **洗脱**: 以恒定流速运行1.5 CV缓冲液。收集组分（10/300用0.5 mL，16/600用2 mL）。大蛋白先洗脱（10/300空隙体积~8 mL）。

detailedSteps.en: **Analyze fractions**: Check A280 chromatogram for peaks. Run peak fractions on SDS-PAGE. Symmetric peak = monodisperse. Shoulder or asymmetry may indicate aggregates or contaminants.
detailedSteps.zh: **分析组分**: 检查A280色谱图的峰。将峰值组分进行SDS-PAGE。对称峰 = 单分散。肩峰或不对称可能表示聚集体或杂质。

detailedSteps.en: **Pool and concentrate**: Combine fractions containing pure target protein. Concentrate with centrifugal concentrators if needed. Measure final concentration.
detailedSteps.zh: **合并浓缩**: 合并含有纯目标蛋白的组分。必要时用离心浓缩管浓缩。测定最终浓度。

detailedSteps.en: **Calibrate (optional)**: Run MW standards (e.g., Bio-Rad gel filtration standard) to generate a log(MW) vs. elution volume plot. Estimate the apparent MW of your protein.
detailedSteps.zh: **校准（可选）**: 运行分子量标准品（如Bio-Rad凝胶过滤标准品）绘制log(MW) vs. 洗脱体积图。估算蛋白的表观分子量。

detailedSteps.en: **Column storage**: Wash with 2 CV running buffer, then 2 CV 20% ethanol for storage. Store at 4°C. ⚠️ Never let the column run dry.
detailedSteps.zh: **柱保存**: 用2 CV流动缓冲液洗涤，然后2 CV 20%乙醇保存。4°C储存。⚠️ 绝不能让柱干燥。

note.en: 20 mM Tris pH 7.5 + 150 mM NaCl or PBS, filtered and degassed
note.zh: 20 mM Tris pH 7.5 + 150 mM NaCl或PBS，过滤脱气

note.en: With UV, conductivity detectors and fraction collector
note.zh: 配备UV、电导率检测器和馏分收集器

note.en: Amicon Ultra, MWCO ≤ ½ target MW
Concentrated sample in running buffer can be stored at 4°C overnight (or -80°C with glycerol for longer)
note.zh: 流动缓冲液中浓缩的样品可4°C过夜保存（或加甘油-80°C更长期保存）

note.en: Pooled fractions can be stored at 4°C overnight before further use
note.zh: 合并的组分可4°C过夜保存后再使用

name: siRNA-Mediated Gene Knockdown
nameCn: siRNA 基因沉默（RNAi 干扰）

components.name: 1. Design siRNA: order 2–3 independent siRNAs per target gene

note.en: 19–21 nt duplex with 2 nt 3' overhangs. Sources: Qiagen, Dharmacon, IDT. Resuspend 20 µM in RNase-free water; store −80°C.
note.zh: 19–21 nt 双链，3' 端 2 nt 突出。来源：Qiagen、Dharmacon、IDT。RNase-free 水溶解至 20 µM；−80°C 保存。

components.name: 2. Day 0: seed cells in antibiotic-free media

note.en: 24-well: 5–8×10⁴ cells; 6-well: 2–4×10⁵; 10 cm: 1.5–2×10⁶. Target 40–70% confluency at transfection.
Tube A: 3 µL RNAiMAX + 47 µL Opti-MEM, 5 min RT. Tube B: 1 µL siRNA (20 µM) + 49 µL Opti-MEM. Combine A+B, mix gently, 20 min RT. [24-well scale; final siRNA ~20 nM].
note.zh: 管 A：3 µL RNAiMAX + 47 µL Opti-MEM，RT 5 min。管 B：1 µL siRNA（20 µM）+ 49 µL Opti-MEM。A+B 混合，轻混，RT 20 min。[24 孔规模；siRNA 终浓度 ~20 nM]。

components.name: 4. Add complex dropwise to cells; gentle plate rocking

note.en: Remove old media; add 400 µL fresh (no antibiotics) + 100 µL complex = 500 µL total. Do NOT change media for 6 h.
note.zh: 去旧培养基；加 400 µL 新鲜培养基（无抗生素）+ 100 µL 复合物 = 500 µL。6 h 内不换液。

note.en: 48 h: fast-turnover proteins. 72 h: most targets. 96 h + re-transfection at 48 h: stable proteins.
note.zh: 48 h：快速周转蛋白。72 h：大多数靶标。96 h + 48 h 时再转染：稳定蛋白。

note.en: qpcr_protocol for mRNA (≥70% reduction expected). wb_protocol for protein (≥60% reduction). Include siNC + siGAPDH controls.
note.zh: qpcr_protocol 检测 mRNA（预期 ≥70% 下调）。wb_protocol 检测蛋白（预期 ≥60% 下调）。对照：siNC + siGAPDH。

note.en: Proliferation: cck8_proliferation; Migration: scratch_assay/transwell_migration; Apoptosis: annexin_v_apoptosis.

notes.en: Controls: (1) siNC (non-targeting); (2) siGAPDH (positive KD); (3) untreated; (4) lipid-only (toxicity). Toxicity high? Reduce RNAiMAX to 1.5 µL/well. Hard-to-transfect cells: Nucleofection, electroporation, or lentiviral shRNA.
notes.zh: 对照：(1) siNC（非靶向）；(2) siGAPDH（阳性 KD）；(3) 未处理；(4) 仅脂质体（毒性）。毒性大？减少 RNAiMAX 至 1.5 µL/孔。难转染细胞：核转染、电穿孔或慢病毒 shRNA。

ref: Elbashir et al. (2001) Nature 411:494–498; Reynolds et al. (2004) Nat Biotechnol 22:326; Qiagen siRNA Transfection Handbook

briefSteps.en: Design/order siRNA → Seed cells → Complex siRNA with lipofectamine → Transfect → Incubate 48–72 h → Harvest → Validate knockdown by RT-qPCR & Western blot
briefSteps.zh: 设计/订购siRNA → 铺板细胞 → siRNA与脂质体复合 → 转染 → 孵育48-72小时 → 收获 → RT-qPCR和Western blot验证敲低

detailedSteps.en: **Day 0 — Seed cells**
detailedSteps.zh: **第0天 — 铺板细胞**

detailedSteps.en: **Seed cells**: Plate cells in antibiotic-free complete medium to reach 60–80% confluence at the time of transfection (next day). For a 6-well plate: 2–3 × 10⁵ cells/well in 2 mL medium. For 24-well: 0.5–1 × 10⁵ cells/well in 0.5 mL. ⚠️ No antibiotics — they increase toxicity with lipofection.
detailedSteps.zh: **铺板细胞**: 将细胞铺板于不含抗生素的完全培养基中，使转染时（次日）达到60-80%融合度。6孔板：2-3 × 10⁵细胞/孔，2 mL培养基。24孔板：0.5-1 × 10⁵细胞/孔，0.5 mL。⚠️ 不加抗生素——脂质体转染时抗生素会增加毒性。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1 — Transfection**
detailedSteps.zh: **第一天 — 转染**

detailedSteps.en: **Prepare siRNA complexes**: For each well of a 6-well plate: Tube A — dilute 25 pmol siRNA (final 5 nM) in 150 µL Opti-MEM. Tube B — dilute 7.5 µL Lipofectamine RNAiMAX in 150 µL Opti-MEM. Incubate each 5 min at RT.
detailedSteps.zh: **制备siRNA复合物**: 6孔板每孔：A管——25 pmol siRNA（终浓度5 nM）稀释于150 µL Opti-MEM中。B管——7.5 µL Lipofectamine RNAiMAX稀释于150 µL Opti-MEM中。各室温孵育5分钟。

detailedSteps.en: **Form lipoplexes**: Combine Tube A + Tube B (300 µL total). Mix gently. Incubate 15–20 min at RT to form siRNA-lipid complexes.
detailedSteps.zh: **形成脂质复合物**: 合并A管 + B管（总共300 µL）。轻柔混匀。室温孵育15-20分钟形成siRNA-脂质复合物。

detailedSteps.en: **Transfect**: Add 300 µL complex dropwise to each well. Rock plate gently. Include controls: (1) Non-targeting siRNA (same concentration), (2) Untransfected cells, (3) Lipofectamine-only (mock). Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
detailedSteps.zh: **转染**: 将300 µL复合物逐滴加入每孔。轻柔晃动板。设置对照：(1)非靶向siRNA（相同浓度），(2)未转染细胞，(3)仅脂质体（模拟转染）。37°C、5% CO₂孵育。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 1–3 — Incubation and monitoring**
detailedSteps.zh: **第1-3天 — 孵育和监测**

detailedSteps.en: **Monitor**: Check cells daily for morphology and viability. Replace medium 6–24 h post-transfection if toxicity is observed. Maximum knockdown typically at 48–72 h for mRNA, 72–96 h for protein.
detailedSteps.zh: **监测**: 每天检查细胞形态和活力。如观察到毒性，转染后6-24小时更换培养基。mRNA敲低通常在48-72小时最大，蛋白在72-96小时。

detailedSteps.en: **Day 3 — Harvest and validate**
detailedSteps.zh: **第三天 — 收获和验证**

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest for RNA**: Aspirate medium. Lyse directly in well with 350 µL RLT buffer (+ 1% β-mercaptoethanol) or TRIzol. Extract RNA using RNeasy or TRIzol protocol.
detailedSteps.zh: **收获RNA**: 吸去培养基。直接在孔中用350 µL RLT缓冲液（+ 1% β-巯基乙醇）或TRIzol裂解。用RNeasy或TRIzol方案提取RNA。

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest for protein**: In parallel wells, wash with cold PBS, lyse with RIPA buffer + protease/phosphatase inhibitors. Scrape, collect, sonicate briefly, centrifuge 16,000 × g 10 min 4°C.
detailedSteps.zh: **收获蛋白**: 在平行孔中，用冷PBS洗涤，用RIPA缓冲液 + 蛋白酶/磷酸酶抑制剂裂解。刮取，收集，短暂超声，4°C 16,000 × g离心10分钟。

detailedSteps.en: **Validate by RT-qPCR**: Reverse transcribe RNA → qPCR with gene-specific primers and housekeeping gene (GAPDH, ACTB, or 18S). Calculate knockdown efficiency by ΔΔCt method. Expect ≥70% reduction.
detailedSteps.zh: **RT-qPCR验证**: 反转录RNA → 用基因特异性引物和管家基因（GAPDH、ACTB或18S）进行qPCR。用ΔΔCt法计算敲低效率。期望≥70%降低。

detailedSteps.en: **Validate by Western blot**: Run protein lysates on SDS-PAGE, transfer, blot for target protein and loading control (β-actin, GAPDH, or total protein stain). Quantify band intensity.
detailedSteps.zh: **Western blot验证**: 蛋白裂解液SDS-PAGE，转膜，检测目标蛋白和内参（β-actin、GAPDH或总蛋白染色）。定量条带强度。

note.en: 25 nmol, HPLC-purified. Design using Dharmacon, IDT, or Sigma tools
Reverse transcriptase, SYBR Green or TaqMan, primers
After seeding, cells incubate overnight at 37°C (standard protocol)
note.zh: 铺板后细胞37°C过夜培养（标准步骤）

note.en: RNA in RLT/TRIzol can be stored at -80°C; protein lysate at -80°C
note.zh: RLT/TRIzol中的RNA可-80°C保存；蛋白裂解液-80°C保存

name: Subcellular Fractionation (Cytoplasmic / Nuclear / Membrane)
nameCn: 亚细胞分级分离（细胞质 / 细胞核 / 膜组分）

components.name: 1. Wash cells 2× ice-cold PBS; collect by scraping + 500×g 5 min 4°C

note.en: ≥2×10⁷ cells per fractionation. Work on ice throughout.
note.zh: 每次分级 ≥2×10⁷ 细胞。全程冰上操作。

components.name: 2. Resuspend in nuclei_isolation_buffer (0.1% NP-40); pipette 10× gently; ice 10–15 min

note.en: 200 µL per 10⁷ cells. Do NOT vortex. Adjust NP-40 (0.05–0.2%) by cell type.
note.zh: 每 10⁷ 细胞加 200 µL。不要涡旋。按细胞类型调 NP-40（0.05–0.2%）。

note.en: Supernatant = cytoplasmic fraction (keep on ice). Verify nuclei integrity by microscopy (dark/intact in pellet).
note.zh: 上清 = 细胞质组分（冰上保存）。显微镜验证核完整性。

components.name: 4. Wash nuclear pellet: 500 µL PBS, pipette gently, 600×g 5 min 4°C (×2)
5. Extract nuclei: RIPA or high-salt buffer (400 mM NaCl), rotate 30 min 4°C; brief sonication (3× 5 s, 20%)

note.en: Nuclear extract buffer: 20 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 400 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT, 10% glycerol + protease inhibitors.
note.zh: 核提取缓冲液：20 mM HEPES pH 7.9、400 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、1 mM DTT、10% 甘油 + 蛋白酶抑制剂。

note.en: Supernatant = nuclear extract. Pellet = insoluble chromatin.
note.zh: 上清 = 核提取物。沉淀 = 不溶性染色质。

components.name: 7. Optional membrane fraction: ultracentrifuge cytoplasmic sup at 100,000×g 1 h 4°C

note.en: Supernatant = soluble cytoplasm. Pellet = total membranes (resuspend in RIPA+1% SDS). Requires ultracentrifuge (SW-41 Ti or equivalent).
note.zh: 上清 = 可溶性细胞质。沉淀 = 总膜组分（RIPA+1% SDS 重悬）。需超速离心机（SW-41 Ti 或同等）。

components.name: 8. Quantify all fractions (Bradford/BCA); verify by WB with fraction markers

note.en: Markers: Cytoplasm → GAPDH/tubulin; Nucleus → Lamin B1/H3; Membrane → Na/K-ATPase/cadherin; Mito → VDAC/HSP60.
note.zh: 标记蛋白：细胞质 → GAPDH/tubulin；细胞核 → Lamin B1/H3；膜 → Na/K-ATPase/cadherin；线粒体 → VDAC/HSP60。

note.en: Add loading buffer + boil for WB. Load equal protein (10–20 µg/lane).
note.zh: 加上样缓冲液煮沸后做 WB。每泳道等量上样（10–20 µg）。

notes.en: QC: WB with compartment markers is mandatory. Cross-contamination = incomplete lysis or wrong centrifugation speed. Hard-to-lyse cells (primary neurons, muscle) may need 0.2–0.5% NP-40. For RNA fractionation: add RNase inhibitor (RNaseOUT) to all buffers.
notes.zh: 质控：必须用标记蛋白 WB 验证。交叉污染 = 裂解不充分或离心不当。难裂解细胞可增加 NP-40 至 0.2–0.5%。RNA 分级需全程加 RNase 抑制剂。

ref: Bhatt et al. (2021) STAR Protoc 2:100450; Dignam et al. (1983) Nucleic Acids Res 11:1475; Herrmann et al. (2018) Nat Protoc 13:2548

briefSteps.en: Harvest cells → Hypotonic lysis → Collect cytoplasmic fraction → Lyse nuclei → Separate soluble nuclear vs chromatin-bound → Western blot QC with compartment markers
briefSteps.zh: 收获细胞 → 低渗裂解 → 收集胞浆组分 → 裂解细胞核 → 分离可溶核蛋白和染色质结合蛋白 → Western blot用区室标记物质控

detailedSteps.en: **Harvest cells**: Collect 5–10 × 10⁶ cells. Wash once with ice-cold PBS. Pellet at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C. Remove all supernatant.
detailedSteps.zh: **收获细胞**: 收集5-10 × 10⁶个细胞。用冰冷PBS洗涤一次。4°C 300 × g离心5分钟沉淀。完全去除上清。

detailedSteps.en: **Cytoplasmic extraction**: Resuspend pellet in 200 µL Cytoplasmic Lysis Buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 10 mM KCl, 0.1 mM EDTA, 0.1 mM EGTA, 1 mM DTT, 0.5 mM PMSF, 1× protease inhibitors). Incubate on ice 15 min to swell cells.
detailedSteps.zh: **胞浆提取**: 将沉淀重悬于200 µL胞浆裂解缓冲液（10 mM HEPES pH 7.9、10 mM KCl、0.1 mM EDTA、0.1 mM EGTA、1 mM DTT、0.5 mM PMSF、1×蛋白酶抑制剂）中。冰上孵育15分钟使细胞膨胀。

detailedSteps.en: **Lyse plasma membrane**: Add NP-40 (IGEPAL CA-630) to 0.5% final. Vortex vigorously for 10 s. ⚠️ Excessive vortexing will lyse nuclei and contaminate the cytoplasmic fraction.
detailedSteps.zh: **裂解质膜**: 加入NP-40（IGEPAL CA-630）至终浓度0.5%。剧烈涡旋10秒。⚠️ 过度涡旋会裂解细胞核并污染胞浆组分。

detailedSteps.en: **Separate cytoplasm**: Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C. Transfer supernatant to a new tube — this is the **cytoplasmic fraction**. Clarify by re-spinning at 16,000 × g for 5 min if desired.
detailedSteps.zh: **分离胞浆**: 4°C 3,000 × g离心5分钟。将上清转移至新管——这是**胞浆组分**。如需可16,000 × g再离心5分钟澄清。

detailedSteps.en: **Wash nuclear pellet**: Wash the nuclear pellet 2× with 500 µL Cytoplasmic Lysis Buffer (without NP-40) to remove cytoplasmic contamination. Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min between washes.
detailedSteps.zh: **洗涤核沉淀**: 用500 µL胞浆裂解缓冲液（不含NP-40）洗涤核沉淀2次，去除胞浆污染。洗涤间3,000 × g离心5分钟。

detailedSteps.en: **Nuclear extraction (soluble)**: Resuspend nuclear pellet in 100 µL Nuclear Extraction Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.9, 400 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM EGTA, 1 mM DTT, 1 mM PMSF, 1× protease inhibitors). Vortex 15 s. Incubate on ice 30 min with intermittent vortexing every 10 min.
detailedSteps.zh: **核提取（可溶性）**: 将核沉淀重悬于100 µL核提取缓冲液（20 mM HEPES pH 7.9、400 mM NaCl、1 mM EDTA、1 mM EGTA、1 mM DTT、1 mM PMSF、1×蛋白酶抑制剂）中。涡旋15秒。冰上孵育30分钟，每10分钟间歇涡旋。

detailedSteps.en: **Separate nuclear fractions**: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C. Supernatant = **soluble nuclear fraction** (transcription factors, nuclear enzymes). Pellet = **chromatin-bound fraction**.
detailedSteps.zh: **分离核组分**: 4°C 16,000 × g离心15分钟。上清 = **可溶性核组分**（转录因子、核酶）。沉淀 = **染色质结合组分**。

detailedSteps.en: **Solubilize chromatin fraction (optional)**: Resuspend chromatin pellet in 50 µL Nuclear Extraction Buffer + 5 mM CaCl₂. Add 1 µL Micrococcal Nuclease (2,000 gel units/µL). Incubate 37°C for 15 min. Stop with 5 mM EGTA. Sonicate 3 × 10 s pulses if needed. Centrifuge 16,000 × g for 5 min — supernatant = solubilized chromatin proteins.
detailedSteps.zh: **溶解染色质组分（可选）**: 将染色质沉淀重悬于50 µL核提取缓冲液 + 5 mM CaCl₂中。加入1 µL微球菌核酸酶（2,000凝胶单位/µL）。37°C孵育15分钟。用5 mM EGTA终止。必要时超声3 × 10秒脉冲。16,000 × g离心5分钟——上清 = 溶解的染色质蛋白。

detailedSteps.en: **Quantify fractions**: Measure protein concentration by Bradford or BCA assay for all fractions. Typical yields from 10⁷ cells: cytoplasmic ~200–400 µg, nuclear soluble ~50–100 µg, chromatin ~20–50 µg.
detailedSteps.zh: **定量各组分**: 用Bradford或BCA法测定所有组分的蛋白浓度。10⁷个细胞的典型产量：胞浆~200-400 µg，可溶性核~50-100 µg，染色质~20-50 µg。

detailedSteps.en: **QC by Western blot**: Load equal protein (10–20 µg) from each fraction. Probe for compartment markers — Cytoplasmic: GAPDH, α-tubulin, MEK1/2. Nuclear soluble: Lamin A/C, SP1. Chromatin-bound: Histone H3, PCNA. ⚠️ Cross-contamination between fractions indicates suboptimal lysis.
detailedSteps.zh: **Western blot质控**: 每个组分加载等量蛋白（10-20 µg）。检测区室标记物——胞浆：GAPDH、α-微管蛋白、MEK1/2。可溶性核：Lamin A/C、SP1。染色质结合：组蛋白H3、PCNA。⚠️ 组分间交叉污染表明裂解条件需优化。

note.en: Add fresh — t½ ~30 min in aqueous solution
note.zh: 新鲜加入——水溶液中半衰期~30分钟
NEB M0247S（可选，用于染色质组分）

note.en: Cytoplasmic fraction can be snap-frozen at -80°C. Nuclear pellet can be frozen at -80°C for extraction later.
note.zh: 胞浆组分可液氮速冻-80°C保存。核沉淀可冻存-80°C后续提取。

note.en: All fractions can be stored at -80°C after quantification
note.zh: 所有组分定量后可-80°C保存
